fields.title: Program Hakkında – Tıbbi Mikrobiyoloji Doktora Programı
fields.content: Tıbbi Mikrobiyoloji Doktora Programı - Programı Bilgileri Dili Türkçe Süresi (Yıl) 4 Azami Süresi (Yıl) 6 Kontenjanı Staj Durumu Yok Program İçeriği Tıbbi Mikrobiyoloji, insanlarda hastalık etkeni olan mikroorganizmaları inceleyen bir bilim dalıdır. Bakteriler, virüsler, mantarlar ve parazitlerin yapısı, üreme özellikleri, hastalık oluşturma mekanizmaları, tanı yöntemleri ve tedavide kullanılacak antimikrobiyal ajanlar başlıca çalışma alanlarıdır. Mikrobiyoloji doktora programında; adayların mikrobiyoloji bilim alanında uluslararası standartlarda yetiştirilmesi amaçlanmıştır. Doktora programımız ile tıbbi mikrobiyoloji alanında çalışacak mezunlarının üniversitenin altyapısının sağladığı laboratuvar uygulamaları ile ilgili son model teknolojiyi ve bilimsel araştırma yöntemlerini de içeren deneyim kazanmaları hedeflenmektedir. Tıbbi Mikrobiyolojinin, son yıllarda özellikle pandemi etkeni mikroorganizmaların tanı yöntemlerinin geliştirilmesi, yorumlanması gibi konularda da söz sahibi olmasının yanı sıra doğru tanı yönteminin kullanılması gibi yönlendirmelerle klinikle de iletişim halinde olabilmesi tercih edilmesinde önemli bir faktör olarak yer almaktadır. Çağdaş ve evrensel değerler ışığında, Tıbbi Mikrobiyoloji konusunda profesyonellik kazanmış, alanımızda yenilik getirebilecek, öz güvenle mesleğini icra edebilecek, bilimsel anlamda kendisini geliştiren ve bilime katkıda bulunacak, etik kurallara bağlılığı ilke edinmiş doktora mezunları yetiştirmek amaçlarımız arasındadır. Doktora programımız, akademik hayat içinde kendisini hazır hissedecek mezunlarımızla da, eğitim kurumlarımızda da bu alanda etkisini gösterecektir. Anabilim Dalı Başkanı Prof. Dr. Yeşim Gürol Tarihçe 2021-22 eğitim öğretim yılında ilk defa öğrenci alacaktır. Kazanılan Derece Programı başarıyla tamamlayanlar Tıbbi Mikrobiyoloji Doktoru (PhD) ünvanını alırlar Kabul Koşulları Üniversitelerin Tıp Fakültesi, Diş Hekimliği Fakültesi, Eczacılık Fakültesi, Veterinerlik Fakültesi, Fen Fakültesi Biyoloji Bölümü ya da Tıbbi Biyoloji Bölümü, Moleküler Biyoloji ve Genetik Bölümü, Biyoteknoloji Bölümünden mezun olmak Akademik Personel ve Lisansüstü Eğitimi (ALES) Sınavında sayısalda minimum 70 puan almış olmak. Yabancı uyruklu öğrenciler için GRE en az 152 ya da GMAT en az 470 puan olması gerekmektedir. Yüksek Öğretim Kurulu tarafından kabul edilen yabancı dil sınavlarından; TOEFL-IBT en az 70 puan YDS/ÜDS/KPDS/YÖKDİL en az 60 puan almış olmak Üst Kademeye Geçiş Tıbbi Mikrobiyoloji doktora derecesi için, Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar Üniversitesi Lisansüstü Yönetmeliği’nin 50. maddesinde belirtildiği gibi, Doktora programı, tezli yüksek lisans derecesi ile kabul edilmiş öğrenciler için toplam yirmi bir krediden ve bir eğitim-öğretim dönemi 60 AKTS’den az olmamak koşuluyla en az yedi ders, seminer, yeterlik sınavı, tez önerisi ve tez çalışması olmak üzere en az 240 AKTS kredisinden oluşur. Mezuniyet Koşulları Tıbbi Mikrobiyoloji doktora derecesi ile mezuniyet için toplam yirmi bir krediden ve bir eğitim-öğretim dönemi 60 AKTS’den az olmamak koşuluyla en az yedi ders, seminer, yeterlik sınavı, tez önerisi ve tez çalışması olmak üzere en az 240 AKTS kredisini tamamlamak şartı aranır. Mezun İstihdam Olanakları Tıbbi Mikrobiyoloji Doktora programı mezunları sadece Türkiye'de değil, yabancı dille eğitim aldıklarından dünyanın birçok üniversitesinde öğretim üyesi olarak istihdam edilebilecek donanımda olacaklardır. Ölçme ve Değerlendirme Sınavlar yazılı, sözlü, ödev ve sunum formatlarında düzenlenebilir. Salgın koşullarında gerektiğinde uzaktan sözlü ve yazılı sınav da yapılabilir. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=tr&curSunit=6151

fields.content: Tıp Eğitimi Doktora (İngilizce) - Programı Bilgileri Dili İngilizce Süresi (Yıl) 4 Azami Süresi (Yıl) 6 Kontenjanı Staj Durumu Yok Program İçeriği Anabilim Dalı Başkanı Doç. Dr. Levent Altintas Program Danışmanı Doç. Dr. Levent Altintas Tarihçe Kazanılan Derece Doktora Kabul Koşulları Lisansüstü programlarımıza öğrenci kabulü, YÖK’ün "Lisansüstü Eğitim ve Öğretim Yönetmeliği" ve Acıbadem Üniversitesi “Lisansüstü Eğitim, Öğretim ve Sınav Yönetmeliği” hükümlerine göre yapılır. Lisansüstü programlara genel başvuru koşulları, başvuru belgeleri, başvuru ve kabul süreci Sağlık Bilimleri Enstitüsü ve program koordinatörleri tarafından belirlenir ve duyurulur. Adaylar, gerekli belgeleri sağlayarak ilgili enstitüye doğrudan başvurabilirler. Başvurular ve kayıtlar Akademik Takvimde ilan edilen süreler içinde yapılır. Yüksek lisans ya da lisans (4 yıllık) öğrenimi veren bir yükseköğretim programının Tıp Fakültesi, Diş Hekimliği Fakültesin’den veya Sağlık Bilimleri Fakültesi bölümlerinden mezun olanlar, Temel /Dahili /Cerrahi Bilimler alanında Tıp Fakültelerinde tezli yüksek lisans veya doktora eğitimini ya da yurtdışındaki eşdeğer eğitimi tamamlamış olanlar, transkriptini sunarak veya kayıt dönemine dek mezun olabileceğini belgeleyerek başvurabilirler. Üst Kademeye Geçiş Mezuniyet Koşulları Programın gerektirdiği süre ve başarı koşulları ile tamamlanması. Mezun İstihdam Olanakları Tıp eğitimi anabilim dallarında akademisyen olarak çalışmak, tıp eğitimi ile ilgili alanlarda danışmanlık yapmak. Ölçme ve Değerlendirme https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=tr&curSunit=6226

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Translasyonel Tıp Doktora (İngilizce)
fields.content: Translasyonel Tıp Doktora (İngilizce) - Programı Bilgileri Dili İngilizce Süresi (Yıl) 4 Azami Süresi (Yıl) 6 Kontenjanı Staj Durumu Yok Program İçeriği Bölüm Başkanı Prof. Dr. Uğur ÖZBEK Tarihçe Bu alanda ilk açılan doktora programıdır. Açılması önerilen doktora programının yürütülen bir yüksek lisans programı bulunmamaktadır fakat halen yürütülmekte olan diğer yüksek lisans programları ile özellikle “Genom Çalışmaları Yüksek Lisans Programı” ile işbirliği içinde olacaktır. Kazanılan Derece Translasyonel Tıp Doktora Kabul Koşulları Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar Üniversitesi, Sağlık Bilimleri Enstitüsü bünyesinde "Translasyonel Tıp" doktora programına başvuru koşulları Yüksek Öğretim Kurumu mevzuatında yer alan şartlara ek olarak şu şekildedir; • Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar Üniversitesi Lisansüstü Eğitim Öğretim Yönetmeliği başvuru koşullarını yerine getirmek. • Lisans derecesi ile doktoraya başvuranlar için; üniversitelerin Tıp Fakültesi, Diş Hekimliği Fakültesi, Eczacılık Fakültesi, Genetik ve Biyomühendislik Bölümü, Moleküler Biyoloji, Genetik ve Biyomühendislik, Tıp Mühendisliği, Biyomedikal Mühendislik, Fen-Edebiyat Fakültesi Biyoloji Bölümü, Tıbbi Biyoloji Bölümü, Moleküler Biyoloji ve Genetik Bölümü, Biyoteknoloji bölümlerinden mezun olanlar, transkriptini sunarak veya kayıt dönemine kadar mezun olabileceğini belgelemelidir. Transkriptinde yüksek lisans derslerinde denkliği bulunmayan bireyler, Translasyonel Tıp programı yüksek lisans derslerini almakla yükümlüdürler. o Lisans programından mezuniyet genel not ortalaması en az 3.0/4.0 olmak o Akademik Personel ve Lisansüstü Eğitimi (ALES) Sınavında sayısalda en az 80 puan almış olmak. o Yüksek Öğretim Kurulu tarafından kabul edilen yabancı dil sınavlarından; TOEFL-IBT en az 84 puan YDS/ÜDS/KPDS/YÖKDİL en az 70 puan • Yüksek Lisans derecesi ile başvuranlar için; Tıp Fakültesi, Diş Hekimliği Fakültesi, Eczacılık Fakültesi, Genetik ve Biyomühendislik Bölümü, Moleküler Biyoloji, Genetik ve Biyomühendislik, Tıp Mühendisliği, Biyomedikal Mühendislik, Fen-Edebiyat Fakültesi Biyoloji Bölümü, Tıbbi Biyoloji Bölümü, Moleküler Biyoloji ve Genetik Bölümü, Biyoteknoloji, Moleküler ve Translasyonel tıp, Biyoistatistik ve Biyoinformatik, Biyolojik Veri Bilimi yüksek lisans programlarından mezun olmak (bu bölümler dışından gelen başvurular anabilim dalı kurulunca uygun görülen şartlara sahip olan bireyler kabul edilecektir) • Transkriptinde Translasyonel Tıp programı yüksek lisans derslerinde denkliği bulunmayan bireyler, ana bilim dalı akademik kurulunca gerekli görülen ders ve/veya dersleri zorunlu kredi yükü dışında yüksek lisans programında yer alan dersleri de almaları gerekebilir. o Akademik Personel ve Lisansüstü Eğitimi (ALES) Sınavında sayısalda minimum 60 puan almış olmak. o Yabancı uyruklu öğrenciler için GRE en az 149 ya da GMAT en az 450 puan olması gerekmektedir. o Yüksek Öğretim Kurulu tarafından kabul edilen yabancı dil sınavlarından; TOEFL-IBT en az 78 puan YDS/ÜDS/KPDS/YÖKDİL en az 65 puan Yabancı dil belgesine sahip olmayan adaylar için Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar Üniversitesi Yabancı Diller Bölümü tarafından yapılacak olan Yabancı Dil Yeterlilik Sınavından en az 65 puan almış olmaları istenecektir. Üst Kademeye Geçiş Mezunlar öğretim üyesi kadrolarına başvurabilir. Mezuniyet Koşulları Translasyonel Tıp doktora derecesi için, Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar Üniversitesi Lisansüstü Yönetmeliği’nin 50. maddesinde belirtildiği gibi, Doktora programı, tezli yüksek lisans derecesi ile kabul edilmiş öğrenciler için toplam yirmi bir krediden ve bir eğitim-öğretim dönemi 60 AKTS’den az olmamak koşuluyla en az yedi ders, seminer, yeterlik sınavı, tez önerisi ve tez çalışması olmak üzere en az 240 AKTS kredisinden oluşur. Translasyonel Tıp doktora derecesi lisansa dayalı doktora programı için, Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar Üniversitesi Lisansüstü Yönetmeliği’nin 50. maddesinde belirtildiği gibi, lisans derecesi ile kabul edilmiş öğrenciler için toplam kırk iki kredilik on dört ders, seminer, yeterlilik sınavı, tez önerisi ve ve tez çalışması olmak üzere en az 300 AKTS kredisinden oluşur. Mezun İstihdam Olanakları Mezunlar öğretim üyesi kadrolarına başvurabilir. Ölçme ve Değerlendirme https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=tr&curSunit=6228

fields.title: About University
fields.content: About University Acıbadem University was founded in 2007 dedicated to the field of health sciences. By using dynamic and contemporary educational programs, a strong academic teaching team trains healthcare students to be future healthcare professionals who continually research innovations in all fields of medical science. With the mission of being a strongly research oriented university, the research laboratories are fitted out with the latest state of the art equipment, designed to complement the life sciences and biotechnology fields. The Clinical Simulation and Advanced Endoscopic - Robotic Surgery Training Center - CASE is one of the most comprehensive medical training centers in the world with its accommodation of multiple departments and advanced technological infrastructure. CASE received the “Center of Excellence” certificate awarded by the CAE Academy to only two medical training centers worldwide. The Center is accredited by the Network of Accredited Clinical Skills Centers of Europe (NASCE) and the Society for Simulation in Healthcare (SSH), providing pre- and post-graduate training. Acıbadem University offers its students the opportunity to study abroad at esteemed partner universities under the Erasmus Programme having bilateral agreements with Europe’s most notable universities. With 100,000 square meters of in-closed area centrally located on the Asian side of Istanbul, the Kerem Aydınlar Campus is replete with high-technology equipment and offers students a privileged university life. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/dynConPage.aspx?curPageId=101&lang=en

fields.title: ECTS Catalogue
fields.content: ECTS Catalog What is the ECTS and TQFHE Catalog? The European Credit Transfer System (ECTS) is a student-based credit system based on the student's workload. It is a value that expresses all the work (theoretical courses, practices, seminars, individual studies, examinations, and assignments, etc.) that the student is supposed to do to complete a course. ECTS is one of the most important work areas in the implementation of the Bologna Process in Turkey. In recent years, many universities in Turkey have intensified their efforts to harmonize their credit and grading systems to ECTS principles. The Turkish Qualifications Framework for Higher Education (TQFHE) refers to "developing a national qualifications framework in higher education” which the member countries of the Bologna Process committed to establish by 2010 in order to increase transparency, recognition and mobility in their higher education systems in accordance with the goals of the Lisbon Strategy, issued by the European Union (EU) in 2000, and the goals of the Bologna Process, in which our country got involved in 2001. The National Qualifications Framework is a system in which the qualifications recognized and associated by national and international stakeholders are structured in a specific order. Through this system, all qualifications and other learning outcomes in higher education can be explained and consistently associated with each other. The studies that were initiated in 2010 in order to determine credits (ECTS) based on student workload at all levels (Associate, Undergraduate, and Graduate) of courses available in curricula, were completed in 2011 and ECTS was made compulsory for all students starting from 2011-2012 Academic Year. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/dynConPage.aspx?curPageId=104&lang=en

fields.title: About the City
fields.content: About City About Istanbul Istanbul is the biggest city in Turkey and is located in the Marmara Region. With a surface area of 5.712 km2, Istanbul is surrounded by Kocaeli in the east, Bursa and the Marmara Sea in the south, Tekirdağ in the west and the Black Sea in the north. Islands in the Sea of Marmara are under the administrative authority of Istanbul. The Bosphorus, which stretches in the north-south direction and connects the Black Sea and the Marmara Sea, divides both the provincial territory and the city into two parts as the Asian side and the European side. The Istanbul metropolitan area approaching the provincial borders in the west, whereas in the west, it passes beyond the provincial borders to include Gebze, which is under the administrative authority of the city of Kocaeli, indeed. Istanbul is Turkey's and Europe's most populous city which had served as the capital of various empires throughout history. It is one of the crowded cities in the world with a population of approximately 12 million. It is ranked 34th in the world with an annual production of 133 billion dollars. It is Turkey's cultural and financial center. Istanbul is located at 41° N, 29° E coordinates. It is established in northwestern Turkey along the Sea of Marmara and the Bosphorus (Bogazici) to surround the Golden Horn. The part of Istanbul in Europe is called the Rumelian side, and the part in Asia is called the Anatolian side. It is the only metropolis in the world built on two continents. It has 40 districts. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/dynConPage.aspx?curPageId=300&lang=en

fields.title: Bologna Process
fields.content: Bologna Process What Is The Bologna Process? The Bologna Process is a reform process that aims to create a European Higher Education Area by 2010. It is an unusual process created and maintained by 47 member states (the number of member states increased from 45 to 46 when Montenegro declared its independence, and finally to 47 with Kazakhstan's participation in the process) in cooperation with many international organizations. Membership in the process is not based on any agreement between governments/states. The papers published within the scope of Bologna Process have no legal binding. It is a process in which each country participates in a free will, and the countries have the right to accept or reject the goals set out by the Bologna Process. Citizens of countries within the European Higher Education Area that the Bologna Process aims to create, will be able to move around Europe easily with the aim of working or studying in higher education. Europe will be preferred by people from other parts of the world both in terms of higher education and job opportunities. What is the most undesirable thing in the European Higher Education Area is that the education systems of the member states should be transformed into a uniform higher education system. The main goal in the European Higher Education Area is to strike a balance between diversity and unity. The aim is to make higher education systems comparable and compatible with each other by preserving their unique differences. In this way, it is planned to facilitate the transition from one country or higher education system to another, thereby increasing the mobility and employment of students and lecturers. How Did The Bologna Process Begin? The foundations of the Bologna Process were laid in 1998 by the Sorbonne Declaration issued at the end of a meeting held by the Ministers of Education of France, Italy, Germany and England in Sorbonne. The idea of creating a common higher education area in Europe emerged for the first time with this statement. However, the Bologna Process officially began in 1999 with the signing and publication of the Bologna declaration by the ministers responsible for higher education of 29 European countries. Six of the main goals of the Bologna Process have been announced with this statement. These goals are: To create highly understandable and comparable higher education diplomas and / or degrees (development of the Diploma Supplement application for this purpose), To switch to a two-stage degree system: Bachelor and Master in Higher Education, To implement the European Credit Transfer System (ECTS), To provide and expand the mobility of students and lecturers, To establish and expand the network of quality assurance systems in higher education, To improve European dimension in higher education. What happened after 1999? Two years after the release of the Bologna declaration, with the participation of three new countries (Turkey, Croatia and Cyprus), including our country, the ministers of higher education of 32 European countries met in Prague on 19 May 2001 to monitor the Bologna Process and set priorities for the coming years. 3 goals added to Bologna Process in Prague: To promote lifelong learning, To ensure the active participation of students and higher education institutions in the process, To render the European Higher Education Area appealing. The Higher Education Ministers of 33 European countries, meeting in Berlin in 2003, added a 10th goal to the Bologna Process on "establishing a synergy between the European Research Area (ERA) and the European Higher Education Area (EHEA)and doctoral studies"; they also set the following 3 priority areas to be realized before the Bergen Conference in 2005 in order to accelerate the process: Two-stage degree structure in higher education (Bachelor’s and Master’s Degree ) , Recognition of higher education diplomas and / or degrees and duration of study, Quality assurance. 7 other countries (Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, The Vatican Republic, the Russian Federation, Serbia-Montenegro, Macedonia and Andorra) joined the Bologna Process at the conference in Berlin, bringing the total number of countries to 40. The number of member states increased to 45 with the acceptance of 5 new countries at the fourth European Education Ministers ' Conference held in Bergen, Norway on 19-20 May 2005. In this meeting, 4 priority areas were identified which were intended to be realized between 2005 and 2007. These priority areas: To create a synergy between the European Higher Education Area and the European Research Area, To strength the social dimension of the Bologna Process, To provide the mobility of students and lecturers, To render the European Higher Education Area appealing, ensure and strength the cooperation with non-European countries. At the meeting, it was also decided to prepare a Stocktaking Report to identify the applications and developments in the member states on the following 4 main topics, which are expected to be realized by 2007.: The implementation of the "Quality Assurance Standards and Implementation principles"for higher education institutions in the European Higher Education Area developed by the European Association of Quality Assurance (ENQA) in member countries Applications of National Qualifications frameworks, Joint higher education programs, including doctoral programs, To create flexible learning paths in higher education. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/dynConPage.aspx?curPageId=400&lang=en

fields.content: Biomedical Device Technology - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 31 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Biomedical Device Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Biomedical Equipment Technology Program is to train biomedical technicians who know the test methodologies, make maintenance repairs and follow up to ensure that the diagnostic and treatment functions of the medical devices can be fulfilled properly. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. In the Center of Advanced Simulation and Education, program students are informed about the indications of the use of many medical devices in the clinic, so that students can learn both the practical operation of medical devices and the effects of medical device problems on the patients, with the help of patient simulators. CASE is intensively benefited in the first year of program. In the second year of the program, theoretical and practical trainings on tests, calibrations and diagnostics of medical devices are carried out in the Medical Device Test and Calibration Laboratory. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. PROG. Director Lecturer, Phd. Mehmet Emin Aksoy ECTS and Erasmus Coordinator of the Department Instructor Serhat Ilgaz Yöner Secretary Gülgün Cuma Program Başkanı Instructor Serhat Ilgaz Yöner History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School, Biomedical Device Technology Program has been accepting students since 2015-2016 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who graduate by completing the two year education receives the title of Biomedical Device Technician through an associate degree. Admission Requirements Biomedical Device Technology Program accepts students according to Basic Proficiency Test (TYT) score obtained as a result of Higher Education Institutions Exam (YKS) conducted by Turkish Republic's Assessment, Selection and Placement Center (ÖSYM). Higher Grade Transition Students who graduate from the Biomedical Device Technology Program can gain the right to enroll in undergraduate programs related to the vertical transfer exam (DGS), if a quota is available in accordance with the "Regulation on the Continuation of Undergraduate Education of Vocational Schools and Open Education Associate Degree Graduates". Graduation Requirements In order for the student to graduate, he / she must have passed all the courses in the program and must not have FF, FG, NA or U grade. In the Biomedical Device Technology Program, the student must complete 120 ECTS and have a GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates have the opportunity to work in public and private health institutions in the health sector as a medical devices expert. Assessment and Grading Various measurement and evaluation methods such as midterm exam, quiz, practice, project, report, final are used to evaluate students. For graduation, the program GPA is expected to be at least 2.00 out of 4.00. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Computer Programming
fields.content: Computer Programming - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 50 Internships Status Have ÖSYM type TYT About Programme Computer Programming is a program related to computer technologies, programming, computer use, software development (in Local, Intranet, or Internet environments), hardware, maintenance and repair, installation, and management of computer networks. In the field of informatics, the need for technicians who specialize in their field every day in our country, who can produce the right solution to problems, who are qualified, have absorbed teamwork, have developed analytical thinking ability, and who can work as a programmer and/or technical support staff is increasing. In this context, courses based on computer hardware and software technologies are included in the curriculum of this program, which was opened to obtain a profession in a field of great need. Besides the compulsory courses, students will also take elective courses, such as embedded systems. system design, computer hardware, computer networks, databases, programming, Object Oriented Programming, mobile programming, Internet programming. Computer Programming, which is a rapidly developing field in the world and Turkey,aims to train an intermediate workforce with decency at the global level. Graduates will have the opportunity to work in industrial organizations, software companies, computer sales, and technical support firms, banks, insurance companies, commercial organizations, internet service providers, companies, internet broadcasting, TV and radio companies, research companies, stock exchanges, transportation, education, logistics companies, public institutions and organizations, and service sector. ECTS and Erasmus Coordinator of the Department Instructor Levent YALÇIN Secretary High School Secretary Gülgün CUMA Program Başkanı Instructor Levent YALÇIN History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School, Computer Programming Program has been accepting students since the 2022-2023 academic year. Qualification Awarded Students who successfully complete this program are entitled to receive an Associate Degree in Computer Programming. Admission Requirements Computer Programming Program accepts students according to Basic Proficiency Test (TYT) score obtained as a result of Higher Education Institutions Exam (YKS) conducted by Turkish Republic's Assessment, Selection and Placement Center (ÖSYM). Higher Grade Transition Students who graduate from the Computer Programming Program can gain the right to enroll in relevant undergraduate programs through the vertical transfer exam (DGS) if a quota is opened in accordance with the "Regulation on the Continuation of Undergraduate Education for Associate Degree Graduates of Vocational Schools and Open Education". In this context, the undergraduate level departments that can be registered with DGS are as follows. Computer Science Computer engineering Computer and Instructional Technologies Teaching Information Systems Engineering Information Systems and Technologies Industrial Engineering Physical Physics engineering Statistics Statistics and Computer Science Control and Automation Engineering Mathematics and Computer Science Meteorological Engineering Aerospace Engineering Software engineering Management Information Systems (Equal Weight) Graduation Requirements In order for the student to graduate, he or she must have passed all the courses in the program and must not have a grade of FF, FG, NA or U. In the Computer Programming Program, the student must complete 120 ECTS and the GPA must be at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates It is aimed to train an intermediate workforce with global competence with Computer Programming, which is a rapidly developing field in the world and in Turkey. Graduates will have wide job opportunities in public institutions and organizations, such as software companies, computer sales and technical support companies, banks, insurance companies, commercial organizations, internet service providers, internet broadcasting companies, radio-television companies, research companies, stock exchanges, transportation, education, logistics companies and service sectors, especially industrial organizations. Assessment and Grading Various measurement and evaluation methods such as midterm exam, quiz, practice, project, report, final are used to evaluate students. For graduation, the program GPA is expected to be at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Courses are scored and lettered as follows; AA 90-100 Excellent 4.00 BA 85-89 Good-Excellent 3.50 BB 80-84 Good 3.00 CB 70-79 Medium-Good 2.50 CC 60-69 Medium 2.00 DC 55-59 Medium-Poor 1.50 DD 50 -54 Poor-Successful 1.00 FF 0-49 Poor-Unsuccessful 0.00 FG Did Not Take Semester / Year-End Exam Failed 0.00 NA Absent Unsuccessful 0.00 T - Transfer S - Successful in Elective Non-Credit Course U - Unsuccessful in Elective Non-Credit Course W - Withdrawal https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6230

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Culinary
fields.content: Culinary - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 37 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Culinary Personnel ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The Culinary Program, which will start formal education with 60 students under the Acıbadem University, Vocational School in the 2014-2015 academic year, will take in a quota of 60 students for evening education. The food and drink services in health facilities differ from other institutions offering food and drink services in terms of its main objectives and structure. In the same way, hospitality in health facilities differs from hospitality in tourism facilities. The Culinary program, which will be accepting students for the first time this year, aims to introduce intermediate staff members to our country and sector with both its course programs and applications which are equipped with differences. Students who complete the Culinary associate degree program and graduate will be able to Vertical Transfer into the following Undergraduate Degree Programs, Family and Consumer Sciences Nutrition and Dietetics Gastronomy Gastronomy and Culinary Arts Culinary Arts and Management. The Hotel, Restaurant and Catering Services Department Culinary Program gives associate degree graduates. When the program is successfully completed and the requirements of the program are provided, an Associate Degree Diploma in "Culinary Personnel" is awarded. Students at our university are not only encouraged to develop in term of knowledge and skills, but also their social skills. At the Kerem Aydınlar Campus where our student clubs and sports centres are located, we ensure that students start their professional life better equipped and with more information and experienced steps. There are five faculty members on the staff of the Culinary Arts Program. There is a culinary workshop, service hall and conference hall where students can practice. Education is provided in classrooms equipped with projectors and internet connectivity. Additionally, various seminars will be organized where experts and managers in the business world will share their knowledge and experiences. Program Başkanı Instructor Pelin KOSAL History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational High School, Culinary program, started education and training in 2014-2015 academic year. It is one of the culinary programs within the foundation universities in Turkey that specializes in its field and has sufficient academic staff. Qualification Awarded Those who graduate after completing two years of education; with an associate's degree, they receive the title of Cook. Admission Requirements The program admits students according to the type of score obtained as a result of the TYT Higher Education Transition exam conducted by the Student Selection and Placement Center (OSYM). Higher Grade Transition Graduates can apply for undergraduate programs in gastronomy, Nutrition and Dietetics. Graduation Requirements In order for a student to graduate, they must have completed all their courses in the program and not have a grade of FF, FG, NA and U. In the nutrition and dietetics program, the student must provide a minimum of 120 ECTS credits and have a GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Those who complete the cookery program are given the title of” Cookery professional employee". Our students who graduate from the program also get the opportunity to continue their undergraduate education in the Departments of gastronomy and culinary arts, nutrition and Dietetics, family and Consumer Sciences. Cooks can especially find the opportunity to work in the kitchens of hospitals, restaurants, accommodation, kitchens of private or official institutions where mass meals are eaten, food factories. Well-trained creative cooks can easily find high-paying jobs Assessment and Grading For the evaluation of students, various assessment and evaluation methods are used, such as decals, quizzes, practical, projects, reports, applications and finals. For graduation, the overall GPA in the program is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored and capitalized as shown in the table. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=48

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Anesthesia
fields.content: Anesthesia - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 50 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Anesthesia Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Anesthesia Program is to raise contemporary technicians who can prepare patients before operation, help the anesthesiologist by monitoring vital parameters of patient during operation, undertake patient control and supervision after operation, with required knowledge, qualification and internalized spirit of team work. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with their internships at hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other healthcare institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Advanced simulation training in the Center of Advanced Simulation and Education is provided as well as the hospital practice within the program. Preparation process for the students is completed with the crisis scenario created. Program Başkanı Associate Prof. Dr. Muharrem KOÇYİĞİT Program Consultant Instructor Tuba USSELİ History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, anesthesia programme started to admit students in 2009-2010 academic year. Qualification Awarded Associate's Degree Admission Requirements The program admits students according to the score of TYT obtained from the Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by the Students Selection and Placement Center. Higher Grade Transition Those who have successfully completed the program may transfer to Nursing, Emergency Relief and Disaster Management, Healthcare Management and Social Services undergraduate programs if they are successful in the vertical transition examination (DGS) conducted by OSYM. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In the program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a general weighted grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can work in the operating rooms of public and private hospitals, intensive care units, pain clinics, medical companies and hair transplant centers. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”prepared by the related lecturers and included in the information package. Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term, quiz, practice, seminar and final are used for the evaluation of students .For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=23

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Anesthesia (Evening Education)
fields.content: Anesthesia (Evening Education) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 37 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Anesthesia Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Anesthesia Program is to raise contemporary technicians who can prepare patients before operation, help the anesthesiologist by monitoring vital parameters of patient during operation, undertake patient control and supervision after operation, with required knowledge, qualification and internalized spirit of team work. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with their internships at hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other healthcare institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Advanced simulation training in the Center of Advanced Simulation and Education is provided as well as the hospital practice within the program. Preparation process for the students is completed with the crisis scenario created. Program Başkanı Associate Prof. Dr. Muharrem KOÇYİĞİT Program Consultant Instructor Tuba USSELİ History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, anesthesia program has been accepting students since the 2009-2010 academic year. Qualification Awarded Associate's Degree Admission Requirements The program admits students according to the score of TYT obtained from the Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by the Students Selection and Placement Center. Higher Grade Transition Those who have successfully completed the program may transfer to Nursing, Emergency Relief and Disaster Management, Healthcare Management and Social Services undergraduate programs if they are successful in the vertical transition examination (DGS) conducted by OSYM. Graduation Requirements In order for a student to graduate, they must have completed all their courses in the program and not have a grade of FF, FG, NA and U. In the anesthesia program, the student must complete 120 ECTS and have an overall weighted GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can work in the operating rooms of public and private hospitals, intensive care units, pain clinics, medical companies and hair transplant centers. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”prepared by the related lecturers and included in the information package. Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term, quiz, practice, seminar and final are used for the evaluation of students .For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=24

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Audiometry
fields.content: Audiometry - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 31 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Audiometry Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Audiometry Program is to raise health technicians who perform hearing diagnostic tests, evaluate the results of medical or surgical interventions to correct hearing impairment, and use test devices that can detect equilibrium and related disorders. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. In the program, practical trainings are carried out in the Audiology Laboratory along with theoretical knowledge. Program Başkanı Instructor Dr. Engin Çakmakcı Program Consultant Instructor Semih Doğukan Ağır History The programme has been admitting students since 2015-2016 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree, receive the title of Health Technician-audiometry technician. Admission Requirements Our programme admits students according to the resutls of YKS and TYT that are conducted by OSYM. Higher Grade Transition Graduates, by taking the advantage of the regulation on the continuity of their undergraduate education”, if the quota is opened in vertical transfer exam (DGS) determined by OSYM, have a right to register for Physics, Audiology, Special Education Teaching, Optical and Acoustic Engineering, Physics Engineering, Emergency and Disaster Management, Healthcare Management undergraduate programmes. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In the Programme, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates are able to work as audiometrists in public and private institutions in the health sector. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Dialysis
fields.content: Dialysis - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 37 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Dialysis Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Dialysis Program is to raise health technicians who are expected to work in the dialysis units for diseases requiring dialysis treatments in the stages of taking patient to dialysis machine, follow-up and treatment and completion of dialysis process. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Program students are trained by studying on real dialysis machines in the Center of Advanced Simulation and Education (CASE). They apply vascular access practices with real materials on the advanced model arms. They learn hemodialysis complications through simulations. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internship and practice courses in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other dialysis centers which are in cooperation with the university. Program Consultant Expert Instructor Canan Yüksel Acar History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, ‘dialysis technician’ programme started education and training in 2013-2014 academic year. The aim of the programme is to train technical staff who are especially equipped to adopt ethical values of the profession, recognize dialysis devices, know how to maintain and establish them and know monitoring and termination stages. The programme includes theoretical and practical courses such as anatomy of the urinary system, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, microbiology and basic information about, as well as lectures about the principles of patient care and specific clinical approach to dialysis patients, dialysis treatment. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree, receive the title of Health Technician-Dialysis technician. Admission Requirements Our programme admits students according to the resutls of YKS and TYT that are conducted by OSYM. Higher Grade Transition Graduates are able to make vertical transfer to Nursing, Nursing and Health Services undergraduate programmes. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In the operating room Services Program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates are able to work in public and private dialysis centers under the title of “dialysis technician”. According to the Public Personnel Selection Examination (KPSS), health technicians can be appointed as dialysis technicians. Assessment and Grading Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term exam, quiz, practice, seminar, project and final are used for the evaluation of students. For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=27

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Electroneurophysiology
fields.content: Electroneurophysiology - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 34 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Electroneurophysiology Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Electroneurophysiology Program is to raise health technicians who perform neurophysiological examinations for patients in neurophysiology laboratories, intensive care units and during operations. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Program Consultant Expert Instructor Emine YILDIZ History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, Electroneurophysiology programme has been admitting students since 2013-2014 Academic Year. Qualification Awarded Those who complete their two - year education and graduate with an associate degree take the title of Health Technician-Elektroneurophysiology technician Admission Requirements Electroneurophysiology Program;admits students according to the basic proficiency test (TYT) score taken from the Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by the Measurement, Selection and Placement center (OSYM). Higher Grade Transition Students who have successfully completed their associate degree may continue their undergraduate education in Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation, Nursing, Nursing and Health Services programs by taking the Vertical Transfer Exam (DGS). Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must accomplish all the courses in the programme and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In the electroneurophysiology program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students who graduate from the electroneurophysiology program are able to work in the Electroneurophysiology Laboratories, Operating Theatres and sleep units of public or private hospitals and polyclinics under the supervision of Neurology, ENT, Psychiatry, Pediatrics, Pulmonologists and Physiology specialists. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “Course Instruction Plan”prepared by the course lecturers and included in the information package. Related articles of Acıbadem University Associate Degree, Undergraduate Education and Examination Regulation are applied regarding exams and course final grades. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=30

fields.title: Program Hakkında – First and Emergency Aid
fields.content: First and Emergency Aid - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 64 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Emergency Medical Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of First and Emergency Aid Program is to raise qualified paramedics (Ambulance and Emergency Care Technicians) particularly to serve in health institutions, where they can perform interventions in order to save the life of patients and prevent injuries in the most appropriate way in emergency situations and work in emergency health service units of other institutions and organizations. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Students develop professional skills with the applied practices in the Center of Advanced Simulation and Education (CASE). Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. PROG. Director Lecturer, Phd. Hasan Aldinç Program Consultant Expert Instructor Canan YÜKSEL ACAR Program Consultant Specialist Yaren KAVRAZ GÜNEY History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University first and Emergency Assistance Program started its education for the first time in the 2009-2010 academic year. The aim of the program is to bring qualified paramedics (ambulance and emergency care technicians) to society who will work in the emergency medical services units of other institutions and organizations, especially health organizations that can perform interventions to save the patient's life or prevent injuries in the most appropriate way. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree are awarded the title of Medical Technician-Emergency Medical Technician. Admission Requirements First and Emergency Programme admits students according to result of (TYT) obtained by the Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by (ÖSYM) Higher Grade Transition Students who graduated from the programme can make vertical transfer to Emergency and Disaster Management, Nursing and health services and the nursing department if succeed in DGS counducted by ÖSYM Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In the first and emergency aid program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a general weighted grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students can work in 112 emergency Help centers, public and private sector in the emergency room of hospitals, air and sea ambulance, medical centers in all units, who provide emergency medical services, the health service that executes private and Voluntary Organizations at different levels (e.g., Directorate General of Red Crescent Society). Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”prepared by the related lecturers and included in the information package. Related articles of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Associate Degree, undergraduate education and examination regulations are applied regarding exams and Course Success grades. fields.title: Program Hakkında – First and Emergency Aid (Evening Education)
fields.content: First and Emergency Aid (Evening Education) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 46 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Emergency Medical Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of First and Emergency Aid Program is to raise qualified paramedics (Ambulance and Emergency Care Technicians) particularly to serve in health institutions, where they can perform interventions in order to save the life of patients and prevent injuries in the most appropriate way in emergency situations and work in emergency health service units of other institutions and organizations. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Students develop professional skills with the applied practices in the Center of Advanced Simulation and Education (CASE). Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. PROG. Director Associate Prof. Dr. Serpil YAYLACI Program Consultant Instructor Dr. Çiğdem ÖZKAYA ŞENÜREN History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University first and Emergency Assistance Program started education for the first time in the 2009-2010 academic year. The aim of the program is to bring qualified paramedics (ambulance and emergency care technicians) to society who will work in the emergency medical services units of other institutions and organizations, especially health organizations that can perform interventions to save the patient's life or prevent injuries in the most appropriate way. Qualification Awarded Those who graduate after completing two years of education; with an associate's degree, they receive the title of Medical Technician - Emergency Medical Technician. Admission Requirements First and Emergency Programme admits students according to result of (TYT) obtained by the Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by (ÖSYM) Higher Grade Transition Students who graduated from the program: the faculty, “the vertical transfer exam made by OSYM (DGS) if successful; emergency and Disaster Management, Nursing, and health services to the nursing department can cross. Graduation Requirements In order for a student to graduate, they must have completed all their courses in the program and not have a grade of FF, FG, NA and U. In the first and emergency aid program, the student must complete 120 ECTS and have an overall weighted GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Udents can work in 112 emergency Help centers, public and private sector in the emergency room of hospitals, air and sea ambulance, medical centers in all units, who provide emergency medical services, the health service that executes private and Voluntary Organizations at different levels (e.g., Directorate General of Red Crescent Society). Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”prepared by the related lecturers and included in the information package. Related articles of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Associate Degree, undergraduate education and examination regulations are applied regarding exams and Course Success grades. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Medical Data Processing Technician
fields.content: Medical Data Processing Technician - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 31 Internships Status Have ÖSYM type TYT About Programme History Qualification Awarded Önlisans Diploması (SHMYO– Tıbbi Veri İşleme Teknikerliği) Programımızda öğrenim gören öğrenciler, mezun olduktan sonra “Tıbbi Veri İşleme Teknikeri” ünvanı alırlar. Admission Requirements T.C. Ölçme, Seçme ve Yerleştirme Merkezi (ÖSYM) tarafından yapılan Yükseköğretim Kurumları Sınavı (YKS) sonucu elde edilen Temel Yeterlilik Testi (TYT) puan türüne göre öğrenci alır. Higher Grade Transition Tıbbi Veri İşleme Teknikerliği Önlisans Programından mezun olan öğrencilerin, lisans öğrenimine devam edebilmeleri için Ölçme, Seçme ve Yerleştirme Merkezi (ÖSYM) tarafından yapılan Dikey Geçiş Sınavına (DGS) girmeleri gerekmektedir. ÖSYM tarafından yayınlanan Dikey Geçiş Sınav Kılavuzuna göre belirlenen lisans programlarına geçiş yapılabilir. Graduation Requirements Programı başarıyla tamamlamak için programda mevcut olan derslerin tümünü (120 AKTS karşılığı) geçmek. 4.00 üzerinden en az 2.00 ağırlıklı not ortalaması elde etmek, uygulama derslerini ve 30 iş günlük yaz uygulamasını başarıyla tamamlamak gerekmektedir. Öğrencinin mezun olabilmesi için programdaki tüm derslerini başarmış olması, FF, FG, NA ve U notuna sahip olmaması gerekir. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Mezunlar; • Devlet, üniversite ve özel hastaneleri • Poliklinikler ve Aile Sağlığı Merkezleri • Tıbbi laboratuvarlar ve görüntüleme merkezleri • Sağlık sigorta şirketleri • Tıbbi yazılım ve bilişim firmaları • Sağlık Bakanlığı ve bağlı birimlerde çalışabilmektedirler. fields.content: Medical Documentation and Secretariat - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 41 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Medical Secretary ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The purpose of Medical Documentation and Secretarial Program is to educate healthcare personnel equipped with following traits: Having advanced computer skills, being good at touch-typing with F-keyboard, having excellent command of medical terminology, being good at processing medical records and documents along with coding of diseases and surgeries in accordance with ICD-10 system, being experienced in compiling and organizing scientific researches in various branches of medicine and healthcare as well as in presenting them for the inquirers and last but not least, being experienced in human relations. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Program Başkanı Associate Prof. Dr. Hakan Özveri Program Consultant Instructor Aytül Yavuz Yılmaz History The Program accepts students from the 2009-2010 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who graduate after completing their two-year education; with an associate's degree, they receive the title of "medical Secretary". Admission Requirements The program admits students according to the score obtained from TYT conducted by the measurement, selection and Placement Center (OSYM). Higher Grade Transition Students who graduate from the medical documentation and secretarial Associate Degree Program must take the vertical transition exam (DGS) conducted by the measurement, selection and Placement Center (OSYM) in order to continue their undergraduate education. Graduation Requirements To successfully complete the program, students must pass pass all of the courses available in the program (equivalent to 120 ECTS). It is necessary to achieve a weighted GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00, successfully complete practice courses and a 30-day internship. In order for a student to graduate, they must have completed all their courses in the program and not have a grade of FF, FG, NA and U. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can work in public and private health institutions and organizations with the title of "medical Secretary". The Ministry of health, public and private bed/mattress computing services agencies and institutions and outpatient clinical treatment, patient registration and admission, and medical services human resources and statistical units can work in archive. According to the Public Personnel Selection Examination (KPSS), they can be appointed as "medical Secretary". Assessment and Grading In order for each student to register for courses at the beginning of the semester and take the final exam, they must have attended at least 70% of the courses and at least 80% of the applications. Students are subjected to at least 1 midterm and final exam for each course Dec. Decency decency (scores obtained from measurement tools such as homework, practice exam, seminar lecture, quiz as mid-term Grade can also be evaluated) is 40% and end-of-term exam contribution is 60%. All exams are evaluated over 100 points. For graduation, the overall GPA in the program is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored and capitalized as shown in the table. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=44

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Medical Documentation and Secretariat (Evening Education)
fields.content: Medical Documentation and Secretariat (Evening Education) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 11 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Medical Secretary ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The purpose of Medical Documentation and Secretarial Program is to educate healthcare personnel equipped with following traits: Having advanced computer skills, being good at touch-typing with F-keyboard, having excellent command of medical terminology, being good at processing medical records and documents along with coding of diseases and surgeries in accordance with ICD-10 system, being experienced in compiling and organizing scientific researches in various branches of medicine and healthcare as well as in presenting them for the inquirers and last but not least, being experienced in human relations. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Program Başkanı Associate Prof. Dr. Hakan Özveri Program Consultant Instructor Aytül Yavuz Yılmaz History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, medical documentation and secretarial program has been accepting students since the 2009-2010 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who graduate after completing two years of education; with an associate's degree, they receive the title of medical Secretary. Admission Requirements The program admits students according to basic qualification test (TYT) based on the type of score obtained from the Higher Education Institutions exam (YKS) conducted by the measurement, selection and Placement Center (OSYM). Higher Grade Transition Students who graduate from the medical documentation and secretarial Associate Degree Program must take the vertical transition exam (DGS) conducted by the measurement, selection and Placement Center (OSYM) in order to continue their undergraduate education. Graduation Requirements To successfully complete the program, pass all of the courses available in the program (equivalent to 120 ECTS). It is necessary to achieve a weighted GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00, successfully complete practice courses and a 30-day internship. In order for a student to graduate, they must have completed all their courses in the program and not have a grade of FF, FG, NA and U. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can work in public and private health institutions and organizations with the title of "medical Secretary". The Ministry of health, public and private bed/mattress computing services agencies and institutions and outpatient clinical treatment, patient registration and admission, and medical services human resources and statistical units can work in archive. According to the Public Personnel Selection Examination (KPSS), they can be appointed as medical secretaries. Assessment and Grading In order for each student to register for courses at the beginning of the semester and take the final exam, they must have attended at least 70% of the courses and at least 80% of the applications. Students are subjected to at least 1 midterm and final exam for each course Dec. Decency decency (scores obtained from measurement tools such as homework, practice exam, seminar lecture, quiz as mid-term Grade can also be evaluated) is 40% and end-of-term exam contribution is 60%. All exams are evaluated over 100 points. For graduation, the overall GPA in the program is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=45

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Medical Imaging Techniques
fields.content: Medical Imaging Techniques - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 56 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Mezuniyet ünvanı güncellendi ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Medical Imaging Techniques Program is to raise healthcare technicians who can use the radiology devices which produce images that are necessary to provide medical diagnosis. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Program Başkanı Prof. Dr. Eşref KIZILKAYA Program Consultant Instructor F. Pınar Elpen Karyemez History The programme has been admitting students since 2009-2010 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree, receive the title of Health Technician-Medical Imaging technician. Admission Requirements Our programme admits students according to the resutls of YKS and TYT that are conducted by OSYM. Higher Grade Transition Graduates, by taking vertical transfer exam (DGS) determined by OSYM, have a right to register for Nursing, Nursing and Health Services undergraduate programmes. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In the Programme, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates are able to work in radiology and nuclear medicine departments of public and private hospitals. Assessment and Grading Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term exam, quiz, practice, project, report and final are used for the evaluation of students For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=40

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Medical Imaging Techniques (Evening Education)
fields.content: Medical Imaging Techniques (Evening Education) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 41 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Medical Imaging Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Medical Imaging Techniques Program is to raise healthcare technicians who can use the radiology devices which produce images that are necessary to provide medical diagnosis. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Program Başkanı Prof. Dr. Eşref KIZILKAYA Program Consultant Instructor F. Pınar Elpen Karyemez History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, medical imaging techniques program has been accepting students since the 2009-2010 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who graduate after completing their two - year education; with an associate's degree, they receive the title of Health Technician - medical imaging technician. Admission Requirements Our programme admits students according to the resutls of YKS and TYT that are conducted by OSYM. Higher Grade Transition If those who have successfully completed the program are successful in the vertical transfer exam (DGS) conducted by OSYM, they can transfer vertically to The Bachelor's degree programs in Nursing, Nursing and Health Services. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. Students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can work in radiology and nuclear medicine departments of public and private hospitals. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course Learning Plan”prepared by the relevant lecturers and included in the information package. Various measurement and evaluation methods are used for evaluating students, such as decals, quizzes, practical, seminars and finals. For graduation, the overall GPA in the program is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=41

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Medical Laboratory Techniques
fields.content: Medical Laboratory Techniques - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 57 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Medical Laboratory Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Medical Laboratory Techniques Program is to raise healthcare technicians who are thoroughly familiar with the work processes in a diagnostic laboratory and who prepare the results of diagnostic tests and perform quality controls. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Program Başkanı Lecturer, Phd. NİHAN ÜNÜBOL Program Consultant Instructor GÖZDE GÜVENÇ ÖZCAN History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, Medical Laboratory Techniques programme has been admitting students since 2009-2010 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree take the title of Health Technician-Medical Laboratory Technician. Admission Requirements Medical Laboratory Techniques Programme admits students according to the basic proficiency test (TYT-score) score taken from the T.C Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by Student Selection and Placement Center (ÖSYM). Higher Grade Transition Those who have successfully completed the programme are allowed to make vertical transfer to other programmes such as Biology, Molecular Biology and genetics, Bioengineering, genetics and Bioengineering, Biotechnology Biotechnology and Molecular Biology, Nursing, Nursing and Health Services if they are successful in the vertical transfer examination (DGS) conducted by ÖSYM. Graduation Requirements To complete the programme, it is necessary to pass all the courses available in the programme (equivalent to 120 ECTS), have a GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00 and complete 30 work days internship. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates are able to work in Health Centers, hospitals, outpatient clinics and laboratories such as Clinical Biochemistry Laboratory, Serology Microbiology, Parasitology, Hematology laboratory and blood bank and medical biology and genetics laboratories. They can also work in the manufacturing or quality control units of the pharmaceutical industry, university research laboratories, Specialty Medical Laboratories, or in companies that produce or market medical laboratory materials. Assessment and Grading Each student must attend at least 70% of the theoretical courses and at least 80% of the applications in order to take the final exam. Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term, quiz, practice, seminar and final are used for the evaluation of students. For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Medical Laboratory Techniques (Evening Education)
fields.content: Medical Laboratory Techniques (Evening Education) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 33 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Medical Laboratory Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Medical Laboratory Techniques Program is to raise healthcare technicians who are thoroughly familiar with the work processes in a diagnostic laboratory and who prepare the results of diagnostic tests and perform quality controls. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Program Başkanı Prof. Dr. YEŞİM GÜROL Program Consultant Instructor GÖZDE GÜVENÇ ÖZCAN History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, medical laboratory techniques program; in the 2014-2015 academic year, students started to admits students to second education. Qualification Awarded Those who graduate after completing two years of education; with an associate's degree, they receive the title of Health Technician - Medical Laboratory Technician. Admission Requirements Medical Laboratory Techniques Programme admits students according to the basic proficiency test (TYT-score) score taken from the T.C Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by Student Selection and Placement Center (ÖSYM). Higher Grade Transition Medical Laboratory Techniques Programme admits students according to the basic proficiency test (TYT-score) score taken from the T.C Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by Student Selection and Placement Center (ÖSYM). Graduation Requirements To complete the program, students must complete all courses in the program (120 ECTS) successfully, and have a cumulative GPA of 2.00 out of 4.00 and a minimum of 30 working days internship is required. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can work in laboratories in public and private health centers, hospitals and outpatient clinics: clinical biochemistry laboratory, Serology laboratory, Microbiology Laboratory, Parasitology Laboratory, Hematology laboratory, blood bank and medical biology and Genetics Laboratory. In addition,they can work in the production or quality control units of the pharmaceutical industry, hospitals in the medical field, University Research Laboratories, Private Medical Laboratories, companies that produce or market medical laboratory materials. Assessment and Grading Each student must attend at least 70% of the theoretical courses and at least 80% of the applications in order to take the final exam. Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term, quiz, practice, seminar and final are used for the evaluation of students. For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Operating Room Services
fields.content: Operating Room Services - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 48 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Operating Room Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Operating Room Services Program is to educate health technicians preparing the operating room for operation and giving support to surgical team during surgery. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. In Operating Room Services Program, students take courses on general information about the profession and duties and responsibilities of the operating room technicians as well as courses of basic medical sciences and culture courses. They develop their professional skills by practical trainings in the Center of Advanced Simulation and Education (CASE). Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with clinical practice and summer internship in the operating rooms of Acıbadem Healthcare Group hospitals and other healthcare facilities which are in cooperation with the university. Program Başkanı Prof. Dr. Aykut Soyder Program Consultant Expert Instructor Rana Güngör Sevinç History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, Operating Room Services Program has been admitting students since 2015-2016 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree, receive the title of Health Technician-operating room technician. Admission Requirements Our programme admits students according to the results of YKS and TYT that are conducted by OSYM. Higher Grade Transition Graduates, by taking the advantage of the regulation on the continuity of their undergraduate education”, if the quota is opened in vertical transfer exam (DGS) determined by OSYM, have a right to register for Nursing, Nursing and health services, Emergency and Disaster Management undergraduate programmes. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In the Operating Room Services Program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates of this programme are able to work in organizations and Ministry of Health Hospitals, Social Security, and other governmental organizations, health departments, training and research hospitals and medical centers Assessment and Grading Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term exam, quiz, practice, project, report and final are used for the evaluation of students For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table.
