fields.title: Program Hakkında – Opticianry
fields.content: Opticianry - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 50 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Optician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Opticianry Program is to raise health technicians who are able to choose optic devices, prepare them in the specified standards and ensure the adaptation of the patient, as prescribed by ophthalmologists for eliminating or alleviating visual disturbances of the patients with refractor defect. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Within the program, students are given practical basic skills training in the Opticianry Laboratory equipped with modern machinery and devices as well as theoretical education. In addition, students are given training in the applications they will encounter in post-graduate work fields and business training. Students gain experience in practice by performing compulsory summer internships for 25 days at optical stores at the end of the first year. In addition to the practices in Opticianry Laboratory in the second year of the program, there are hospital practices in the program where students can work individually with ophthalmologists at the Eye Polyclinics of Acıbadem Healthcare Group hospitals. PROG. Director Lecturer, Phd. Neslihan Sinim Kahraman Program Consultant Instructor Seda Kın Barka History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, Opticianry Programme has been admitting students since 2015-2016 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree, receive the title of Health Technician-Optician. Admission Requirements Our programme admits students according to the results of YKS and TYT that are conducted by OSYM. Higher Grade Transition Graduates, by taking vertical transfer exam (DGS) determined by OSYM, have a right to register for Physics, physics engineering, optical and acoustic engineeringundergraduate programmes. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In the operating room Services Program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our students who graduate from this program can open, operate an optician institution or be responsible directors in optical stores. It will be able to be a technician in optical stores and companies that produce optical lenses, it will be able to make focometer measurements of glasses in outpatient eye clinics and outpatient services of ophthalmologists. Assessment and Grading Various assessment and evaluation methods are used for evaluating students, such as decals, quizzes, practical, projects, assignments and finals. For graduation, the overall GPA in the program is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=33

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Oral and Dental Health
fields.content: Oral and Dental Health - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 50 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Oral and Dental Health Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme Oral and Dental Health Program raises health technicians to support dentists in all clinical studies in dental clinics. Oral and dental health technicians prepare the working environment for the dentist, admits patients and help the dentist and patient during treatment. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Oral and Dental Health Program students are provided with practical training in mouth and dental health clinics of Acıbadem Healthcare Group hospitals as well as theoretical education. Program students gain experience in their field by undertaking compulsory summer internships at Acıbadem Healthcare Group hospitals and other healthcare facilities are in cooperation with the university. PROG. Director Instructor Dr. Hatice Ağan Program Consultant Expert Instructor Mine KARAYAMAN History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, oral and Dental Health Programstarted admitting students in 2015-2016 academic year. The aim of the program is to train health technicians who assist in all clinical studies of the dentist as the clinical assistant of the dentist in dental outpatient clinics. Prepares the working environment for dentists, dental technicians, and physician and patient during treatment, admit the patient and help the clinician. The aim of the oral and dental health technician programme is to train students who are respected, qualified, modern and who have reached the international level of knowledge in the field of dental health which is preferred in the public and private sectors to meet the need for decommissioned staff in our country. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two-year education and graduated with an associate degree take the title of Oral and Dental Health Technician. Admission Requirements Oral and Dental Health Programme admits students according to the basic proficiency test (TYT-score) score taken from the Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by the placement center (OSYM). Higher Grade Transition If the students who have successfully completed the program are successful in the vertical transfer examination (DGS) conducted by OSYM, they can transfer to the undergraduate programs of Rescue and Disaster Management Department, Nursing, Health Administration, Social Services. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In oral and Dental Health Program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates are able to work as an assistant in public and private institutions. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”prepared by the related lecturers and included in the information package. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Oral and Dental Health (Evening Education)
fields.content: Oral and Dental Health (Evening Education) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 26 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Oral and Dental Health Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme Oral and Dental Health Program raises health technicians to support dentists in all clinical studies in dental clinics. Oral and dental health technicians prepare the working environment for the dentist, admits patients and help the dentist and patient during treatment. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Oral and Dental Health Program students are provided with practical training in mouth and dental health clinics of Acıbadem Healthcare Group hospitals as well as theoretical education. Program students gain experience in their field by undertaking compulsory summer internships at Acıbadem Healthcare Group hospitals and other healthcare facilities are in cooperation with the university. Program Başkanı Dr. Hatice Ağan Program Consultant Expert Instructor Mine Karayaman History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, oral and Dental Health Programstarted admitting students in 2015-2016 academic year. The aim of the program is to train health technicians who assist in all clinical studies of the dentist as the clinical assistant of the dentist in dental outpatient clinics. Prepares the working environment for dentists, dental technicians, and physician and patient during treatment, admit the patient and help the clinician. The aim of the oral and dental health technician programme is to train students who are respected, qualified, modern and who have reached the international level of knowledge in the field of dental health which is preferred in the public and private sectors to meet the need for decommissioned staff in our country. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two-year education and graduated with an associate degree take the title of Oral and Dental Health Technician. Admission Requirements Oral and Dental Health Programme admits students according to the basic proficiency test (TYT-score) score taken from the Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by the placement center (OSYM). Higher Grade Transition If the students who have successfully completed the program are successful in the vertical transfer examination (DGS) conducted by OSYM, they can transfer to the undergraduate programs of Rescue and Disaster Management Department, Nursing, Health Administration, Social Services. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In oral and Dental Health Program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates are able to work as an assistant in public and private institutions. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”prepared by the related lecturers and included in the information package. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Orthopedic Prosthetics and Orthotics
fields.content: Orthopedic Prosthetics and Orthotics - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 24 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Orthopedic Prosthesis and Orthosis Technician - Medical Prosthesis and Orthosis Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Orthopedic Prosthetics and Orthotics Program is to raise health technicians who are able to make aesthetic and functional prostheses for people who have lost their upper or lower extremities for various reasons, and again to make supportive, aesthetic and functional orthotics to replace the functions for people who have lost their neck, trunk, arm and leg functions. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. In the program, practical trainings are carried out in Prosthetics-Orthotics Laboratory along with theoretical knowledge. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. PROG. Director Lecturer, Phd. Mustafa Sungur Program Consultant Expert Instructor Erkan Evrendilek History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, Orthotics and Prosthetics Programme has been admitting students since 2015-2016 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree, receive the title of Health Technician-Orthotics and Prosthetics technician. Admission Requirements Our programme admits students according to the results of YKS and TYT that are conducted by OSYM. Higher Grade Transition Graduates, by taking vertical transfer exam (DGS) determined by OSYM, have a right to register for Orthotics and Prosthetics, Biomedical Engineering, Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Programmes. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the programme and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In the Programme, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00 and are required to complete 30 work-day internships successfully. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates with the title of health technician are able to work in Polyclinic, prosthetic orthotic construction and application workshop, orthopedics clinic and plaster room of public and private in/out patient institutions and institutions affiliated to the Ministry of Health. According to the Public Personnel Selection Examination (KPSS), they can be appointed as a health technician (medical prosthetics and Orthotics technician). They may also open their own “Special prosthetic orthotic production and Application Centers” and “Medical Device Sales Centers” or work there. Assessment and Grading In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In the Programme, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00 and are required to complete 30 work-days. internships successfully. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=37

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Pathology Laboratory Techniques
fields.content: Pathology Laboratory Techniques - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 41 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Pathology Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Pathology Laboratory Techniques Program is to educate pathology technicians, who are able to apply methods and techniques required in the diagnosis of diseased cells and tissues, with high level of knowledge, skill and dynamism. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. In the program, practical trainings are carried out in Advanced Pathology Laboratory along with theoretical knowledge. Program trains students in such a way that they can fully apply any pathology technique. Thus, students can easily adapt to the pathology laboratories at which they will work after graduation. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. The students who graduate from the program assume the title of “Pathology Technician” and work as a team with pathology physicians. Program Başkanı Associate Prof. Dr. Davut Şahin Program Consultant Instructor Gülsün Ekicioğlu History The pathology laboratory techniques program started education and training with 24 students in the 2009-2010 academic year. In the 2014-2015 academic year, it started recruiting students to secondary education. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree are awarded the title of Health Technician - Pathology technician. Admission Requirements Pathology Laboratory Techniques Programme; submits the students according to the result of the basic proficiency test (TYT-score) obtained from the Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by (ÖSYM). Higher Grade Transition If those who successfully complete the program are successful in the Vertical Transfer Exam (DGS) conducted by ÖSYM; Emergency and Disaster Management, Biology, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, Genetics and Bioengineering, Nursing, Molecular Biology and Genetics, Health Management, undergraduate programs can transfer vertically. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In pathology laboratory techniques program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can work in Pathology Laboratories of public and private hospitals, private pathology laboratories, histology laboratories of the Faculty of Medicine and Forensic Medicine Institution, and Molecular Pathology Laboratories. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”prepared by the related lecturers and included in the information package. Related articles of Acıbadem University Associate Degree, Bachelor's Degree Education and Examination Regulations are applied regarding exams and final grades of the related course https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=38

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Pathology Laboratory Techniques (Evening Education)
fields.content: Pathology Laboratory Techniques (Evening Education) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 24 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Pathology Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Pathology Laboratory Techniques Program is to educate pathology technicians, who are able to apply methods and techniques required in the diagnosis of diseased cells and tissues, with high level of knowledge, skill and dynamism. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. In the program, practical trainings are carried out in Advanced Pathology Laboratory along with theoretical knowledge. Program trains students in such a way that they can fully apply any pathology technique. Thus, students can easily adapt to the pathology laboratories at which they will work after graduation. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. The students who graduate from the program assume the title of “Pathology Technician” and work as a team with pathology physicians. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Ümit İnce Program Consultant Instructor Gülsün Ekicioğlu History The pathology laboratory techniques program started education and training with 24 students in the 2009-2010 academic year. In the 2014-2015 academic year, it started recruiting students to secondary education. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree are awarded the title of Health Technician - Pathology technician. Admission Requirements Pathology Laboratory Techniques Programme; submits the students according to the result of the basic proficiency test (TYT-score) obtained from the Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by (ÖSYM). Higher Grade Transition If those who successfully complete the program are successful in the Vertical Transfer Exam (DGS) conducted by ÖSYM; Emergency and Disaster Management, Biology, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, Genetics and Bioengineering, Nursing, Molecular Biology and Genetics, Health Management, undergraduate programs can transfer vertically. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In pathology laboratory techniques program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can work in Pathology Laboratories of public and private hospitals, private pathology laboratories, histology laboratories of the Faculty of Medicine and Forensic Medicine Institution, and Molecular Pathology Laboratories. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”prepared by the related lecturers and included in the information package. Related articles of Acıbadem University Associate Degree, Bachelor's Degree Education and Examination Regulations are applied regarding exams and final grades of the related course https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=39

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Physiotherapy
fields.content: Physiotherapy - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 44 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Physiotherapy Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The 'physiotherapy' program, opened within the scope of Acıbadem University Health Services Vocational School, is a 2-year associate degree program prepared for this purpose. according to the diagnosis and treatment program of the specialist physician; To train Physiotherapy technicians, who are highly competent, equipped in terms of knowledge, to help individuals who are injured for any reason under the supervision of a physiotherapist, to provide the necessary physical therapy and rehabilitation program. Physiotherapy technicians are health personnel who help patients to provide safe, effective and quality health care in physical therapy and exercise practices under the supervision of specialist physicians and physiotherapists. The need for physical therapy and rehabilitation services increases in order to prevent functional disorders from becoming permanent after all kinds of injuries that cause movement disorders and to increase the quality of life of the person. In the success of the treatments in this field, it is of great importance that the practice under the coordination and supervision of the Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation specialist is carried out by the well-trained assistant health personnel "Physiotherapy Technician". Program Consultant Instructor Merve Sevik Dönderici History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, Physiotherapy program accepts students from 2020-2021 academic year. Qualification Awarded Associate's Degree Admission Requirements Physiotherapy program admits students according to the result obtained from Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS), TYT score conducted by measurement, selection and Placement Center (ÖSYM) Higher Grade Transition If those who have successfully completed the program succeed in the vertical transition exam (DGS) conducted by OSYM; They can transfer vertically to undergraduate programs in physiotherapy and Rehabilitation, Nursing, Nursing and Health Services, Health Management, Emergency and Disaster Management. Graduation Requirements In order for a student to graduate, they must have completed all their courses in the program and not have a grade of FF, FG, NA and U. In the physiotherapy program, the student must complete 120 ECTS and have an overall weighted GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can work in public hospitals, University research hospitals, private health institutions, sports centers, nursing homes, prosthetic-orthotic production and rehabilitation centers, Spa/thermal/SPA facilities and home care centers affiliated with the Ministry of Health. Assessment and Grading The assessment and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course Learning Plan”prepared by the relevant lecturers and included in the information package. Various measurement and evaluation methods are used for evaluating students, such as decals, quizzes, practical, seminars and finals. For graduation, the overall GPA in the program is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6109

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Podology
fields.content: Podology - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 44 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Podology Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Podology (Foot Health) Program is to raise health technicians with necessary knowledge and skills to protect foot health in cooperation with the physicians and to prevent diseases that may occur accordingly, by providing awareness for foot health and its protection. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. In the program, practical trainings are carried out in Podology Laboratory along with theoretical knowledge. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in hospitals, sports medicine centers and nursing centers of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and in podology units of diabetes hospitals and in other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Program Consultant Instructor Birce Buturak Küçük History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, Podology programme started admitting students in 2014-2015 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree are awarded the title of Health Technician-Podology technician. Admission Requirements Podology Program; admits the student saccording the results of the basic proficiency test (TYT-score) score obtained by the Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by OSYM. Higher Grade Transition Those who have completed the program successfully can transfer to emergency and disaster management, physiotherapy and rehabilitation program can transfer to a bachelor's in nursing and health care management. if they are successful in The Vertical transfer exam made by OSYM (DGS) Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In podology program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our Graduates can work in podoloji units, hospitals, medical centers, foot health centers, sports centers, in hospitals, diabetes, obesity, centers, physician offices, elderly care homes. Assessment and Grading Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term exam, quiz, practice, project, report and final are used for the evaluation of students For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Podology (Evening Education)
fields.content: Podology (Evening Education) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 26 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Podology Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme The aim of Podology (Foot Health) Program is to raise health technicians with necessary knowledge and skills to protect foot health in cooperation with the physicians and to prevent diseases that may occur accordingly, by providing awareness for foot health and its protection. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. In the program, practical trainings are carried out in Podology Laboratory along with theoretical knowledge. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with internships in hospitals, sports medicine centers and nursing centers of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and in podology units of diabetes hospitals and in other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Program Consultant Instructor Birce Buturak Küçük History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, Podology programme started admitting students in 2014-2015 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree are awarded the title of Health Technician-Podology technician. Admission Requirements Podology Program; admits the student saccording the results of the basic proficiency test (TYT-score) score obtained by the Higher Education Institutions Examination (YKS) conducted by OSYM. Higher Grade Transition Those who have completed the program successfully can transfer to emergency and disaster management, physiotherapy and rehabilitation program can transfer to a bachelor's in nursing and health care management. if they are successful in The Vertical transfer exam made by OSYM (DGS) Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. In podology program, students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can work in podoloji units, hospitals, medical centers, foot health centers, sports centers, in hospitals, diabetes, obesity, centers, physician offices, elderly care homes. Assessment and Grading Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term exam, quiz, practice, project, report and final are used for the evaluation of students For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Radiotherapy
fields.content: Radiotherapy - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 4 Program Quota 37 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Radiotherapy Technician ÖSYM type TYT About Programme Radiotherapy is a local treatment method used with surgical and systemic treatments in the treatment of cancer. Radiotherapy application is a very important field that requires intensive cooperation of radiation oncology doctors, medical physics specialists, radiotherapy technicians and nurses. The aim of Radiotherapy Program is to train health technicians who will take part in this team. The program has a 2-year education period and the education language is Turkish. Program students gain pre-graduate professional experience with applied practices and internships in the hospitals of Acıbadem Healthcare Group and other health institutions which are in cooperation with the university. Program Başkanı Prof. Dr. Enis Özyar Program Consultant Instructor Özlem Göksel History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Vocational School of Health Services, Radiotherapy Programme has been admitting students since 2009-2010 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who have completed their two - year education and graduated with an associate degree, receive the title of Health Technician-Radiotherapy Technician. Admission Requirements Our programme admits students according to the results of YKS and TYT that are conducted by OSYM. Higher Grade Transition Graduates, by taking vertical transfer exam (DGS) have a right to register for Emergency Relief and Disaster Management, Nursing, Healthcare Management undergraduate programmes. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, the student must have accomplished all the courses in the program and not have the grades of FF, FG, NA and U. , Students must complete 120 ECTS and have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can work as radiotherapy technicians in radiation oncology departments of government or private hospitals and outpatient treatment centers serving in the field of Health. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”prepared by the related lecturers and included in the information package. Related articles of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Associate Degree, Undergraduate Education and Examination Regulations are applied regarding exams and Course Success grades. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=42

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Molecular Biology and Genetics (English)
fields.content: Molecular Biology and Genetics (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 40 Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree Molecular Biologist and Geneticist ÖSYM type SAY About Programme The branch of Molecular Biology and Genetics has emerged as a result of the advances made particularly in the fields of genetics, biochemistry and cell biology. It is one of the fastest growing branches of science of the century and is frequently referenced. For centuries, mankind has been interested in living beings and has conducted research into how they are born, how they live and how they reproduce. The completion of the Human Genome Project and the subsequent rapid advances made in various disciplines has led to the accumulation of knowledge becoming a driving force in many sectors including healthcare, the environment, agriculture, stockbreeding and energy. All modern biotechnological products have been developed on the basis of knowledge generated by molecular biology and genetic engineering practices. Students are offered inter-disciplinary observation, research and practice opportunities thanks to the “Acıbadem Healthcare Group” companies, which are leaders in the healthcare sector in Turkey, the school of medicine, the vocational school of higher education, hospitals as well as its developed clinical laboratories including genetic, molecular genetics, biochemistry, microbiology, and stem cell laboratories. Thanks to the driving force of this science, the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics is an important starting point for students who are to be trained to become scientists who invent and research, develop and apply. Qualified specialists in the field of Molecular Biology and Genetics in Turkey are limited in number. In a world which is global in its approach to science, the department is committed to training researchers who aim to be a part of inter-university information and collaboration. With this aim, we support international student exchange programs and study opportunities and experiences overseas and encourage students to participate in national and international congresses. Students are also encouraged to enroll in post-graduate programs at leading universities in the US and Europe which will assist in contributing to the training of scientists (researchers with a PhD) needed by Turkey. The opening of the “Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics” at our university will serve to increase Turkey’s international recognition and its knowledge in this field. The department will also contribute to bridge the human resource gap for competent, qualified people in the national healthcare sector. The distinctive feature of the department is that in addition to the opportunities for scientific research, it predominantly supports the facilities of clinical practices therefore enabling students to benefit from the facilities of both Acıbadem University and Acıbadem Healthcare Group. The state of the art laboratory facilities and physical infrastructure enables us to conduct prominent research at a global level, particularly in the field of healthcare. Students who complete their education will be qualified to work as researchers in corporations and private institutions such as universities and research centers. They will be competent to work in diagnosis and treatment centers of genetic diseases and schools of medicine as well as fields which require biotechnology such as food and agriculture, and many laboratories including transgenic animal breeding. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Mehmet Batu ERMAN History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Faculty of Arts and Sciences Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics was established in 2013. Education is provided at Kerem Aydınlar campus, one of the most advanced basic sciences research campuses in Turkey. Turkish English language education was started in the 2013-2014 academic year and the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics has started its education in English language education as of the 2015-2016 academic year. The duration of education is 4 years, except for the English preparatory class. Students who have sufficient English level can start their first year of Education directly. English language proficiency is determined by the Foreign Language proficiency exam (AYES) administered by the foreign languages coordinator of the University or by equivalent National/International Examinations. The Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics aims to educate the world's leading scientists who have a strong teamwork spirit, think, question, Think, Research and contribute to production in order to keep up with the rapidly changing and regenerating age of Science and Technology. Molecular Biology and Genetics students are able to do the world's leading studies in the field of health, especially in the journey from laboratory to clinic, thanks to the highly modern and equipped research laboratory facilities and physical infrastructure. The most important feature that distinguishes our department from the like is that it focuses on clinical applications as well as basic science research and in doing so, our students can benefit from the facilities of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University and Acıbadem Health Group. In our country, which is one of the leading groups in the field of Health "Acıbadem Healthcare Group" companies, school of medicine, vocational schools, hospitals and advanced technologies that are used for genetic, molecular genetics, biochemistry, microbiology, clinical laboratories such as advanced stem cell laboratories thanks to our students through interdisciplinary observation, research and application possibilities. Qualification Awarded After 4 years of education, graduates receive a bachelor's degree in Molecular Biology and Genetics. Degree Level: Bachelor's Degree Admission Requirements It is necessary to have completed secondary education or received an equivalent education abroad and to have obtained the score of the Molecular Biology and Genetics Program (English) in the National University Selection Examination (OSYM) for that year. English language proficiency is determined by the Foreign Language proficiency exam (AYES) administered by the foreign languages coordinator of the University. In AYES, the base achievement rating is 70%. National and international exams equivalent to AYES and the minimum scores to be taken for exemption from them are determined by the Senate of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University over one hundred full points. Acıbadem University Mehmet Ali intellectuals from other parts of and abroad-abroad at the University of Acibadem, Mehmet Ali intellectuals from other universities Department of Molecular Biology and genetics, published in the Official Gazette 24/4/2010 dated and 27561 “higher education institutions undergraduate and graduate level programs, switching between Double Major, Minor, credit transfer between institutions with regulations required to be made” in accordance with the provisions of the transfer can be made to and determined by the Senate. The board of Directors decides the transfer and course exemptions. Inter-institutional and inter-institutional horizontal transfers are carried out in the fall semester. Transfers to be made between universities included in the European Credit Transfer System and transfer of courses are made within the framework of the principles determined by the Higher Education Council and other relevant legislation provisions. Higher Grade Transition European Higher Education Area Qualifications Framework (EAP): 2 EAP(European Qualifications Framework) - ICO (lifelong learning) (EAP-ICO): 7 Graduation Requirements In order to obtain the undergraduate degree in Molecular Biology and Genetics, the student must have completed at least 240 ECTS (140 national credits), succeeded all the courses, do not have FF, FG, NA and U grades and 4.00 according to the Undergraduate-Education and Training regulations. In the grade system, it is required to have a general academic average of at least 2.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates The graduates of the Department of Molecular Biology and genetics can work as researchers in our department and at other universities in Turkey and abroad as well as in legal and private institutions such as universities and research centers. They can work in medical schools such as diagnosis and treatment centers of genetic diseases and in the health sector as experienced staff in areas requiring biotechnology such as food and agriculture. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”. Related articles of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University's regulations for Associate Degree, undergraduate education and examination are applied in relation to exams and Course Success grades. Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term exam, quiz, application, project, report, and final are used for the evaluation of students Dec. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Psychology
fields.content: Psychology - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 60 Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree Psychologist ÖSYM type EA About Programme The scientific study of psychology contributes to society in a variety of ways and touches and enriches our lives at different levels. The knowledge on which psychology is based is important for modern society. There is always a need for psychologists whether it is to have a deep conceptual understanding of society; to increase productivity or employment security in a workplace; to evaluate and treat individuals who are suffering mental anguish; to research the effectiveness of subliminal messaging used in advertising; to increase the motivation and success of athletes or evaluate and rehabilitate individuals who are inclined to commit a crime; or to determine the cognitive function of individuals who have been injured in an accident. The scientific study of psychology examines mental, emotional and behavioral processes. There are many sub-branches of psychology including developmental psychology, experimental psychology, social psychology, clinical psychology, industrial and organizational psychology, health psychology, cognitive psychology, forensic psychology, neuropsychology, sports psychology, and traffic psychology. An individual who has been educated in the science of psychology needs also to possess knowledge regarding the fundamental fields of psychology, research and statistical information prior to practice. Later, psychology students can complete a postgraduate degree following their four-year education which will enable them to specialize in a field in which they are interested and in which they believe they will be successful. Other students may desire to do field work, or continue their studies to become researchers or academics. The Department of Psychology at Acıbadem University opened in the 2013-2014 academic year and has aimed to provide educational opportunities at the highest level to its students. With its strong conviction in ethical and scientific principles, academic staff who teach their specialist subjects as well as the physical structure, laboratories, library, and sports facilities offered to students in the heart of the city, combined with the academic opportunities provided by Acıbadem Hospitals, the department aims to set a benchmark for education. Head of Department Associate Prof. Dr. Olga Selin HÜNLER ÇİDAM History The Department of Psychology started education in Turkish with 50 students in 2013-2014 academic year. 35 out of 50 students enrolled in the department were the first graduates in 2017. In the second year, the quota increased to 60 and this number is still valid. The founding and retired faculty member of the department, Prof. Dr. İlyas Göz served as the head of the department from the beginning until 2015. Retired faculty member of the department Prof. Dr. Yeşim Korkut served as the head of the department between 2015-2017. Currently the head of the department Assoc. Dr. Belma Bekçi became the head of the department in 2017. Since its establishment, faculty members who have completed their doctorate degrees abroad and in the country have been included in the department. In 2015, Prof. Dr. Şeyda Türk, Prof. Dr. Yeşim Korkut, Assist. Prof. Esra Bal, Lecturer Melih Baybars, and Assist. Prof. Ayşenur Aktaş, in 2016, Assoc. Prof. Belma Bekçi, Assist. Prof. Şebnem Akan, and Res. Assist. Begüm Özbek; in 2018, Assist. Prof. Fatma Kahraman; in 2019, Assoc. Prof. Dr. Nilay Pekel Uludağlı and Res. Assist. Ece Yayla; in 2022, Assist. Prof. Bernis Sütçübaşı, Assist. Prof. Gamze Gültekin and Prof. Dr. Murat Kurt in 2022, Assist. Prof. Şafak Öz Aktepe and Res. Assist. Ülkü Gülbike Yumak in 2023, and Res. Assist. Ezgi Bostancı in 2024. Currently, educational and research activities in our department are carried out by 2 full-time Professors, 1 Associate Professor, 5 Assistant Professors, and 5 Research Assistants. From the Department of Psychology (English), Assoc. Prof. Esra Bal, Res. Asst. Kıvanç Konukoğlu and Res. Asst. Tuğrul Torun provide contribution to education activities. Qualification Awarded They receive a “bachelor's degree” in psychology. Degree Level: Bachelor's Degree Admission Requirements 1. To graduate from secondary education institutions or foreign secondary education institutions whose equivalence is approved by the Ministry of National Education and to meet the admission requirements for undergraduate programs of higher education institutions. 2. To be placed in the relevant undergraduate program of the higher education institution by having the (EA) score type qualification as a result of the central exam conducted by the Measurement, Selection and Placement Center (ÖSYM), whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK. 3. To have obtained sufficient points as a result of the central exam conducted by ÖSYM for the programs of higher education institutions that accept students with special aptitude exam, whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK, and to have succeeded in the special aptitude exam. 4. To be placed in undergraduate programs that are the continuation of the fields they have completed in higher education institutions for associate degree graduates as a result of the "Dikey Geçiş Sınavı" (DGS) conducted by ÖSYM, whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK. Higher Grade Transition Individuals who have the grade point average requirement determined by our university board can apply to graduate and doctorate programs if they are successful in exams such as ALES and ÜDS, and they can continue their specialization training at universities when they get enough points in the science and interview exams. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, students must have accomplished all his / her courses in the program and not have FF, FG, NA and U grades. In the Department of Psychology, the student must provide a minimum of 248 ECTS credits and the overall grade point average must be at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students who graduate from this program can work in public and private health institutions, educational institutions, businesses, nursing homes, rehabilitation centers and sports clubs. Assessment and Grading Various assessment and evaluation methods such as midterms, quizzes, applications, projects, reports, and finals are used to evaluate students. For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2.00 out of 4.00 in the program. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Psychology (English)
fields.content: Psychology (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 50 Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree Psychologist ÖSYM type EA About Programme The scientific study of psychology contributes to society in a variety of ways and touches and enriches our lives at different levels. The knowledge on which psychology is based is important for modern society. There is always a need for psychologists whether it is to have a deep conceptual understanding of society; to increase productivity or employment security in a workplace; to evaluate and treat individuals who are suffering mental anguish; to research the effectiveness of subliminal messaging used in advertising; to increase the motivation and success of athletes or evaluate and rehabilitate individuals who are inclined to commit a crime; or to determine the cognitive function of individuals who have been injured in an accident. The scientific study of psychology examines mental, emotional and behavioral processes. There are many sub-branches of psychology including developmental psychology, experimental psychology, social psychology, clinical psychology, industrial and organizational psychology, health psychology, cognitive psychology, forensic psychology, neuropsychology, sports psychology, and traffic psychology. An individual who has been educated in the science of psychology needs also to possess knowledge regarding the fundamental fields of psychology, research and statistical information prior to practice. Later, psychology students can complete a postgraduate degree following their four-year education which will enable them to specialize in a field in which they are interested and in which they believe they will be successful. Other students may desire to do field work, or continue their studies to become researchers or academics. The Department of Psychology at Acıbadem University opened in the 2013-2014 academic year and has aimed to provide educational opportunities at the highest level to its students. With its strong conviction in ethical and scientific principles, academic staff who teach their specialist subjects as well as the physical structure, laboratories, library, and sports facilities offered to students in the heart of the city, combined with the academic opportunities provided by Acıbadem Hospitals, the department aims to set a benchmark for education. PROG. Director Associate Prof. Dr. Olga Selin Hünler History The English Psychology Bachelor's Program, which opened in our department in 2019 and accepted its first students into the preparatory class in the 2020-2021 academic year, began its bachelor's education in 2021-2022. The program graduated its first students at the end of the spring semester of 2024-2025. Assist. Prof. Esra Bal, who has been supporting the program's faculty on a part-time basis since 2017, rejoined the program full-time in 2021 and was promoted to Associate Professor in 2025. Also joining the faculty in 2021 were Assoc. Prof. Dr. Olga Selin Hünler, Res. Asst. Kıvanç Konukoğlu and Res. Asst. Tuğrul Torun, in 2024 Assist. Prof. Dilan Çabuk Çolak and Assist. Prof. Ezgi Soncu Büyükişcan, and finally, in 2025, Assist. Prof. Sura Ertaş joined the faculty. Education and research activities in our department are currently carried out by 2 Associate Professors, 3 Assisstant Professors and 2 Research Assistants. Assoc. Prof. Dr. Olga Selin Hünler assumed the role of program chair in 2024. The program awarded its first graduates at the end of the 2024-2025 spring semester. From the Department of Psychology (Turkish), Prof. Dr. Şeyda Türk, Assist. Prof. Bernis Sütçübaşı, Assist. Prof. Şafak Öz Aktepe, Res. Asst. Ezgi Bostancı and Res. Asst. Ülkü Gülbike Yumak provide contribution to education activities. Qualification Awarded They receive a “bachelor's degree” in psychology. Degree Level: Bachelor's Degree Admission Requirements 1. To graduate from secondary education institutions or foreign secondary education institutions whose equivalence is approved by the Ministry of National Education and to meet the admission requirements for undergraduate programs of higher education institutions. 2. To be placed in the relevant undergraduate program of the higher education institution by having the (EA) score type qualification as a result of the central exam conducted by the Measurement, Selection and Placement Center (ÖSYM), whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK. 3. To have obtained sufficient points as a result of the central exam conducted by ÖSYM for the programs of higher education institutions that accept students with special aptitude exam, whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK, and to have succeeded in the special aptitude exam. 4. To be placed in undergraduate programs that are the continuation of the fields they have completed in higher education institutions for associate degree graduates as a result of the "Dikey Geçiş Sınavı" (DGS) conducted by ÖSYM, whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK. Higher Grade Transition Individuals who have the grade point average requirement determined by our university board can apply to graduate and doctorate programs if they are successful in exams such as ALES and ÜDS, and they can continue their specialization training at universities when they get enough points in the science and interview exams. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, students must have accomplished all his/her courses in the program and not have FF, FG, NA and U grades. In the Department of psychology, the student must provide a minimum of 240 ECTS credits and the overall grade point average must be at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students who graduate from this program can work in public and private health institutions, educational institutions, businesses, nursing homes, rehabilitation centers and sports clubs. Assessment and Grading Various assessment and evaluation methods such as midterms, quizzes, applications, projects, reports, and finals are used to evaluate students. For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2.00 out of 4.00 in the program. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Sociology
fields.content: Sociology - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 20 Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree Sociology Graduate ÖSYM type EA About Programme The Department of Sociology of the Faculty of Arts and Sciences at Acıbadem University opened in the 2016-2017 academic year. The course program is compatible with the sociology courses offered at other universities in Turkey and in Western countries. Much importance is placed on this compatibility in order for students, particularly post-graduate students, not to encounter any obstacles in their education. The program is taught in English which is advantageous for students who wish to participate in student exchange possibilities. Additionally, it helps students benefit from world literature and to undertake their post-graduate studies abroad should they wish to do so. Sociology is a member of the social sciences family. In order for students to truly grasp the concept of sociology, they need to be familiar with the relation between sociology and social sciences, the common and different ground, and the opportunities for collaboration. The department offers compulsory and elective lessons in all the fields of social sciences in order to meet this requirement. Each year, students are offered a comprehensive range of compulsory and elective lessons which guides research knowledge and experience. It is aimed for students to have a full comprehension of the methodology of social sciences, to learn research techniques and ethics, and to develop the conduct and skills required for field study. With the support of the academic staff, students are encouraged to carry out research in a variety of societal settings, to participate in congresses and similar events. Sociology education does not include a mandatory period of internship; however, voluntary internships for students to familiarize themselves with a variety of fields of work are encouraged and supported. It is highly regarded for students to explore the opportunities available to them while working as a sociologist particularly in health institutions, social work and non-profit organizations. A unique aspect of the department is that students are offered a wide range of elective courses and research opportunities in order for them to become fully acquainted with social sciences and, in particular, with health sociology. The field of health social sciences is an area of research and practice which has developed rapidly since the 1980s. Acıbadem University also supports the development of this field. It is desired for the students to take their place as young trailblazers in the development of the field in Turkey. Sociology education can be considered a process which increases sensitivity to social, cultural and humanitarian facts. This department is committed to training young people who are sensitive to the country in which they live, the world, who are knowledgeable, intellectual and responsible. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. İnci User ECTS and Erasmus Coordinator of the Department Lecturer, Phd. Ceren Gülser İlikan Rasimoğlu History The first students of the Sociology Department of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University started their studies in English preparatory class in 2016-2017. Qualification Awarded Students who complete four years of education in our department obtain a ‘bachelor's degree in sociology’. Admission Requirements For admission to the sociology department, it is necessary to have completed secondary education or received an equivalent education abroad and to be eligible for the field proficiency test (ayt) Equal Weight (EA) score type qualification conducted by the Student Selection and Placement Center (OSYM). Higher Grade Transition Individuals who have the grade point average requirement determined by our university, ales and foreign language exams if they are successful in the master's and doctoral programs opened can hit head. Since various programs in Turkey and abroad have been taken into account in the preparation of the departmental curriculum, they will have a high chance of being accepted. Master's and doctoral degrees can bring privilege to students in business life as well as enable those who wish and have success to continue their academic career. Graduation Requirements Students who graduate from sociology must have passed all courses in the undergraduate program (FF, FG, NA and U grades are not available), have completed the total ECTS credits of the curriculum they follow, and have a minimum GPA of 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Undergraduate education in sociology gives students comprehensive and versatile knowledge of people, society and culture. The options of the students who have a sociology license in their working life can be to work in research institutions (public and market research, social and Demographic Research), social service organizations, health organizations, communication fields such as press and publications or public relations, to turn to teaching or academic career. Graduates can also further expand their fields by pursuing a master's degree in any field of social, humanities or administrative sciences. If they want to change fields, they can turn to managerial jobs or sectors such as banking and insurance. In recent years, in business life, Advertising, Marketing, Human Resources Management and professional NGO management areas such as sociology graduates can choose. In addition, sociologist staff can be opened in local administrations, state-affiliated institutions (such as courthouses, housing estates, prisons). It is expected that the demand for sociology graduates will increase as sociology is a relatively new concept in our country, where sociology is not only an academic field but can also benefit for application purposes. Assessment and Grading The assessment and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course teaching plan”. Related articles of Acıbadem University's Associate Degree, undergraduate education and examination regulations are applied in relation to exams and Course Success grades. In addition to semester and end-of-term exams, homework, term paper, classroom practice, report and evaluation methods are used for the evaluation of the students and which of these are to be used in each course will be notified in advance. The overall grade point average in the program for graduation is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. fields.content: Computer Engineering (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 50 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Computer Engineer ÖSYM type SAY About Programme Our undergraduate education is centered on Data Science and AI. In the first two years, our students advance their programming (two courses) and algorithms (two courses) skills. In addition, they complete their natural sciences courses. There are four courses to deepen and strengthen the core Data Science and AI skillset. These courses are Exploratory Data Analysis, Data Systems, Cluster Computing, and Data Science & AI. The pillars of Computer Science and Engineering technical education is provided through Computer Architecture, Software, Computer & Social Networks, and Operating Systems courses. The mathematics courses to solidify theoretical understanding of Data Science and AI are Discrete Mathematics, Linear Algebra, Differential Equations, Statistics, and Optimization. These courses are offered mostly in the 2nd year, including the 3rd year as well. Distributed evenly in the 4-year program, project management, technology innovation, engineering ethics, professional enrichment, and humanities in science courses are key drivers both for broadening the horizon and for building the social skills of our students. In the final year, there are four technical electives and two senior design courses. The technical electives pool include data visualization, data engineering, micro services, mobile programming, big data analysis, social networks, health informatics, natural language processing, machine learning, and deep learning. Our modus operandi is to execute a Technical Business School. Our students will find an environment awash with business problems, business needs, and business data. They are expected to solve business problems, to analyze core business data, and to focus on delivering business value through algorithms, systems, and product development. This modus operandi is key to internalize and to materialize theoretical foundation with practical experience. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Ahmet Bulut History The Department of Computer Engineering at Acıbadem University is established in April 2021. The department starts its educational program in the 2021-2022 academic year. The department’s education and research program is centered around data science and artificial intelligence. Qualification Awarded Students receive a "Computer Engineering" degree and an undergraduate diploma upon graduation after 4 years of education. Admission Requirements For the enterance to Computer Engineering Department, accomplishment of Turkish high school education or having an equivalent education in a foreign country is required. For the lateral transfer, when the students apply from the higher education programms within and out of our country according to the regulations determined by the YÖK, credit and grade transfers are assessed by the department and presented for the acceptance of faculty management committee,and decided. Higher Grade Transition When someone fullfill the average grade requirement which is determined by the university management committee, if he/she succeeded in ALES, ÜDS exams, he/she can apply to master and doctorate programms, and after taking a sufficient score point in the scientific and oral-interview exams, they may get the chance to continue an academic career in universities. Graduation Requirements For a student in order to be able to graduate from Computer Engineering Department, he/she had to accomplish (by fullfilling all the requirements in) all the courses in the programm and must not have any FF, FG, NA and U grades. Student has to fulfill the minimum 240 ECTS credits requirement and general grade average must be minimum 2.00 over 4.00 at least, and ,in addition to that, every student must accomplish all the requirements included in the summer term internship regulations in summer at the end of second and third classes as 20+20 working days. Occupational Profiles of Graduates When someone fullfill the average grade requirement which is determined by the university management committee, if he/she succeeded in ALES, ÜDS exams, he/she can apply to master and doctorate programms, and after taking a sufficient score point in the scientific and oral-interview exams, they may get the chance to continue an academic career in universities. Assessment and Grading For the assessment of the students, assesments methodologies such as mid term, exams, quizes, practical applications, projects, reports and final exams etc is used. For graduation, the eneral average points should be minimum 2 over 4. Classes are pointed and given letters according to the following table. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Medical Engineering (English)
fields.content: Medical Engineering (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 36 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Medical Engineer ÖSYM type SAY About Programme Medical Engineering is an engineering branch that aims to develop, produce and efficiently use devices and biomaterials used for diagnosis, treatment and research purposes in order to solve the problems encountered in the field of health and meet their needs. Medical Engineering is an interdisciplinary field that allows working in cooperation with medicine, basic science and engineering fields such as biology, physics, chemistry, machinery, electrical electronics and computers. Our program aims to train effective Medical Engineers in the field with the support of its strong Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences staff, Clinical Simulation and Advanced Endoscopic-Robotic Surgery Training Center-CASE and its campus equipped with advanced technology. Although the Department of Medical Engineering mainly focuses on health, it serves the health sector in a wide variety of fields. From biomaterials to tissue engineering, from nanobiotechnology to bioengineering, from biotechnological medicine to molecular modeling, from the development of point of care diagnostic systems for the diagnosis of diseases with biosensor technologies, to targeted drug release systems, to the development of methods that can be used in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases by processing big health data with artificial intelligence technologies, medical imaging and image processing. It has a wide range of fields of study, from the development of technologies, from athlete health with biomechanical technologies to the development of physical therapy and rehabilitation applications by combining them with engineering applications. For this reason, we have created focus areas such as biomedical engineering, biomaterials, nanobiotechnology and clinical engineering by concentrating our elective courses in our project-oriented curriculum in these areas. In our clinical observation and innovation course, which we carry out completely in the form of practice, our students visit many different clinical departments, identify real-time clinical problems with their observations there, and present projects that will bring solutions to these problems. Our students, who have gained experience with such courses since the day they started the Medical Engineering Program, also specialize in different subjects with the rich elective courses they take in the focus areas I mentioned after creating a solid infrastructure with the basic engineering courses they take. Our students can do their summer internships in companies or hospitals that are suitable for their interests, as well as by being involved in the scientific studies of the faculty members. At the same time, they can get long or short-term internship opportunities in various sectors and fields in Acıbadem Healthcare Group companies. Here, they can do internships in various departments from R&D to quality in various health sectors, from clinical laboratories to biomedical departments to genetic diagnosis laboratories. We have a highly equipped, dynamic faculty staff with overseas experience. This valuable team continues its research in the Biomaterials Center and Nanobiotechnology Center spread over an area of 1500 m2 equipped with the state of the art technologies. Starting from the first grade, our students have the opportunity to participate in our work in these centers according to their interests. Our students working in our projects supported by TUBITAK, European Union and our University Research Funds can also take part in these projects as TUBITAK scholarship holders. Our students have the opportunity to do a minor and double major in Computer Engineering, Molecular Biology and Genetics, as well as Psychology, Sociology and Health Management Departments. This branch of engineering, whose main purpose is to produce technological solutions needed in the field of health, brings together academic sciences, clinical and industrial fields, is developing rapidly and the need for Medical Engineers to be employed is increasing day by day. We, too, follow our graduates closely and are proud of them every day, because they find job opportunities in world-renowned companies and universities, both in the academic and sector, in the country and abroad. The Medical Engineering Department works in direct cooperation with CASE. This center, which is a virtual hospital area, has medical simulators and many of the medical devices used in hospitals. Especially in recent years, since the design of smart materials, mathematical models and medical simulation systems have started to gain priority, the Department of Medical Engineering is a department that trains engineers who can design and produce by considering the solution of real problems in these fields. Our Bio-design Center, which was established with the support of the Ministry of Development and Istanbul Development Agency, is a center where both our students and all other researchers can implement their health-oriented innovative ideas and produce prototypes of the products they have developed. In the “Design for Medicine” hackathons we organize periodically in this center, nearly a hundred students from different universities and departments compete in the established interdisciplinary teams and gain a very special experience on the situations they will encounter in real life with the products they have developed in different fields. In addition, the maturation of new business ideas in the field of health, their transformation into products and their implementation are also possible in our Incubation Center within our university. Thus, our Medical Engineering Department students graduate as Medical Engineers who are prone to teamwork, with high ethical values and open to continuous learning, by experiencing both clinical and sectoral applications within the ecosystem that we have carefully designed since the day they first stepped into the department, taking part in multidisciplinary projects. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Özge Can History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Engineering Faculty, Medical Engineering Department has started education and teaching in 2014-2015 academic year. Medical Engineering is a branch of engineering which aims to develop, produce and use the instruments and biomaterials to solve the problems faced in health fields and to fulfill the diagnose, treatment and research needs by means of the engineering approaches. Medical Engineering is a multidiciplinary field that enables working in colloboration with biology, physics, chemistry, engineering fields such as mechanical, electrical and electronics and computer engineering together with medicine. Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, where the programm is in, together with its strong Medical Faculty and health sciences staff, medical center of advanced simulation and education (CASE), and its campus equiped with advanced technology, aims to bring up Medical Engineers effective in their field. This branch of engineering, having the main purpose of improvement of patients health and life quality, gathering academic sciences, clinics and industry fields, is improving fast and the necessity for the enrolled Medical Engineers is rising each day by day. Qualification Awarded Students receive a "Medical Engineering" degree and an undergraduate diploma upon graduation after 4 years of education. Admission Requirements For the acceptance to Medical Engineering Department, accomplishment of Turkish high school education or the equivalent education in a foreign country and having proficieny (in SAY) score type from the "Lisans Yerleştirme Sınavı" (LYS) by "Öğrenci Seçme ve Yerleştirme Merkezi" (ÖSYM) is required. Higher Grade Transition When someone fullfill the average grade requirement which is determined by the university management committee, if he/she succeeded in ALES, ÜDS exams, he/she can apply to master and doctorate programms, and after taking a sufficient score point in the scientific and oral-interview exams, they may get the chance to continue an academic career in universities. Graduation Requirements For a student in order to be able to graduate from Medical Engineering Department, he/she had to accomplish (by fullfilling all the requirements in) all the courses in the programm and must not have any FF, FG, NA and U grades. Student has to fulfill the minimum 240 ECTS credits requirement and general grade average must be minimum 2.00 over 4.00 at least, and ,in addition to that, every student must accomplish all the requirements included in the summer term internship regulations in summer at the end of second and third classes as 20+20 working days. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students graduated from this programm, may work in institutions and hospitals related to Ministry of Health, SGK, and other health units that are bound to public institutions, companies, private hospitals, besides the public and private institutions having research and development activities. In addition to these, they may work as a educational staff in the Medical Engineering departmetns of universities. Enterprise progresses in the field of medical technologies is possible as well. Assessment and Grading For the assessment of the students, assesments methodologies such as mid term, exams, quizes, practical applications, projects, reports and final exams etc is used. For graduation, the eneral average points should be minimum 2 over 4. Classes are pointed and given letters according to the following table.
