fields.title: Program Hakkında – Biomedical Engineering (English)
fields.content: Biomedical Engineering (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 36 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Medical Engineer ÖSYM type SAY About Programme Medical Engineering is an engineering branch that aims to develop, produce and efficiently use devices and biomaterials used for diagnosis, treatment and research purposes in order to solve the problems encountered in the field of health and meet their needs. Medical Engineering is an interdisciplinary field that allows working in cooperation with medicine, basic science and engineering fields such as biology, physics, chemistry, machinery, electrical electronics and computers. Our program aims to train effective Medical Engineers in the field with the support of its strong Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences staff, Clinical Simulation and Advanced Endoscopic-Robotic Surgery Training Center-CASE and its campus equipped with advanced technology. Although the Department of Medical Engineering mainly focuses on health, it serves the health sector in a wide variety of fields. From biomaterials to tissue engineering, from nanobiotechnology to bioengineering, from biotechnological medicine to molecular modeling, from the development of point of care diagnostic systems for the diagnosis of diseases with biosensor technologies, to targeted drug release systems, to the development of methods that can be used in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases by processing big health data with artificial intelligence technologies, medical imaging and image processing. It has a wide range of fields of study, from the development of technologies, from athlete health with biomechanical technologies to the development of physical therapy and rehabilitation applications by combining them with engineering applications. For this reason, we have created focus areas such as biomedical engineering, biomaterials, nanobiotechnology and clinical engineering by concentrating our elective courses in our project-oriented curriculum in these areas. In our clinical observation and innovation course, which we carry out completely in the form of practice, our students visit many different clinical departments, identify real-time clinical problems with their observations there, and present projects that will bring solutions to these problems. Our students, who have gained experience with such courses since the day they started the Medical Engineering Program, also specialize in different subjects with the rich elective courses they take in the focus areas I mentioned after creating a solid infrastructure with the basic engineering courses they take. Our students can do their summer internships in companies or hospitals that are suitable for their interests, as well as by being involved in the scientific studies of the faculty members. At the same time, they can get long or short-term internship opportunities in various sectors and fields in Acıbadem Healthcare Group companies. Here, they can do internships in various departments from R&D to quality in various health sectors, from clinical laboratories to biomedical departments to genetic diagnosis laboratories. We have a highly equipped, dynamic faculty staff with overseas experience. This valuable team continues its research in the Biomaterials Center and Nanobiotechnology Center spread over an area of 1500 m2 equipped with the state of the art technologies. Starting from the first grade, our students have the opportunity to participate in our work in these centers according to their interests. Our students working in our projects supported by TUBITAK, European Union and our University Research Funds can also take part in these projects as TUBITAK scholarship holders. Our students have the opportunity to do a minor and double major in Computer Engineering, Molecular Biology and Genetics, as well as Psychology, Sociology and Health Management Departments. This branch of engineering, whose main purpose is to produce technological solutions needed in the field of health, brings together academic sciences, clinical and industrial fields, is developing rapidly and the need for Medical Engineers to be employed is increasing day by day. We, too, follow our graduates closely and are proud of them every day, because they find job opportunities in world-renowned companies and universities, both in the academic and sector, in the country and abroad. The Medical Engineering Department works in direct cooperation with CASE. This center, which is a virtual hospital area, has medical simulators and many of the medical devices used in hospitals. Especially in recent years, since the design of smart materials, mathematical models and medical simulation systems have started to gain priority, the Department of Medical Engineering is a department that trains engineers who can design and produce by considering the solution of real problems in these fields. Our Bio-design Center, which was established with the support of the Ministry of Development and Istanbul Development Agency, is a center where both our students and all other researchers can implement their health-oriented innovative ideas and produce prototypes of the products they have developed. In the “Design for Medicine” hackathons we organize periodically in this center, nearly a hundred students from different universities and departments compete in the established interdisciplinary teams and gain a very special experience on the situations they will encounter in real life with the products they have developed in different fields. In addition, the maturation of new business ideas in the field of health, their transformation into products and their implementation are also possible in our Incubation Center within our university. Thus, our Medical Engineering Department students graduate as Medical Engineers who are prone to teamwork, with high ethical values and open to continuous learning, by experiencing both clinical and sectoral applications within the ecosystem that we have carefully designed since the day they first stepped into the department, taking part in multidisciplinary projects. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Özge CAN History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Engineering Faculty, Medical Engineering Department has started education and teaching in 2014-2015 academic year. As of 2022, it continues its education and training as the Faculty of Engineering and Natural Sciences, Department of Biomedical Engineering with its changing names. Biomedical Engineering is a branch of engineering which aims to develop, produce and use the instruments and biomaterials to solve the problems faced in health fields and to fulfill the diagnose, treatment and research needs by means of the engineering approaches. Biomedical Engineering is a multidiciplinary field that enables working in colloboration with biology, physics, chemistry, engineering fields such as mechanical, electrical and electronics and computer engineering together with medicine. Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, where the programm is in, together with its strong Medical Faculty and health sciences staff, medical center of advanced simulation and education (CASE), and its campus equiped with advanced technology, aims to bring up Medical Engineers effective in their field. This branch of engineering, having the main purpose of improvement of patients health and life quality, gathering academic sciences, clinics and industry fields, is improving fast and the necessity for the enrolled Medical Engineers is rising each day by day. Qualification Awarded Students receive a "Biomedical Engineering" degree and an undergraduate diploma upon graduation after 4 years of education. Admission Requirements For the acceptance to Biomedical Engineering Department, accomplishment of Turkish high school education or the equivalent education in a foreign country and having proficieny (in SAY) score type from the "Lisans Yerleştirme Sınavı" (LYS) by "Öğrenci Seçme ve Yerleştirme Merkezi" (ÖSYM) is required. Higher Grade Transition When someone fullfill the average grade requirement which is determined by the university management committee, if he/she succeeded in ALES, ÜDS exams, he/she can apply to master and doctorate programms, and after taking a sufficient score point in the scientific and oral-interview exams, they may get the chance to continue an academic career in universities. Graduation Requirements For a student in order to be able to graduate from Biomedical Engineering Department, he/she had to accomplish (by fullfilling all the requirements in) all the courses in the programm and must not have any FF, FG, NA and U grades. Student has to fulfill the minimum 240 ECTS credits requirement and general grade average must be minimum 2.00 over 4.00 at least, and ,in addition to that, every student must accomplish all the requirements included in the summer term internship regulations in summer at the end of second and third classes as 20+20 working days. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students graduated from this programm, may work in institutions and hospitals related to Ministry of Health, SGK, and other health units that are bound to public institutions, companies, private hospitals, besides the public and private institutions having research and development activities. In addition to these, they may work as a educational staff in the Biomedical Engineering departmetns of universities. Enterprise progresses in the field of medical technologies is possible as well. Assessment and Grading For the assessment of the students, assesments methodologies such as mid term, exams, quizes, practical applications, projects, reports and final exams etc is used. For graduation, the eneral average points should be minimum 2 over 4. Classes are pointed and given letters according to the following table. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Computer Engineering (English)
fields.content: Computer Engineering (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 61 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Computer Engineer ÖSYM type SAY About Programme Our undergraduate education is centered on Data Science and AI. In the first two years, our students advance their programming (two courses) and algorithms (two courses) skills. In addition, they complete their natural sciences courses. There are four courses to deepen and strengthen the core Data Science and AI skillset. These courses are Exploratory Data Analysis, Data Systems, Cluster Computing, and Data Science & AI. The pillars of Computer Science and Engineering technical education is provided through Computer Architecture, Software, Computer & Social Networks, and Operating Systems courses. The mathematics courses to solidify theoretical understanding of Data Science and AI are Discrete Mathematics, Linear Algebra, Differential Equations, Statistics, and Optimization. These courses are offered mostly in the 2nd year, including the 3rd year as well. Distributed evenly in the 4-year program, project management, technology innovation, engineering ethics, professional enrichment, and humanities in science courses are key drivers both for broadening the horizon and for building the social skills of our students. In the final year, there are four technical electives and two senior design courses. The technical electives pool include data visualization, data engineering, micro services, mobile programming, big data analysis, social networks, health informatics, natural language processing, machine learning, and deep learning. Our modus operandi is to execute a Technical Business School. Our students will find an environment awash with business problems, business needs, and business data. They are expected to solve business problems, to analyze core business data, and to focus on delivering business value through algorithms, systems, and product development. This modus operandi is key to internalize and to materialize theoretical foundation with practical experience. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Ahmet BULUT History The Department of Computer Engineering at Acıbadem University is established in April 2021. The department starts its educational program in the 2021-2022 academic year. The department’s education and research program is centered around data science and artificial intelligence. Qualification Awarded Students receive a "Computer Engineering" degree and an undergraduate diploma upon graduation after 4 years of education. Admission Requirements For the enterance to Computer Engineering Department, accomplishment of Turkish high school education or having an equivalent education in a foreign country is required. For the lateral transfer, when the students apply from the higher education programms within and out of our country according to the regulations determined by the YÖK, credit and grade transfers are assessed by the department and presented for the acceptance of faculty management committee,and decided. Higher Grade Transition When someone fullfill the average grade requirement which is determined by the university management committee, if he/she succeeded in ALES, ÜDS exams, he/she can apply to master and doctorate programms, and after taking a sufficient score point in the scientific and oral-interview exams, they may get the chance to continue an academic career in universities. Graduation Requirements For a student in order to be able to graduate from Computer Engineering Department, he/she had to accomplish (by fullfilling all the requirements in) all the courses in the programm and must not have any FF, FG, NA and U grades. Student has to fulfill the minimum 240 ECTS credits requirement and general grade average must be minimum 2.00 over 4.00 at least, and ,in addition to that, every student must accomplish all the requirements included in the summer term internship regulations in summer at the end of second and third classes as 20+20 working days. Occupational Profiles of Graduates When someone fullfill the average grade requirement which is determined by the university management committee, if he/she succeeded in ALES, ÜDS exams, he/she can apply to master and doctorate programms, and after taking a sufficient score point in the scientific and oral-interview exams, they may get the chance to continue an academic career in universities. Assessment and Grading For the assessment of the students, assesments methodologies such as mid term, exams, quizes, practical applications, projects, reports and final exams etc is used. For graduation, the eneral average points should be minimum 2 over 4. Classes are pointed and given letters according to the following table. AA 90-100 Outstanding 4.00 BA 85-89 Good-Outstanding 3.50 BB 80-84 good 3.00 CB 70-79 Average-Good 2.50 CC 60-69 Average 2.00 DC 55-59 Average-Poor 1.50 DD 50-54 Poor-Successful 1.00 FF 0-49 Poor-Fail 0.00 Failed FG semester/year-end exam 0.00 Na absent-fail 0.00 T - Transfer | S-Successful In Elective Non-Credit Course / U-Unsuccessful In Elective Non-Credit Course / W-Withdrawal From Course. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6246

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Molecular Biology and Genetics (English)
fields.content: Molecular Biology and Genetics (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 61 Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree Molecular Biologist and Geneticist ÖSYM type SAY About Programme The branch of Molecular Biology and Genetics has emerged as a result of the advances made particularly in the fields of genetics, biochemistry and cell biology. It is one of the fastest growing branches of science of the century and is frequently referenced. For centuries, mankind has been interested in living beings and has conducted research into how they are born, how they live and how they reproduce. The completion of the Human Genome Project and the subsequent rapid advances made in various disciplines has led to the accumulation of knowledge becoming a driving force in many sectors including healthcare, the environment, agriculture, stockbreeding and energy. All modern biotechnological products have been developed on the basis of knowledge generated by molecular biology and genetic engineering practices. Students are offered inter-disciplinary observation, research and practice opportunities thanks to the “Acıbadem Healthcare Group” companies, which are leaders in the healthcare sector in Turkey, the school of medicine, the vocational school of higher education, hospitals as well as its developed clinical laboratories including genetic, molecular genetics, biochemistry, microbiology, and stem cell laboratories. Thanks to the driving force of this science, the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics is an important starting point for students who are to be trained to become scientists who invent and research, develop and apply. Qualified specialists in the field of Molecular Biology and Genetics in Turkey are limited in number. In a world which is global in its approach to science, the department is committed to training researchers who aim to be a part of inter-university information and collaboration. With this aim, we support international student exchange programs and study opportunities and experiences overseas and encourage students to participate in national and international congresses. Students are also encouraged to enroll in post-graduate programs at leading universities in the US and Europe which will assist in contributing to the training of scientists (researchers with a PhD) needed by Turkey. The opening of the “Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics” at our university will serve to increase Turkey’s international recognition and its knowledge in this field. The department will also contribute to bridge the human resource gap for competent, qualified people in the national healthcare sector. The distinctive feature of the department is that in addition to the opportunities for scientific research, it predominantly supports the facilities of clinical practices therefore enabling students to benefit from the facilities of both Acıbadem University and Acıbadem Healthcare Group. The state of the art laboratory facilities and physical infrastructure enables us to conduct prominent research at a global level, particularly in the field of healthcare. Students who complete their education will be qualified to work as researchers in corporations and private institutions such as universities and research centers. They will be competent to work in diagnosis and treatment centers of genetic diseases and schools of medicine as well as fields which require biotechnology such as food and agriculture, and many laboratories including transgenic animal breeding. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Mehmet Batu ERMAN History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Faculty of Arts and Sciences Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics was established in 2013. Education is provided at Kerem Aydınlar campus, one of the most advanced basic sciences research campuses in Turkey. Turkish English language education was started in the 2013-2014 academic year and the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics has started its education in English language education as of the 2015-2016 academic year. The duration of education is 4 years, except for the English preparatory class. Students who have sufficient English level can start their first year of Education directly. English language proficiency is determined by the Foreign Language proficiency exam (AYES) administered by the foreign languages coordinator of the University or by equivalent National/International Examinations. The Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics aims to educate the world's leading scientists who have a strong teamwork spirit, think, question, Think, Research and contribute to production in order to keep up with the rapidly changing and regenerating age of Science and Technology. Molecular Biology and Genetics students are able to do the world's leading studies in the field of health, especially in the journey from laboratory to clinic, thanks to the highly modern and equipped research laboratory facilities and physical infrastructure. The most important feature that distinguishes our department from the like is that it focuses on clinical applications as well as basic science research and in doing so, our students can benefit from the facilities of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University and Acıbadem Health Group. In our country, which is one of the leading groups in the field of Health "Acıbadem Healthcare Group" companies, school of medicine, vocational schools, hospitals and advanced technologies that are used for genetic, molecular genetics, biochemistry, microbiology, clinical laboratories such as advanced stem cell laboratories thanks to our students through interdisciplinary observation, research and application possibilities. Qualification Awarded After 4 years of education, graduates receive a bachelor's degree in Molecular Biology and Genetics. Degree Level: Bachelor's Degree Admission Requirements It is necessary to have completed secondary education or received an equivalent education abroad and to have obtained the score of the Molecular Biology and Genetics Program (English) in the National University Selection Examination (OSYM) for that year. English language proficiency is determined by the Foreign Language proficiency exam (AYES) administered by the foreign languages coordinator of the University. In AYES, the base achievement rating is 70%. National and international exams equivalent to AYES and the minimum scores to be taken for exemption from them are determined by the Senate of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University over one hundred full points. Acıbadem University Mehmet Ali intellectuals from other parts of and abroad-abroad at the University of Acibadem, Mehmet Ali intellectuals from other universities Department of Molecular Biology and genetics, published in the Official Gazette 24/4/2010 dated and 27561 “higher education institutions undergraduate and graduate level programs, switching between Double Major, Minor, credit transfer between institutions with regulations required to be made” in accordance with the provisions of the transfer can be made to and determined by the Senate. The board of Directors decides the transfer and course exemptions. Inter-institutional and inter-institutional horizontal transfers are carried out in the fall semester. Transfers to be made between universities included in the European Credit Transfer System and transfer of courses are made within the framework of the principles determined by the Higher Education Council and other relevant legislation provisions. Higher Grade Transition European Higher Education Area Qualifications Framework (EAP): 2 EAP(European Qualifications Framework) - ICO (lifelong learning) (EAP-ICO): 7 Graduation Requirements In order to obtain the undergraduate degree in Molecular Biology and Genetics, the student must have completed at least 240 ECTS (140 national credits), succeeded all the courses, do not have FF, FG, NA and U grades and 4.00 according to the Undergraduate-Education and Training regulations. In the grade system, it is required to have a general academic average of at least 2.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates The graduates of the Department of Molecular Biology and genetics can work as researchers in our department and at other universities in Turkey and abroad as well as in legal and private institutions such as universities and research centers. They can work in medical schools such as diagnosis and treatment centers of genetic diseases and in the health sector as experienced staff in areas requiring biotechnology such as food and agriculture. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”. Related articles of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University's regulations for Associate Degree, undergraduate education and examination are applied in relation to exams and Course Success grades. Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term exam, quiz, application, project, report, and final are used for the evaluation of students Dec. For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2.00 out of 4.00. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6248

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Health Care Management
fields.content: Health Care Management - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 36 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Health Manager ÖSYM type EA About Programme Vision of the Department of Health Management To be the leading educational institution, providing education at modern standards with respected academic members of staff, which shapes the future of the healthcare system in Turkey through the people it trains and the knowledge it generates on a national and international level. Mission of the Department of Health Management To train “professional healthcare managers” who are innovative, inquisitive, competitive, and entrepreneurial and who have developed a lifelong learning skill. Fundamental Values of the Department of Health Management Adherence to universal values Being scientific Creativity Reliability Having team spirit The concept of hands on management Transparency Integrity The satisfaction of employees, students and other stakeholders PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Mesut ÇİMEN ECTS and Erasmus Coordinator of the Department Lecturer, Phd. Berna Eren History Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Faculty of Health Sciences, Department of Health Management started education and training in 2009-2010 academic year. The department consists of academicians specializing in the field of academic staff and who have served in management positions in the health sector for many years. The importance of professional health managers in health care enterprises with a complex structure, rapidly growing, many professional groups working together and having large budgets is increasing day by day. In recent years, both the expectations of public opinion regarding rational use of resources and patient satisfaction in our country and the regulations that increase competition in health sector have brought to the forefront the need for qualified personnel trained in health management. The Department of health management emphasizes the concept of education, which integrates theory with practice, the education program designed according to international standards in its field, the support it receives from Acibadem Health Group, and the opportunity to practice and train its students from the second grade within Acibadem health group. Qualification Awarded After 4 years of education, graduates receive bachelor's degree in “Health Management“. Admission Requirements The Department of Health Management receives students according to the type of the Equal Weight (EA) score obtained from the Higher Education Institutions exam (YKS) conducted by student selection and placement center (ÖSYM). Higher Grade Transition Graduates can apply to master's and/or doctoral programs in Health Management, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Public Administration, Human Resources Management, Quality Management, Marketing and international trade. Graduation Requirements Students have to pass all the courses in the program and must not have FF, FG, NA and U grades in order to graduate. In the Health Management Program, the student has to provide a minimum of 240 ECTS credits and a GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates serve as administrative, financial and technical managers in a wide range of services in various health institutions and institutions connected to the public and private sectors, especially hospitals. Graduates of the Department of Health Management can be employed in • hospitals (private/public/university hospitals) • Ministry of Health Center and affiliated Institutions • Universities and research institutions • rehabilitation centers • Home Care Institutions • consultancy firms • health insurance companies • Specialist Assistant, expert or manager in health sector such as pharmaceutical and medical supplies.; • Patient Care Management Services • Human Resources • Information Systems • Finance • Marketing • Material Management • Maintenance Management • Planning and business development • quality departments. Assessment and Grading A variety of measurement and evaluation methods are used for the evaluation of the students, such as midterm, quiz, practical, project, report, and final exam. For graduation, the cumulative grade point average is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=5

fields.content: Nursing - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 101 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Nurse ÖSYM type SAY About Programme Nursing is an applied discipline of healthcare which rests on a foundation of scientific knowledge. Individuals, family and society play a great role and have a multi-faceted responsibility in meeting fundamental requirements such as care, comfort, recuperation and enlightenment at each stage of life. Nursing practices in modern day primary care settings are based on the results of research. Nurses meet the needs of individuals, families and society by basing clinical decisions on their knowledge. In order for nursing care to be effective, reliable and sufficient, nursing practices must be monitored and evaluated critically and meticulously. This serves to emphasize that nursing training needs to be given in conjunction with theoretical nursing and contemporary methods of practice in keeping with the philosophical belief of the unique nature of mankind. The Department of Nursing of the Faculty of Health Sciences at Acıbadem University is committed to training qualified and competent manpower. Just as with all the education programs based on practice in other disciplines, theoretical knowledge and clinical experience are inseparable components which complement each other. The Kerem Aydınlar Campus is fully equipped with state of the art technology which supports the philosophy, vision, mission and educational values of nursing. Each student can apply their theoretical knowledge in simulation laboratories and equipment prior to undertaking practical education in university teaching hospitals. The Department of Nursing is committed to educating and training nurses who are capable of providing excellent international standards of care to patients/healthy individuals. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. ÜKKE KARABACAK History First student admission to Acibadem University Health Sciences Faculty Nursing Department was in 2009-2010 academic year, in accordance with our university’s mission and vision. Program’s first graduates were in 2012-2013 academic year. Qualification Awarded Undergraduate Nursing degree includes a 4 year education and graduates will be able to have “Bachelor Degree in Nursing”. Admission Requirements Final enrolment is carried out with the required documents within the time limits and in accordance with the principles laid down by the Council of Higher Education, the Presidency of the Centre for Assessment, Selection and Placement (ÖSYM) and the Rectorate. Higher Grade Transition The undergraduate nursing program lasts four years, and graduates receive a “Bachelor of Nursing” degree. Those who meet the required qualifications can pursue postgraduate studies in nursing specialties and some other fields. Graduates can work as clinical, occupational, or school health nurses, as well as educators, managers, and academicians, and have career opportunities in the Ministry of Health, research centers, and the pharmaceutical industry. Graduation Requirements According to the "Acıbadem University Associate and Undergraduate Education and Examination Regulations", in order to graduate from the undergraduate programme, students must successfully complete 240 ECTS credits and have a GPA of 2.0 or above out of 4.00. Nursing education consists of four years of theoretical and clinical training. To graduate from the undergraduate programme, students must successfully complete 240 ECTS credits and have a GPA of 2.0 or above. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates have employment opportunities at first, second and third level healthcare providing institutions and establishments for positions such as clinical nurse, nurse instructor, occupational health nurse, school health nurse, administrator and as academicians at universities’ nursing departments. Assessment and Grading Assessment and evaluation procedures are carried-out in accordance with university’s assessment and evaluation principles. Assessment and evaluation methods, that are used to evaluate students, are mid-term exams, practice, project, case reports and final exam. Principles about course passing, grade passing, course exemption, taking lower/upper grade courses are described in university-approved Acibadem University Associate and Undergraduate Education and Training and Examination By-law and announced on the website. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=3

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Nursing (English)
fields.content: Nursing (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 91 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Nurse ÖSYM type SAY About Programme Nursing is an applied discipline of healthcare which rests on a foundation of scientific knowledge. Individuals, family and society play a great role and have a multi-faceted responsibility in meeting fundamental requirements such as care, comfort, recuperation and enlightenment at each stage of life. Nursing practices in modern day primary care settings are based on the results of research. Nurses meet the needs of individuals, families and society by basing clinical decisions on their knowledge. In order for nursing care to be effective, reliable and sufficient, nursing practices must be monitored and evaluated critically and meticulously. This serves to emphasize that nursing training needs to be given in conjunction with theoretical nursing and contemporary methods of practice in keeping with the philosophical belief of the unique nature of mankind. The Department of Nursing of the Faculty of Health Sciences at Acıbadem University is committed to training qualified and competent manpower. Just as with all the education programs based on practice in other disciplines, theoretical knowledge and clinical experience are inseparable components which complement each other. The Kerem Aydınlar Campus is fully equipped with state of the art technology which supports the philosophy, vision, mission and educational values of nursing. Each student can apply their theoretical knowledge in simulation laboratories and equipment prior to undertaking practical education in university teaching hospitals. The Department of Nursing is committed to educating and training nurses who are capable of providing excellent international standards of care to patients/healthy individuals. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Ükke Karabacak History First student admission to Acibadem University Health Sciences Faculty Nursing Department was in 2009-2010 academic year, in accordance with our university’s mission and vision. Program’s first graduates were in 2012-2013 academic year. Qualification Awarded Undergraduate Nursing degree includes a 4 year education and graduates will be able to have “Bachelor Degree in Nursing”. Admission Requirements Final enrolment is carried out with the required documents within the time limits and in accordance with the principles laid down by the Council of Higher Education, the Presidency of the Centre for Assessment, Selection and Placement (ÖSYM) and the Rectorate. Higher Grade Transition The undergraduate nursing program lasts four years, and graduates receive a “Bachelor of Nursing” degree. Those who meet the required qualifications can pursue postgraduate studies in nursing specialties and some other fields. Graduates can work as clinical, occupational, or school health nurses, as well as educators, managers, and academicians, and have career opportunities in the Ministry of Health, research centers, and the pharmaceutical industry. Graduation Requirements According to the "Acıbadem University Associate and Undergraduate Education and Examination Regulations", in order to graduate from the undergraduate programme, students must successfully complete 240 ECTS credits and have a GPA of 2.0 or above out of 4.00. Nursing education consists of four years of theoretical and clinical training. To graduate from the undergraduate programme, students must successfully complete 240 ECTS credits and have a GPA of 2.0 or above. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates have employment opportunities at first, second and third level healthcare providing institutions and establishments for positions such as clinical nurse, nurse instructor, occupational health nurse, school health nurse, administrator and as academicians at universities’ nursing departments. Assessment and Grading Assessment and evaluation procedures are carried-out in accordance with university’s assessment and evaluation principles. Assessment and evaluation methods, that are used to evaluate students, are mid-term exams, practice, project, case reports and final exam. Principles about course passing, grade passing, course exemption, taking lower/upper grade courses are described in university-approved Acibadem University Associate and Undergraduate Education and Examination Regulation and announced on the website. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6108

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Nutrition and Dietetics
fields.content: Nutrition and Dietetics - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 37 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Dietitian ÖSYM type SAY About Programme This department is committed to training dietitians who are guided by science in the preservation, development and sustainability of health. Our graduates will be able to combine applied education and academics with theory in order to maintain the standards required for a healthy lifestyle. Our graduating dietitians will promote, sustain and renew healthy eating habits based on scientific studies on an individual, social and global level; will be guided by professional ethical regulations; will have a firm belief in team work and will be a qualified healthcare professional embracing preventive and curative practices. The goal of the department is to be a valued department of choice; to train graduates who are specialists in nutrition sciences and dietetics; to offer research and development; to be renowned on the national and international platforms for scientific studies and consultancies. Additionally, we aim to set benchmarks in the field of nutrition and dietetics through social research and publications as a part of preventive and curative healthcare services. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Murat Baş History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Department of Nutrition and Dietetics has been accepting students since 2013, with its first graduates in 2017. Qualification Awarded After four years of education, graduates who successfully complete the theoretical, practical and internship applications receive the title of "Dietitian" with a bachelor's degree in the field of "Nutrition and Dietetics". Organizing the plans and programs of individual and collective nutrition in line with the principles of nutrition science in order to protect and develop the health of all individuals throughout the life of dietitian, growth, development and increase the quality of life; researches, evaluates and finds solutions to health problems arising from nutrients, food and nutrition; medical and surgical treatments for congenital and acquired diseases and other special cases, which ensure the use of existing food resources in accordance with economic and health rules, control food, inform and raise awareness of the individual and society in order to adopt physiological, psychological and sociological healthy lifestyles on these issues. It is the field of health profession that plans, provides education, plans, implements and monitors diet programs according to the combination of appropriate, natural and therapeutic foods. Admission Requirements Nutrition and Dietetics Department admits students according to the type of points obtained from the higher education transition exam (YKS) conducted by Student Selection and Placement center (ÖSYM). Higher Grade Transition Graduates may apply to master's and/or doctoral programs in nutrition and Dietetics, Child Health, Nutrition and Internal Medicine, Public Health, Phytotherapy and Sports Sciences. Graduation Requirements In order for the student to graduate, he/she must have completed all the courses in the program and must not have FF, FG, NA and U grades. In the Nutrition and Dietetics Program, the student must provide a minimum of 240 ECTS credits and a GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. In the last year, students are required to do an internship for 4 days a week and for a total of 1200 hours in the fields of Nutrition and Dietetic Practices, medical nutrition therapy in adult and pediatric diseases, food services management, public health, sports nutrition and related fields and successfully complete the internships. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can be recruited in, mother and Child Health Centers, dialysis centers, out-patient clinics, etc. all health units, polyclinics of various public and private institutions, food and beverage enterprises, hotels, nursing homes, elderly care centers, nurseries and food industry, and/or as academicians in Nutrition and Dietetics departments in universities. Assessment and Grading A variety of measurement and evaluation methods are used for the evaluation of the students, such as midterm, quiz, practice, internship, project, report, and final exam. For graduation, the cumulative grade point average is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored and letter graded as shown in the table. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=4

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Nutrition and Dietetics (English)
fields.content: Nutrition and Dietetics (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 37 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Dietitian ÖSYM type SAY About Programme This department is committed to training dietitians who are guided by science in the preservation, development and sustainability of health. Our graduates will be able to combine applied education and academics with theory in order to maintain the standards required for a healthy lifestyle. Our graduating dietitians will promote, sustain and renew healthy eating habits based on scientific studies on an individual, social and global level; will be guided by professional ethical regulations; will have a firm belief in team work and will be a qualified healthcare professional embracing preventive and curative practices. The goal of the department is to be a valued department of choice; to train graduates who are specialists in nutrition sciences and dietetics; to offer research and development; to be renowned on the national and international platforms for scientific studies and consultancies. Additionally, we aim to set benchmarks in the field of nutrition and dietetics through social research and publications as a part of preventive and curative healthcare services. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Murat Baş History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Department of Nutrition and Dietetics has been accepting students since 2013, with its first graduates in 2017. Qualification Awarded After four years of education, graduates who successfully complete the theoretical, practical and internship applications receive the title of "Dietitian" with a bachelor's degree in the field of "Nutrition and Dietetics". Organizing the plans and programs of individual and collective nutrition in line with the principles of nutrition science in order to protect and develop the health of all individuals throughout the life of dietitian, growth, development and increase the quality of life; researches, evaluates and finds solutions to health problems arising from nutrients, food and nutrition; medical and surgical treatments for congenital and acquired diseases and other special cases, which ensure the use of existing food resources in accordance with economic and health rules, control food, inform and raise awareness of the individual and society in order to adopt physiological, psychological and sociological healthy lifestyles on these issues. It is the field of health profession that plans, provides education, plans, implements and monitors diet programs according to the combination of appropriate, natural and therapeutic foods. Admission Requirements Nutrition and Dietetics Department admits students according to the type of points obtained from the higher education transition exam (YKS) conducted by Student Selection and Placement center (ÖSYM). Higher Grade Transition Graduates may apply to master's and/or doctoral programs in nutrition and Dietetics, Child Health, Nutrition and Internal Medicine, Public Health, Phytotherapy and Sports Sciences. Graduation Requirements In order for the student to graduate, he/she must have completed all the courses in the program and must not have FF, FG, NA and U grades. In the Nutrition and Dietetics Program, the student must provide a minimum of 240 ECTS credits and a GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00. In the last year, students are required to do an internship for 4 days a week and for a total of 1200 hours in the fields of Nutrition and Dietetic Practices, medical nutrition therapy in adult and pediatric diseases, food services management, public health, sports nutrition and related fields and successfully complete the internships. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can be recruited in, mother and Child Health Centers, dialysis centers, out-patient clinics, etc. all health units, polyclinics of various public and private institutions, food and beverage enterprises, hotels, nursing homes, elderly care centers, nurseries and food industry, and/or as academicians in Nutrition and Dietetics departments in universities. Assessment and Grading A variety of measurement and evaluation methods are used for the evaluation of the students, such as midterm, quiz, practice, internship, project, report, and final exam. For graduation, the cumulative grade point average is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored and letter graded as shown in the table. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6107

fields.content: Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 44 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Physiotherapist ÖSYM type SAY About Programme A physiotherapist is the person who identifies, plans and implements protocols by conducting professional measurements and tests in order to enhance the mobility of healthy people and to organize their physical activities. Physiotherapists are healthcare professionals who are equipped with the knowledge and skills to plan and implement treatments for improving movement and loss of physical function experienced by patients in conjunction with the diagnosis of specialist physicians. They play a vital role in increasing the quality of health and standard of life. Advances made in modern day health sciences have led to an increase in longevity. This increase has served to firmly emphasize the importance of the concept of quality of life. Physiotherapists play a key role in increasing the quality of life of people. Physiotherapists’ field of practice is growing and becoming more diverse. The Department of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation of the Faculty of Health Sciences at Acıbadem University offers a 4-year undergraduate program which includes basic and clinical science lessons as well as practical and theoretical training revolving around the planning and application of treatment programs. The course is taught in Turkish. The aim is to develop the vision of students by supporting education with an intensive English education and monitoring of international literature. The program is prepared at the standards of education and training provided at Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Schools in developed countries. In addition to participation in an intensive education program, we expect our graduate physiotherapists to be physically and culturally active, patient, tolerant, friendly, responsible, and respectful of human rights, helpful to patients and disabled people, with strong communication skills and who are predisposed to teamwork. Students who graduate from this program will learn how to be physiotherapists who can act independently, use initiative, be creative and to have problem solving skills. This is associated with becoming a physiotherapist who has embraced the principles of lifelong learning, who is dedicated to research and who has the capacity to develop new ideas. Upon their graduation, students who enroll on this program will be fully equipped in both theory and practice. PROG. Dilek ÇAĞRI ARSLAN Vice-co-ordinator Research Assist. Yağmur İLDENİZ Vice-co-ordinator Prof. Dr. Sema SAVCI Vice-co-ordinator Lecturer, Phd. Elif Esma SAFRAN History Acibadem University, Faculty of Health Sciences, Department of Physiotherapy and rehabilitation started education and training in 2009-2010 academic year. The aim of our department is to train researchers and participating physiotherapists who have received universal education, who are equipped with features to help protect physical health, who are equipped with features to help regain health in the event of loss of Health, who have adopted the ethical values of the profession. Qualification Awarded After 4 years of education, graduates receive a bachelor's degree in "Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation". Admission Requirements The degree is awarded to students who have succesfully completed all courses in the curriculum with a CGPA of not less than 2.00/4.00 and no failling grades. Higher Grade Transition Students who graduate from this program can work in Health Ministry affiliated institutions and hospitals, health units affiliated to SGK and other public institutions, special education and branch centers, sports clubs, private hospitals and nursing homes, as well as public and private universities providing physiotherapy education. They can also serve as a faculty member in the physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Department of the universities if they wish and found appropriate Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, students must have accomplished all their courses in the programme and not have FF, FG, NA and U grades. In the physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Program, the student must provide a minimum credit of 240 ECTS and the overall grade point average must be at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students who graduate from this program can work in Health Ministry affiliated institutions and hospitals, health units affiliated to SGK and other public institutions, special education and branch centers, sports clubs, private hospitals and nursing homes, as well as public and private universities providing physiotherapy education. They can also work as lecturers in physiotherapy and rehabilitation departments of universities. Assessment and Grading Various measurement and evaluation methods are used for evaluation of students such as mid-term exam, quiz, practical, project, report, and final. The overall grade point average in the program for graduation is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. The courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Psychology
fields.content: Psychology - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 61 Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree Psychologist ÖSYM type EA About Programme The scientific study of psychology contributes to society in a variety of ways and touches and enriches our lives at different levels. The knowledge on which psychology is based is important for modern society. There is always a need for psychologists whether it is to have a deep conceptual understanding of society; to increase productivity or employment security in a workplace; to evaluate and treat individuals who are suffering mental anguish; to research the effectiveness of subliminal messaging used in advertising; to increase the motivation and success of athletes or evaluate and rehabilitate individuals who are inclined to commit a crime; or to determine the cognitive function of individuals who have been injured in an accident. The scientific study of psychology examines mental, emotional and behavioral processes. There are many sub-branches of psychology including developmental psychology, experimental psychology, social psychology, clinical psychology, industrial and organizational psychology, health psychology, cognitive psychology, forensic psychology, neuropsychology, sports psychology, and traffic psychology. An individual who has been educated in the science of psychology needs also to possess knowledge regarding the fundamental fields of psychology, research and statistical information prior to practice. Later, psychology students can complete a postgraduate degree following their four-year education which will enable them to specialize in a field in which they are interested and in which they believe they will be successful. Other students may desire to do field work, or continue their studies to become researchers or academics. The Department of Psychology at Acıbadem University opened in the 2013-2014 academic year and has aimed to provide educational opportunities at the highest level to its students. With its strong conviction in ethical and scientific principles, academic staff who teach their specialist subjects as well as the physical structure, laboratories, library, and sports facilities offered to students in the heart of the city, combined with the academic opportunities provided by Acıbadem Hospitals, the department aims to set a benchmark for education. PROG. Director Associate Prof. Dr. Belma Bekçi History The Department of Psychology started education in Turkish with 50 students in 2013-2014 academic year. 35 out of 50 students enrolled in the department were the first graduates in 2017. In the second year, the quota increased to 60 and this number is still valid. The founding and retired faculty member of the department, Prof. Dr. İlyas Göz served as the head of the department from the beginning until 2015. Retired faculty member of the department Prof. Dr. Yeşim Korkut served as the head of the department between 2015-2017. Currently the head of the department Assoc. Dr. Belma Bekçi became the head of the department in 2017. Since its establishment, faculty members who have completed their doctorate degrees abroad and in the country have been included in the department. In 2015, Prof. Dr. Şeyda Türk, Prof. Dr. Yeşim Korkut, Assist. Prof. Esra Bal, Lecturer Melih Baybars, and Assist. Prof. Ayşenur Aktaş, in 2016, Assoc. Prof. Belma Bekçi, Assist. Prof. Şebnem Akan, and Res. Assist. Begüm Özbek; in 2018, Assist. Prof. Fatma Kahraman; in 2019, Assoc. Prof. Dr. Nilay Pekel Uludağlı and Res. Assist. Ece Yayla; in 2022, Assist. Prof. Bernis Sütçübaşı, Assist. Prof. Gamze Gültekin and Prof. Dr. Murat Kurt in 2022, Assist. Prof. Şafak Öz Aktepe and Res. Assist. Ülkü Gülbike Yumak in 2023, and Res. Assist. Ezgi Bostancı in 2024. Currently, educational and research activities in our department are carried out by 2 full-time Professors, 1 Associate Professor, 5 Assistant Professors, and 5 Research Assistants. From the Department of Psychology (English), Assoc. Prof. Esra Bal, Res. Asst. Kıvanç Konukoğlu and Res. Asst. Tuğrul Torun provide contribution to education activities. Qualification Awarded They receive a “bachelor's degree” in psychology. Degree Level: Bachelor's Degree Admission Requirements 1. To graduate from secondary education institutions or foreign secondary education institutions whose equivalence is approved by the Ministry of National Education and to meet the admission requirements for undergraduate programs of higher education institutions. 2. To be placed in the relevant undergraduate program of the higher education institution by having the (EA) score type qualification as a result of the central exam conducted by the Measurement, Selection and Placement Center (ÖSYM), whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK. 3. To have obtained sufficient points as a result of the central exam conducted by ÖSYM for the programs of higher education institutions that accept students with special aptitude exam, whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK, and to have succeeded in the special aptitude exam. 4. To be placed in undergraduate programs that are the continuation of the fields they have completed in higher education institutions for associate degree graduates as a result of the "Dikey Geçiş Sınavı" (DGS) conducted by ÖSYM, whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK. Higher Grade Transition Individuals who have the grade point average requirement determined by our university board can apply to graduate and doctorate programs if they are successful in exams such as ALES and ÜDS, and they can continue their specialization training at universities when they get enough points in the science and interview exams. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, students must have accomplished all his / her courses in the program and not have FF, FG, NA and U grades. In the Department of psychology, the student must provide a minimum of 248 ECTS credits and the overall grade point average must be at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students who graduate from this program can work in public and private health institutions, educational institutions, businesses, nursing homes, rehabilitation centers and sports clubs. Assessment and Grading Various assessment and evaluation methods such as midterms, quizzes, applications, projects, reports, and finals are used to evaluate students. For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2.00 out of 4.00 in the program. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. fields.content: Psychology (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 61 Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree Psychologist ÖSYM type EA About Programme The scientific study of psychology contributes to society in a variety of ways and touches and enriches our lives at different levels. The knowledge on which psychology is based is important for modern society. There is always a need for psychologists whether it is to have a deep conceptual understanding of society; to increase productivity or employment security in a workplace; to evaluate and treat individuals who are suffering mental anguish; to research the effectiveness of subliminal messaging used in advertising; to increase the motivation and success of athletes or evaluate and rehabilitate individuals who are inclined to commit a crime; or to determine the cognitive function of individuals who have been injured in an accident. The scientific study of psychology examines mental, emotional and behavioral processes. There are many sub-branches of psychology including developmental psychology, experimental psychology, social psychology, clinical psychology, industrial and organizational psychology, health psychology, cognitive psychology, forensic psychology, neuropsychology, sports psychology, and traffic psychology. An individual who has been educated in the science of psychology needs also to possess knowledge regarding the fundamental fields of psychology, research and statistical information prior to practice. Later, psychology students can complete a postgraduate degree following their four-year education which will enable them to specialize in a field in which they are interested and in which they believe they will be successful. Other students may desire to do field work, or continue their studies to become researchers or academics. The Department of Psychology at Acıbadem University opened in the 2013-2014 academic year and has aimed to provide educational opportunities at the highest level to its students. With its strong conviction in ethical and scientific principles, academic staff who teach their specialist subjects as well as the physical structure, laboratories, library, and sports facilities offered to students in the heart of the city, combined with the academic opportunities provided by Acıbadem Hospitals, the department aims to set a benchmark for education. PROG. Director Associate Prof. Dr. Olga Selin Hünler History The English Psychology Bachelor's Program, which opened in our department in 2019 and accepted its first students into the preparatory class in the 2020-2021 academic year, began its bachelor's education in 2021-2022. Assist. Prof. Esra Bal, who has been supporting the program's faculty on a part-time basis since 2017, rejoined the program full-time in 2021 and was promoted to Associate Professor in 2025. Also joining the faculty in 2021 were Assoc. Prof. Dr. Olga Selin Hünler, Res. Asst. Kıvanç Konukoğlu and Res. Asst. Tuğrul Torun, in 2024 Assist. Prof. Dilan Çabuk Çolak and Assist. Prof. Ezgi Soncu Büyükişcan, and finally, in 2025, Assist. Prof. Sura Ertaş joined the faculty. Education and research activities in our department are currently carried out by 2 Associate Professors, 3 Assisstant Professors and 2 Research Assistants. The founding faculty member of the department, Assoc. Dr. Belma Bekçi served as the head of the department from the beginning until 2024. Assoc. Prof. Dr. Olga Selin Hünler assumed the role of program chair in 2024. The program awarded its first graduates at the end of the 2024-2025 spring semester. From the Department of Psychology (Turkish), Prof. Dr. Şeyda Türk, Assist. Prof. Bernis Sütçübaşı, Assist. Prof. Şafak Öz Aktepe, Res. Asst. Ezgi Bostancı and Res. Asst. Ülkü Gülbike Yumak provide contribution to education activities. Qualification Awarded They receive a “bachelor's degree” in psychology. Degree Level: Bachelor's Degree Admission Requirements 1. To graduate from secondary education institutions or foreign secondary education institutions whose equivalence is approved by the Ministry of National Education and to meet the admission requirements for undergraduate programs of higher education institutions. 2. To be placed in the relevant undergraduate program of the higher education institution by having the (EA) score type qualification as a result of the central exam conducted by the Measurement, Selection and Placement Center (ÖSYM), whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK. 3. To have obtained sufficient points as a result of the central exam conducted by ÖSYM for the programs of higher education institutions that accept students with special aptitude exam, whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK, and to have succeeded in the special aptitude exam. 4. To be placed in undergraduate programs that are the continuation of the fields they have completed in higher education institutions for associate degree graduates as a result of the "Dikey Geçiş Sınavı" (DGS) conducted by ÖSYM, whose procedures and principles are determined by YÖK. Higher Grade Transition Individuals who have the grade point average requirement determined by our university board can apply to graduate and doctorate programs if they are successful in exams such as ALES and ÜDS, and they can continue their specialization training at universities when they get enough points in the science and interview exams. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate, students must have accomplished all his/her courses in the program and not have FF, FG, NA and U grades. In the Department of Psychology (English), the student must provide a minimum of 248 ECTS credits and the overall grade point average must be at least 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students who graduate from this program can work in public and private health institutions, educational institutions, businesses, nursing homes, rehabilitation centers and sports clubs. Assessment and Grading Various assessment and evaluation methods such as midterms, quizzes, applications, projects, reports, and finals are used to evaluate students. For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2.00 out of 4.00 in the program. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Sociology
fields.content: Sociology - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 7 Program Quota 24 Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree Sociology Graduate ÖSYM type EA About Programme The Department of Sociology of the Faculty of Arts and Sciences at Acıbadem University opened in the 2016-2017 academic year. The course program is compatible with the sociology courses offered at other universities in Turkey and in Western countries. Much importance is placed on this compatibility in order for students, particularly post-graduate students, not to encounter any obstacles in their education. The program is taught in English which is advantageous for students who wish to participate in student exchange possibilities. Additionally, it helps students benefit from world literature and to undertake their post-graduate studies abroad should they wish to do so. Sociology is a member of the social sciences family. In order for students to truly grasp the concept of sociology, they need to be familiar with the relation between sociology and social sciences, the common and different ground, and the opportunities for collaboration. The department offers compulsory and elective lessons in all the fields of social sciences in order to meet this requirement. Each year, students are offered a comprehensive range of compulsory and elective lessons which guides research knowledge and experience. It is aimed for students to have a full comprehension of the methodology of social sciences, to learn research techniques and ethics, and to develop the conduct and skills required for field study. With the support of the academic staff, students are encouraged to carry out research in a variety of societal settings, to participate in congresses and similar events. Sociology education does not include a mandatory period of internship; however, voluntary internships for students to familiarize themselves with a variety of fields of work are encouraged and supported. It is highly regarded for students to explore the opportunities available to them while working as a sociologist particularly in health institutions, social work and non-profit organizations. A unique aspect of the department is that students are offered a wide range of elective courses and research opportunities in order for them to become fully acquainted with social sciences and, in particular, with health sociology. The field of health social sciences is an area of research and practice which has developed rapidly since the 1980s. Acıbadem University also supports the development of this field. It is desired for the students to take their place as young trailblazers in the development of the field in Turkey. Sociology education can be considered a process which increases sensitivity to social, cultural and humanitarian facts. This department is committed to training young people who are sensitive to the country in which they live, the world, who are knowledgeable, intellectual and responsible. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. İnci USER ECTS and Erasmus Coordinator of the Department Lecturer, Phd. Ceren Gülser İLİKAN RASİMOĞLU History The first students of the Sociology Department of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University started their studies in English preparatory class in 2016-2017. Qualification Awarded Students who complete four years of education in our department obtain a ‘bachelor's degree in sociology’. Admission Requirements For admission to the sociology department, it is necessary to have completed secondary education or received an equivalent education abroad and to be eligible for the field proficiency test (ayt) Equal Weight (EA) score type qualification conducted by the Student Selection and Placement Center (OSYM). Higher Grade Transition Individuals who have the grade point average requirement determined by our university, ales and foreign language exams if they are successful in the master's and doctoral programs opened can hit head. Since various programs in Turkey and abroad have been taken into account in the preparation of the departmental curriculum, they will have a high chance of being accepted. Master's and doctoral degrees can bring privilege to students in business life as well as enable those who wish and have success to continue their academic career. Graduation Requirements Students who graduate from sociology must have passed all courses in the undergraduate program (FF, FG, NA and U grades are not available), have completed the total ECTS credits of the curriculum they follow, and have a minimum GPA of 2.00 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Undergraduate education in sociology gives students comprehensive and versatile knowledge of people, society and culture. The options of the students who have a sociology license in their working life can be to work in research institutions (public and market research, social and Demographic Research), social service organizations, health organizations, communication fields such as press and publications or public relations, to turn to teaching or academic career. Graduates can also further expand their fields by pursuing a master's degree in any field of social, humanities or administrative sciences. If they want to change fields, they can turn to managerial jobs or sectors such as banking and insurance. In recent years, in business life, Advertising, Marketing, Human Resources Management and professional NGO management areas such as sociology graduates can choose. In addition, sociologist staff can be opened in local administrations, state-affiliated institutions (such as courthouses, housing estates, prisons). It is expected that the demand for sociology graduates will increase as sociology is a relatively new concept in our country, where sociology is not only an academic field but can also benefit for application purposes. Assessment and Grading The assessment and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course teaching plan”. Related articles of Acıbadem University's Associate Degree, undergraduate education and examination regulations are applied in relation to exams and Course Success grades. In addition to semester and end-of-term exams, homework, term paper, classroom practice, report and evaluation methods are used for the evaluation of the students and which of these are to be used in each course will be notified in advance. The overall grade point average in the program for graduation is expected to be at least 2 out of 4. Courses are scored as shown in the table and letter grades are given. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6289

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Faculty of Pharmacy (English)
fields.content: Faculty of Pharmacy (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 5 Max.Program Time (Year) 8 Program Quota 60 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Pharmacist ÖSYM type SAY About Programme The mission of Acıbadem University Faculty of Pharmacy is to train pharmacists at international standards who have been well-educated, are creative, and dedicated to research and development. We aim for our graduate pharmacists to become highly sought after in every field of pharmaceutical sciences in medical industries and hospitals in Turkey and around the world. Our students benefit from learning in the laboratories of Acıbadem University Faculty of Pharmacy which are equipped with state of the art technology as well as Acıbadem Healthcare Group hospitals and outpatient clinics located not just in Istanbul, but in a variety of regions in Turkey. Our experience academic staff closely follows scientific developments. Their devoted contributions to their students as well as the interactive, innovative education models they implement enables students to have full knowledge in all areas of pharmaceutical sciences (academic, medical industry, hospital, independent pharmacy) and competence to work in them. Throughout the education of the students, the faculty aims to work in collaboration with the medical industry, and to contribute to the development of the medical industry in Turkey by using all available resources. The Faculty also aims to undertake research and development for the development of herbal, dermatological and cosmetic products as well as to design scientific studies which could result in the development of a product. The Faculty vows to undertake all these responsibilities and share all the processes and procedures associated with them with their students. ECTS and Erasmus Coordinator of the Department Prof. Dr. Umut Bulut History A faculty supporting the involvement of competent and qualified pharmacists in all areas and processes involving drugs, Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydinlar University Faculty of Pharmacy was opened in 2015 and started to accept students in 2016-2017 academic year. Qualification Awarded Faculty of Pharmacy Students who successfully complete the curriculum are awarded the title of PHARMACIST at the end of their education. Admission Requirements For admission to the Faculty of Pharmacy, a high school diploma is required and a central national examination by the OSYM must be conducted, or the student has to meet the necessary conditions according to the regulations of the Higher Education Institution related to international student admission. Higher Grade Transition The graduates of the Faculty of Pharmacy can continue their master and doctorate programs depending on the admission requirements. They can continue their education in Pharmacy and choose special areas after taking Specialization Exam in Pharmacy (EUS). Graduation Requirements Students must successfully complete all 225 National Credits and 300 ECTS credits to graduate. Having a GPA of at least 2.00 out of 4.00 is the required qualification requirement for graduation. 70% attendance for theoretical courses and 80% attendance for laboratory courses are required. In addition, they must complete a total of 120 days of pharmacy / hospital internships, and a graduation project (during 9. and 10. semesters) in order to graduate. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Pharmacies, Hospital Pharmacy, Clinical Pharmacy, Academic Pharmacy, Cosmetologist or Phytotherapist Pharmacist, Health Insurances, Pharmaceutical Industry, Research & Development, Production, Quality Control and Assurance, Medical Department, Licensing, Marketing, Pharmacovigilance, Pharmacoeconomics, etc. Public institutions, Hifzissihha Laboratories, Social Security Institution Assessment and Grading The types of exams and assessment and evaluation forms used for each course in the program are explained in detail in the Course Learning Plans. In addition, a midterm exam and an absolute final exam are held for each course. At the same time, students' internship grades are determined by taking the average of the follow-up and exams given at the end of the internship. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=17
