fields.title: Program Hakkında – School of Medicine (English)
fields.content: School of Medicine (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 6 Max.Program Time (Year) 9 Program Quota 50 Internships Status Have .Graduate Degree Doctor of Medicine ÖSYM type SAY About Programme The Acıbadem University School of Medicine was established in 2007 and accepted its first students into the academic year starting in 2009 following a two year period where the curriculum was devised. The school was initially established on a modest campus located in Maltepe. In 2013, it moved to the purpose-built Kerem Aydınlar Campus, one of the most developed science campuses in Turkey. The campus features a Center of Advanced Simulation and Education (CASE) while practical applications take place at Acıbadem Atakent and Acıbadem Maslak Education and Research Hospitals and the Education Research Regions whose affiliation with the Council of Higher Education (YÖK) is complete. Education at the School of Medicine is in English and our education program features three phases. Phase I is integrated Basic and Clinical Sciences, Phase II is Clinical Clerkships and Phase III is Internships.Our education is based on an integrated curriculum. In the program for Phase I systems in organisms ranging from the simplest units such as cells to more complex systems including pathologies are taught as a whole. Phase I also includes Clinical Medicine and Professional Skills (CMPS) which is a program designed to be an initial introduction to medical professionalism providing students with relevant knowledge and skills. This program includes applied communication courses designed to help students with honing their skills prior to meeting patients during the Clinical Clerkship phase. Additionally, Phase I is enriched with practical applications at Family and Society Health Centers. This phase involves training settings which support the development of intellectual skills and human values. During the 1-year Clinical Clerkships of Phase II, students continue to develop their existing clinical knowledge and skills by caring for inpatients and outpatients in a hospital setting. During the 1-year Internship of Phase III students undertake the responsibility of patient care in a hospital or primary care setting under the supervision of teaching staff where they are able to apply their knowledge and skill in full. Students develop their clinical skills through participation in programs at the Center of Advanced Simulation and Education (CASE) for six terms. Our faculty boasts a strong academic staff. Our mission is to ensure young people from Turkey and around the world who choose to study medicine at our establishment are nurtured to become universal physicians who are sensitive to the needs of the society they live in and the world, who fully comprehend the importance of knowledge and academic thought, who are curious and inquisitive, with an excellent command of technology. We strive to ensure our students understand that patients are our priority, who are humanitarian, who have excellent communication skills and who respect their fellow medical professional co-workers and who have embraced the importance of ethical values and team work. Acıbadem University School of Medicine invests in science and encourages its students to carry out research and publish research papers. We emphasize the importance of training in society in addition to internships and we aim to train universal physicians who strive for great achievements in all fields of medicine on a national and international scale. We are proud of the superior levels of competence and awareness displayed by our graduates in specialist programs in the field of primary healthcare. We continue to stride confidently towards our goal of training the best physicians in Turkey. Vice-co-ordinator Prof. Dr. Mustafa Aktekin Vice-co-ordinator Prof. Dr. Özgür Kurt Vice-co-ordinator Prof. Dr. Işıl Pakiş Program Başkanı Prof. Dr. Nadi Bakırcı History The faculty has been accepting students since the 2009-2010 academic year. Qualification Awarded After 6 years of Education, people who graduate receive a bachelor's degree in the field of" Doctor". Degree level: Doctor of Medicine Admission Requirements For admission to the School of Medicine, placement must be made with a high school diploma and a central national exam conducted by OSYM, or must meet the requirements in accordance with the rules of the Council of Higher Education related to international student admission. Higher Grade Transition Graduates of the School of Medicine can continue their master's and doctoral programs depending on the admission requirements. By taking tus, they can continue their education in the fields of Medicine. Graduation Requirements Students must successfully complete all 360 ECTS in order to graduate. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates of the School of Medicine work in the Departments of the ministry, especially family health centers and community health centers in primary health care, with lots organized by the Ministry of Health for two years of mandatory service. Those who are successful in the medical specialty exam, which is held twice every year, start their specialty training in hospitals of universities or in educational and research hospitals belonging to the Ministry of Health. Assessment and Grading Exams; - in Phase I, at least one midterm and one final exam are held at each course Board. Measurement and evaluation of the CMPS program is carried out in various ways in accordance with the learning outcomes and the training method used in the courses. The final exam at the end of the year covers all course subjects given during the year. - 4. and 5. at the end of each clinical internship period, students must take all theoretical and practical exams. Scoring system; - At the end of each year of Phase I, the passing grade consists of 50% of the average course Board exams and 50% of the final exam grade. - Passing grade in Phase II, exams conducted during and at the end of the internship determine the internship grade. The methods, content and contribution of the exams to determine the internship grade are determined at the beginning of the semester by the Board of coordinators and the measurement and Evaluation Board together with the internship officers, and the exam Matrix created for this purpose is announced to the students in writing. Completion exam grade is Internship grade. Credits; - There are two types of lending: the National Credit system and the European Credit Transfer System (ECTS). fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Anatomy (Medicine) (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Anatomy (Medicine) (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Temel tıp bilimleri ve özellikle anatomi alanında, uluslararası düzeyde bilimsel üretim ve araştırmalar yapan bilim insanlarına ihtiyaç tüm dünyada sürmektedir. Acıbadem Üniversitesi Sağlık Bilimleri Enstitüsü Anatomi Tezli Yüksek Lisans programı, anatomi alanındaki bilim insanı ihtiyacını karşılayacak, sorgulayan, merak eden, evrensel bilime ve uluslararası literatüre katkı sağlayacak araştırmalar planlayıp yürütebilen nitelikli bilim insanları yetiştirmeyi hedeflemektedir. Program ilk yıl zorunlu ve seçmeli derslerden oluşurken, ikinci yıl ise araştırma ve tez yürütme dönemidir. Program kapsamında hem makroskopik hem de mikroskobik anatomi yöntemleri ile eğitim ve akademik çalışma planları uygulanmakta ve çeşitli patolojik durumlar açısından anatomi eğitimi verilmektedir. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Mustafa AKTEKİN History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Institute of Health Sciences Anatomy Master's Program with Thesis started education and training in the 2020-2021 Academic Year. Qualification Awarded MSc Admission Requirements Demonstration that one of the Academic Personnel and Graduate Education Entrance Examination (ALES), Graduate Record Examination (GRE) or Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT) exams (at least 55 from ALES, at least 610 from GRE numerical score or at least 450 from GMAT) ) result document. Having received at least 50 points or an equivalent score from the foreign language exams accepted by the Council of Higher Education. For candidates who do not have a Foreign Language Proficiency Certificate, having received at least 50 points from the Foreign Language Proficiency Exam to be held by Acıbadem University Foreign Languages ??Department. Higher Grade Transition Those who complete the Master's Program can pursue a doctorate in anatomy or other basic sciences. Graduation Requirements Students who have been successful in taking the courses that constitute the graduation requirement in the program and fulfilling the criteria, who have successfully completed their thesis and who have been successful in the thesis defense exam are deemed to have successfully completed their master's degree with thesis, provided that their overall grade point average is at least the passing grade determined by the Institute of Health Sciences. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can start a PhD program, work as research assistants in higher education institutions, and work in companies in the medical field. Assessment and Grading For each course, midterm exams/homework/projects etc. are prepared by the instructors who teach the course studies and a final exam are held. Evaluation criteria for each course are stated in the course information packages. Faculty members evaluate all studies, homework, midterm exams and final exams during the semester and grade them according to the course passing grade system determined by the Institute. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6187

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Biochemistry And Molecular Biology (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Biochemistry And Molecular Biology (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme The purpose of Acibadem University Health Sciences Institute’s ‘Biochemistry and Molecular Biology’ Doctoral Program is to educate qualified scientists, who have strong team work spirit, questioning, idea production and investigation mentality and who can also contribute to production. Today, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology are the two fastest developing scientific fields and have substantial effect on sectors such as medicine, pharmacology, agriculture, husbandry, industry and environment globally, as much as in our country. All of the modern biotechnologic products are based on the knowledge at hand about biochemistry and molecular biology. In this doctoral program, the goal is to teach students cellular and chemical incidents, which are observed at health and sickness, at molecular level. Genetics, signal transduction and metabolic reactions form a grift interaction web that has harmony with the environment. Genetic changes such as mutation and polymorphism, which affect single molecule, have also effect on cellular behaviour besides chemical process. This way, they might have significant effect on the organs’ functions and the organism itself. Because of these reasons, today’s biochemistry involves a wide interdisciplinary web of genomics, proteomics, gene and protein network, as well as lipid, carbohydrate and protein metabolic pathway, cellular communication and signal cascades and also organs’ complex diseases and cardiovascular circulation. And in modern biochemical researches, as parallel to that wide content, advanced techniques such as microarrays, peptides, proteins and mass – spectrometry anlysis of biomolecules are also in use. Students, who attend this doctoral program, will gain experience about clinical and laboratory aspects of biochemical and genetic researches, besides acquisition of wide theoric knowledge about an interdisciplinary program. As a result, a student, who graduates from this program that aims to educate preemptible researchers in terms of career opportunities and preferability in various areas, will be able to become an academician or a researcher at public or private institutions such as universities and research centers and also will have executive positon opportunities at medical faculties’ and health institutions’ diagnosis and tratment laboratories. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Aysel Özpınar Program Başkanı Prof. Dr. Aysel Özpınar History The BMB Masters Program has started to accept students from the fall semester of 2011-2012 academic year. Twenty one students have completed the Msc program. The program included 2 Prof., 7 Assoc Prof and 5 Assist Prof at the beginning. Qualification Awarded MSc in Biochemistry and Molecular Biology Admission Requirements Language Proficiency: TOEFL-IBT: At least 60 YDS/ÜDS/KPDS/YÖKDİL: At least 50 Candidates who do not have a foreign language certificate will be asked to get at least 50 points from the Foreign Language Proficiency Exam that will be held by Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Foreign Languages ??Department. Additionally, Candidates must have a minimum score of 55 from the Academic Personnel and Postgraduate Education Entrance Examination (ALES). Higher Grade Transition The Graduates of the Master's program in Biochemistry and Molecular Biology can apply for a doctorate in Biochemistry and Molecular Biology or other basic sciences. Graduation Requirements Students who have successfully completed the courses in the program and have fulfilled the graduation criteria, who have successfully completed their thesis work, who have been successful in the thesis defense exam and who has submitted an abstract each year and who has submitted the thesis work to a journal covered in SCI-SCI expanded are considered to have successfully completed the masters's degree program provided that the GPA is at least the passing grade determined by the Institute of Health Science. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students can either proceed to doctorate education or work at pharmaceutical industry or R&D centers. Assessment and Grading For the evaluation of students, different assessment and evaluation methods such as midterm, project presentation, practice exam, final exam and article discussion are used. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=56

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Bioethics (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Bioethics (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme Bioethics is very dynamic discipline which covers all the value issues related with the living beings. It is an activity and practice of deeper thinking about ethical issues in health sciences, healthcare policy-making and decision making in life science practices. As a both theoretical and applied discipline, bioethics covers the analysis of ethical dilemmas with rational reasoning. It is open to and works closely with the disciplines of philosophy, law, public health, history, forensic medicine, biomedical technologies in collaboration with the social sciences. Acibadem University Bioethics Master Program aims to develop the critical thinking of the perception of society and individual through universal bioethical principles and to put them into practice by field studies inspired by the ethical and professional values. The first year of Bioethics Master Program includes compulsory and elective courses. The second year is the research and thesis writing term. Our program offers an ideal learning environment and professional career opportunity if you are interested in the main issues of bioethics and wish to develop your intellectual and professional skills. ECTS and Erasmus Coordinator of the Department Associate Prof. Dr. Fatih Artvinli Head of Department Prof. Dr. Yeşim Işıl Ülman History It started in the 2015-2016 academic year. It operates within the Institute of Health Sciences.The master's program with Thesis in Bioethics has a multidisciplinary training program. Qualification Awarded Master's Degree Specialization in Bioethics Admission Requirements The graduate program in bioethics, medicine, pharmacy, dentistry, veterinary medicine, nursing and other health sciences faculties and the faculties of Science and arts, biology, departments of Molecular Biology and genetics, Law, philosophy, sociology or other related field is a 4-year graduates of the Department of education, with domestic and overseas graduates of schools approved by YÖK may apply Higher Grade Transition Students who have successfully completed this program and obtained a master's degree can continue doctoral programs in related fields (such as Bioethics, medical history and Ethics). Graduation Requirements The program is scheduled to be completed in at least four semesters. The first two semesters are the course term and students take the compulsory and elective courses together. During the course period, students must successfully complete at least 23 local or 60 ECTS credits. Dissertation work begins in the third semester. The thesis period is at least two semesters (60 ECTS credits). To complete this program, at least 21 local or 120 ECTS credits must be successfully completed. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates of the program can work in Ethics Committee (Research, Hospital, academic,...) , provide Counseling in private and public hospitals, can serve as experts/advisor in Biomedicine and biotechnology companies, give lectures in the field of bioethics, medical ethics and history of Medicine at the undergraduate level and high schools and conduct academic research and project work in the area. Assessment and Grading Midterm exam / homework / project, etc Dec. studies and a final exam are conducted. Evaluation criteria for each course are specified in the course information packages. Final exams are held in the date range determined according to the academic calendar announced by Acıbadem University Institute of Health Sciences at the beginning of the year. Faculty members evaluate all the work, homework, midterms and final exams during the semester and make grading according to the course passing grade system determined by the Institute. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=55

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Biophysics (With Thesis) (English)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Biophysics (With Thesis) (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Biophysics is a scientific field that studies biological processes using the concepts, principles, and methods of physics. To understand the structure and function of complex biological systems a multidisciplinary approach is required. Biophysics is a field where scientists from life sciences and quantitative sciences of physics, mathematics, chemistry and engineering address scientific questions. Due to its interdisciplinary nature, students with an undergraduate degree in many fields, including physics, chemistry, biology, engineering and medicine can be trained in biophysics. Biophysicists are expected to have a basic background in medical sciences such as anatomy, physiology, and biochemistry, as well as in fields such as mathematics, physics, biology, and computers, and they must acquire sufficient knowledge in these fields during their education. Especially in recent years, developments in the field of science and technology have highlighted the need for an interdisciplinary approach and many countries have intensified their investments to train manpower in these fields. In our country, the number of scientists and faculty members in the field of biophysics is quite limited. Our graduate program aims to fill this gap and train biophysicists for academia as well as other career options. Vice-co-ordinator Associate Prof. Dr. Devrim Öz Arslan Vice-co-ordinator Associate Prof. Dr. Zeynep Aslıhan Durer Vice-co-ordinator Lecturer, Phd. Evren Kılınç Head of Department Prof. Dr. Beki Kan History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Institute of Health Sciences, Biophysics Master Program has started education and training in the 2020-2021 Academic Year. Qualification Awarded Those who graduate after completing their two-year education will receive the title of "Master in Science, MSc". Admission Requirements Biology, Biochemistry, Physics, Chemistry, Genetics and Bioinformatics, Molecular Biology and Genetics, Bioengineering, Biology and Chemical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Physics Engineering, Mathematical Engineering , Medical and Biomedical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering Department; Graduates of the Faculty of Natural and Life Sciences, Faculty of Medicine and Faculty of Pharmacy can apply. Applications coming from outside these departments will be evaluated by the science exam to be held by the relevant board. Scientific Qualification Requirements: Candidates must have a quantitative score of at least 60 from the Academic Personnel and Postgraduate Education Entrance Exam (ALES) or a GRE score of at least 149. Foreign Language Requirement: Among the foreign language exams accepted by the Higher Education Council; TOEFL-IBT: Minimum 72 points; YDS / ÜDS / KPDS / YÖKDİL: Minimum 70 points; Candidates who do not have a foreign language certificate will be required to have at least 70 points from the Foreign Language Proficiency Exam held by Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Foreign Languages ??Department. Higher Grade Transition Diploma holders can apply for a doctorate program by meeting the necessary conditions and continue their academic career . Graduation Requirements It is required to take at least 22 credits and 121 ECTS courses for the Master's degree in Biophysics with thesis. In addition, it is obligatory to complete the articles, seminars and thesis studies taken without credit. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Diploma holders can apply for a doctorate program by meeting the necessary conditions and continue their academic career . Assessment and Grading Different assessment and evaluation methods such as project presentation, homework, seminar preparation and final exam are used in the assessment of students. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6148

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Biostatistics And Bioinformatics (With Thesis) (English)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Biostatistics And Bioinformatics (With Thesis) (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Biostatistics and bioinformatics are the most important fields, which bring scientific approaches to the solution of modern health problems. These two fields aim to generate stochastic and analytical solutions, respectively, for problems in medicine and life sciences. Along with their coinciding aspects, these two fields have differential features as well. Today’s technological developments, especially the developments in new age sequencing, transcriptomic, proteomic and in other omic technologies enable collection of substantial amount of data. In addition, hospitals’ electronic health records are rich databases, thus they contain substantial amount of data. Advanced biostatistic and bioinformatic methods are needed to be developed in order to adapt and utilize these types of data in customized medical perspective, diagnosis and treatment, in understanding the mechanism of disease formation and in early diagnosis. In this program, we aim to teach these two scientific approaches together. We believe that this is important because the scientists, who can attain these skills all together, would contribute a lot to the development of science in Turkey. There are very few examples of the program we recommend in the world, while there is none in Turkey. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Uğur Sezerman History The first graduate program of biostatistics and bioinformatics in Turkey Qualification Awarded Master of Science in Biostatistics and Bioinformatics Admission Requirements Dil Yeterliliği • Yükseköğretim Kurulu tarafından kabul edilen yabancı dil sınavlarından; • TOEFL-IBT: En az 80 puan • YDS/ÜDS/KPDS/YÖKDİL: En az 67 puan • Yabancı dil belgesine sahip olmayan adaylar için Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar Üniversitesi Yabancı Diller Bölümü tarafından yapılacak olan Yabancı Dil Yeterlilik Sınavından; en az 67 puan almış olmaları istenecektir. Bilimsel Yeterlilik • Lisansüstü eğitim için aşağıda belirtilen sınavlardan birinden en az geçerli puanı almış olmak (sonuç belgeleri başvuru tarihine kadar geçerli olmalıdır): • ALES veya e-ALES sayısal puan türünden en az 55 puan almak veya GRE quantitative türünden en az 149 almak koşuluyla başvuru yapabilirler. Bu sınavların geçerlilikleri 5 yıldır. Programlara Başvuru için Gerekli Evraklar; • Lisans Diploma veya Geçici Mezuniyet Belgesinin Aslı (Onaylı fotokopisi kayıt esnasında yapılacaktır.) (Yabancı ülkelerden Biyoinformatik Doktora Programına temel oluşturabilecek ilgili alanlardan bir lisans programından (BSc) programından alınan diplomalarının YÖK tarafından denkliğinin onaylanmış olması gerekir.) • Resmi akademik transkript: İlgili yükseköğretim kurumunun Öğrenci İşleri tarafından hazırlanmış, adayın aldığı tüm dersleri ve notlarını gösteren resmi belgenin online sistem üzerinden sisteme yüklenmesi ve/veya kapalı zarf içerisinden sunulması gereklidir. • Niyet mektubu: Adayın söz konusu programa neden katılmak istediği, programa ve kariyerine ilişkin hedefleri, motivasyonları, beklentileri özetlenmelidir. • Referans Mektubu, (iki adet) (kapalı zarf içinde) (Mülakat Sınavında Referans Mektuplarının teslim edilmemesi durumunda kayıt alınmayacaktır.) • İngilizce Yeterlilik Sınav Sonuç Belgesi • ALES, GMAT veya GRE sınavlarından birisinden sonuç belgesi (Doktora/ sanatta yeterlilik/tıpta uzmanlık/diş hekimliğinde uzmanlık/veteriner hekimliğinde uzmanlık/eczacılıkta uzmanlık mezunları için mezun olduğu lisans programı diploması). • Nüfus cüzdanı fotokopisi /Pasaport Fotokopisi • Erkek Adaylar için Askerlik Belgesi Higher Grade Transition Graduates can apply to the faculty member positions. Qualification Awarded Master's Degree (with thesis) Admission Requirements 1. To graduate from Nursing / Health Officer degree program 2. To get "TOEFL-IBT 60, YDS-ÜDS-KPDS-YÖKDIL 50" and above from foreign language exams accepted by YÖK. If you do not have a language score, it is essential to get at least 50 and above from Acıbadem University Foreign Language exam 3.To get 55 and above in numerical field from Academic Personnel Graduate Education Entrance Exam Higher Grade Transition Those who have successfully completed this program and obtained a master's degree can continue to doctoral programs in related fields. Graduation Requirements Students who have successfully completed their thesis study and have been successful in the thesis defense exam are considered to have successfully completed their master's degree provided that they have a passing grade determined by the Graduate School of Health Sciences Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can work as a specialist nurse in health institutions. Assessment and Grading Midterm exam/homework/project, course studies and a final exam are conducted by the relevant lecturer.The evaluation criteria for each course are stated in the course information package. The final exams are held in the date range determined according to the academic calendar announced by Acıbadem University Institute of Health Sciences at the beginning of the year. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Emergency Nursing (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Emergency Nursing (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme Reasons such as the fact that individuals are more interested in health-related issues in the world and in our country and their expectations from health professionals increase, developments in care and treatment, and patient satisfaction being one of the important quality indicators for health institutions have increased the need for specialist nurses in health care fields. The aim of Acıbadem University Nursing Master's Programs is to provide evidence-based care, equipped with contemporary knowledge and skills, creative and critical thinking skills, capable of scientific research, access to information and transforming their knowledge in the field of nursing into a specialist skill, with the knowledge and skills to meet the increasing and changing care demand. To train scientific experts who can present. Nursing Master's program give education in the fields of Emergency Nursing, Surgical Diseases Nursing, Internal Diseases Nursing, Intensive Care Nursing. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Ükke Karabacak History The Program has been accepting students since the 2010-2011 academic year. Qualification Awarded Master's Degree (with thesis) Admission Requirements 1. To graduate from Nursing / Health Officer degree program 2. To get "TOEFL-IBT 60, YDS-ÜDS-KPDS-YÖKDIL 50" and above from foreign language exams accepted by YÖK. If you do not have a language score, it is essential to get at least 50 and above from Acıbadem University Foreign Language exam 3.To get 55 and above in numerical field from Academic Personnel Graduate Education Entrance Exam Higher Grade Transition Those who have successfully completed this program and obtained a master's degree can continue to doctoral programs in related fields. Graduation Requirements Students who have successfully completed their thesis study and have been successful in the thesis defense exam are considered to have successfully completed their master's degree provided that they have a passing grade determined by the Graduate School of Health Sciences Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can work as a specialist nurse in health institutions. Assessment and Grading Midterm exam/homework/project, course studies and a final exam are conducted by the relevant lecturer.The evaluation criteria for each course are stated in the course information package. The final exams are held in the date range determined according to the academic calendar announced by Acıbadem University Institute of Health Sciences at the beginning of the year. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Forensic Sciences (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Forensic Sciences (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Acıbadem University Institute of Health Sciences Forensic Sciences Master's Program with thesis is a multidisciplinary master's program prepared with the contributions of different disciplines for those who want to specialize in forensic sciences. Forensic Sciences is one of the fastest rising and increasing popularity branches of recent times. The basis of the glare of Forensic Sciences is now the ability of the judiciary, the police force, and the forensic scientific methods to find the solution in all kinds of cases where there is conflict and dissent. Especially in cases reflected in the judiciary, the number of cases that can be solved without resorting to the methods of forensic science and without obtaining forensic opinion has become very limited. The recent increase in all forms of violence, especially in cases of individual violence, the fact that many people, especially women and children, the elderly, and the disabled, experience physical, sexual and emotional violence increases the importance of forensic sciences. Because the only way to detect violence experienced in all cases, whether child abuse or sexual violence is obtained by the coroner's report as quickly as possible and only thus the rights of the victim can be protected. Forensic scientific methods should be used in all cases, starting with mental problems such as legal license and criminal license, medical practice errors, disability and disability calculations in accidents, when an autopsy performed in fatal cases and determining the cause of death and especially whether it is murder, accident, suicide or natural cause of origin, which we call origin. With the extraordinary advances in forensic science laboratory technology, it has become an area in the field of identification and toxicology that can now give near-certain results. Especially in identification and paternity detections, DNA use, toxicological and drug analysis spectrophotometric and chromatographic methods have become a position that reduces question marks and even eliminates them in many cases with the precise results obtained. Forensic Sciences Master's programs with and without thesis aim to provide education in line with the two main objectives. The first is that this area is a relatively new field and there is a great need for young scientists in the field of forensic sciences because scientific studies are walking at a very fast pace. Our master's program with thesis aims to discuss the initiatives that can be made in this field on the scientific platform by teaching methodological working principles and scientific approaches in light of new developments in the world. In our master's program without thesis, it aims to respond to the need of the judiciary for great human resources in the field of forensic sciences and to train experts in its field. The most characteristic feature of Forensic Sciences is that it is a field of science that has multidisciplinary and interdisciplinary working characteristics and aims to work together experts from many different fields. From medical doctors to nurses, paramedics, psychologists, lawyers, sociologists and social workers, intensive forensic studies are carried out. Forensic and forensic science approaches in many different subjects such as child abuse, sexual violence, medical practice errors, homicides, murders, toxicological analyses, crime scene investigations, victimology studies, both contribute greatly to understanding the dynamics and development of events and to determining the truth on a legal level. The Master of Forensic Sciences program accepts its students both with and without thesis. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Oğuz Polat Program Consultant Prof. Dr. Işıl Pakiş History Forensic Science Master's program without thesis was established in 2020. Qualification Awarded Master of Science Admission Requirements Four-year, social and health sciences graduate candidates are accepted with the requirement to comply with the student admission criteria of the Higher Education Institution (YÖK) and the Institute of Health Sciences of Acıbadem University. Higher Grade Transition Students who have graduated from Master's programs with a dissertation in forensic science can apply for doctoral programs. Graduation Requirements The amount of credit and number of courses required to obtain a master's degree with a forensic science dissertation are listed below. Number of credit courses to be taken (minimum): 10 Total course credits(minimum): 30 Total ECTS (minimum): 120 Occupational Profiles of Graduates Participants in the Forensic Science Master's program will have the opportunity to work in many business areas. In recent years, the use of Forensic Science in many areas has great advantages. Especially in the detection - treatment and monitoring of violence cases and in expert cases, this situation comes to the fore. Expertise is also an area that will play an important role in closing the large gap in this area, since the judiciary is the ones whom is applied for Opinion. Assessment and Grading For each course, the instructor conducts research such as mid-term exam, homework, projects, and a final exam. Evaluation criteria for each course are given in the course information packages.Faculty members evaluate all assignments, midterms and final exams during the semester and grade them in accordance with the course passing grade system determined by the Institute https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6146

Head of Department Prof. Dr. Oğuz Polat Program Consultant Prof. Dr. Işıl Pakiş History Forensic Science Master's program without dissertation was established in 2020. There has been no graduates yet. Qualification Awarded Master's Degree Admission Requirements In this program, four-year, social and health sciences graduate candidates are accepted with the requirement to be in compliance with the student admission criteria of the Higher Education Institution (YÖK) and the Institute of Health Sciences of Acıbadem university. Higher Grade Transition Students who graduate from Forensic Science Master's programs without a dissertation can apply to study in Master's programs with a dissertation. Number of credit courses to be taken (minimum):12 Total course credits(minimum): 30 Total ECTS (minimum): 120 Occupational Profiles of Graduates Participants in the Forensic Science Master's program will have the opportunity to work in many business areas. In recent years, the use of Forensic Science in many areas has great advantages. Especially in the detection - treatment and monitoring of violence cases and in expert cases, this situation comes to the fore. An expert witness is an area that will also play an important role in closing a large gap in this area, since the judiciary is the ones to whom it applies for an opinion. Because it is a field where are made for multidisciplinary studies, medical doctors, nurses, chemistry, physics and pharmacy graduates, healthcare management graduates, Lawyers, Psychologists, Sociologists, social workers, including forensic studies for all occupational groups in the study is very important. Courts , Forensic Medicine Institution, Ministry of Health and Ministry of Interior institutions need trained personnel in this field Assessment and Grading For each course, the instructor conducts research such as mid-term exam, homework, projects, and a final exam. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Genome Studies (With Thesis) (English)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Genome Studies (With Thesis) (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Nowadays, developments in medical science have gained great speed with the advancement of genomic technologies. Personal genetic background is now at the forefront in the diagnosis and selection of treatment options of diseases. In this graduate program, it is envisaged that candidates will be trained in international standards by learning the use of medical genetic and genomic technologies in the field of medicine during their modern biology education. In addition, it is aimed to provide them with the skills of application and evaluation of molecular genetics and omics approaches in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases. With the help of these skills, the students would be able to conduct independent research in genomic medicine, interpret and analyze scientific problems and data, reach new syntheses, and develop related products. ECTS and Erasmus Coordinator of the Department Associate Prof. Dr. Cemaliye Akyerli Boylu Program Başkanı Associate Prof. Dr. Cemaliye Akyerli Boylu History The Department of Genomic Studies under the Institute of Health Sciences was established in 2020 by the Medical Genetics and Medical Biology departments of Acıbadem University School of Medicine. Qualification Awarded Master of Science in Genomic Studies (M.Sc.) Admission Requirements Requires undergraduate diploma from one of the following departments/faculties of a 4-year-minimum Higher Education Program: Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Genetics and Bioengineering, Molecular Biology and Genetics, Biomedical Engineering, Medical Engineering, Biology, Medical Biology, Biotechnology (applications from departments other than listed above will be evaluated by the Faculty Council) Higher Grade Transition Those who complete this master of science program can do their Ph.D. studies in one of the life sciences programs. Graduation Requirements Students who have successfully completed their thesis study and succeeded in the thesis defense exam by taking the courses that constitute the graduation requirement of the program are considered to have successfully completed their master's degree with thesis, provided that the GPA is at least the passing grade determined by the Institute of Health Sciences. Occupational Profiles of Graduates They can be employed as an academician at universities or as a researcher in public / private organizations. Assessment and Grading Methods such as exams, homework, projects, etc. are used to measure the learning objectives determined for each course. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6147

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Health Physics (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Health Physics (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme Health Physics is a branch of science in which the methods and concepts of physics are used practically in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases. The main areas of use of radiation in medicine can be grouped into radiotherapy, radiology and nuclear medicine. With the introduction of radiation in the field of health, a medical physicist was also needed. Operating in the field of health sciences universities, medical schools, hospitals and private hospitals within the Ministry of Health, radiation oncology centers, nuclear medicine centers and these centers are opened and radiodiagnostic centres are equipped with modern diagnostic and treatment equipment with advanced technology that works. Therefore, the need for specialists in health physics has reached serious heights in our country. In order for these devices to work efficiently, they are not harmful to patients, and the correct diagnosis and treatment can be made with these devices, and the quality of diagnosis and treatment can be improved, specialized medical physicists with graduate (at least master's) education in the relevant field are needed. To meet the requirement of a Health Physics Specialist trained in our country. Students who will graduate from this program will ensure the correct and efficient use of high-tech diagnostic and therapeutic devices used in branches of medicine related to ionizing rays, such as radiation oncology centers, nuclear medical centers, radiodiagnostic clinics. In addition, expert physicists who have been trained and well-trained in this regard will perform important tasks in the most accurate implementation of the planned treatment, quality safety of devices, quality control and dosimetry operations, and ensuring overall radiation safety. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Enis ÖZYAR History The areas where radiation is most intensively used in medicine are radiation therapy, radiology and nuclear medicine. As radiation began to be used in the field of Health, practical use of the methods and concepts of physics and experts of this branch of science were needed. Radiation oncology, radiology and nuclear medicine departments in hospitals operating in the field of Health Sciences have modern diagnostic and therapeutic devices. In order for these devices to work efficiently, make accurate diagnosis and treatment, and improve the quality of diagnosis and treatment, specialized health physicists with graduate (at least graduate) training in the relevant field are needed. The current program at our university contributes to the training of health physics specialist staff that our country needs. Graduate students will ensure accurate and efficient use of diagnostic and therapeutic devices in the Departments of radiation oncology, nuclear medicine, and radiology, where ionizing radiation is used. Health physics experts 'job descriptions include Quality Control and safety of treatment devices, planning patients' treatment, and ensuring overall radiation safety. Acıbadem University Institute of Health Sciences since 2010, mainly Acıbadem Maslak Hospital Radiation Oncology Department continues its educational activities and gave its first graduates in 2012. Qualification Awarded Health Physicist ( Master's Degree with dissertation ) Admission Requirements At least a bachelor's (4 years) of a higher education program education physics, engineering physics and nuclear energy engineering, degree, transcripts provide, or document that may be awarded until the registration period. For language proficiency, Foreign language exams accepted by the Council of Higher Education; TOEFL-IBT: minimum 60 points YDS / UDS/KPDS/YÖKDIL: at least 50 points For candidates who do not have a foreign language certificate, they will be asked to have received at least 50 points from the Foreign Language proficiency exam, which will be conducted by the Department of Foreign Languages of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar university. For foreign candidates, they will be asked to have at least 70 points for YDS/UDS/KPDS/YÖKDIL, at least 84 points for TOEFL-IBT, at least 71 points for PTE Academic, at CAE B level, at CPE C level. For scientific competence, For graduate education, to have received the least valid score from one of the following exams (result documents must be valid until the application date) Get at least 55 points from one of any type of score from the Academic staff and Graduate Education Entrance Examination (ALES) , GRE at least 149 for foreign students or GMAT at least 450 points. Higher Grade Transition After the completion of the master's degree, students can apply to a doctoral program. Our university does not yet have a doctoral program. Graduation Requirements Students who take courses in the program, fulfill the general criteria and successfully completed the thesis and thesis defense get passing grades found successful in the examination set by the Institute of Health Sciences is deemed to have successfully completed subject to the Graduate School. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can work as a needed health physicist in the radiation oncology, nuclear medicine and radiology departments of private, government and University Hospitals. He can work as a Radiation Protection Officer, Application Specialist and/or service/sales units in companies licensed to work with ionizing radiation. Assessment and Grading Midterm exam/ homework/ project, etc. and a final exam are conducted by the instructors who teach the course for each course. Evaluation criteria for each course are specified in the course information packages. Final exams are held in the date range determined according to the academic calendar announced by Acıbadem University Institute of Health Sciences at the beginning of the year. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Healthcare Management (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Healthcare Management (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme The objective of the program is to train competent scientists/health administrators, who will follow-up innovations in health sector, who will plan, carry-out and evaluate the outcome of resources and researches, within changing and improving health sector. The program also aims to train qualified research associates and academician candidates, who are needed more and more. Education period is 2 years. The first year of the program consists of theoretical classes and the final year is the thesis study. Throughout his/her education period, a student should take at least 7 courses, not to add up to less than 21 credits and one none-credit seminar, during first two semesters and the thesis study should be completed in the second year. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Mesut ÇİMEN ECTS and Erasmus Coordinator of the Department Instructor M. Emre Güvey History Those responsible for the health sector in all countries of the world, on the one hand, to manage the increasing and diverse health service demands; On the other hand, it tries to plan the irrepressible increase in health expenditures with sustainability efforts. In this context, for the purpose of protecting and improving the health status of societies, in the health sector, which is constantly growing, changing and increasing competition, "health management" has been trained and conceptual, analytical and technical knowledge that can develop more effective, more efficient and more innovative solutions to the problems of the sector, The need for skilled and talented managers is increasing. In Turkey, health management / health care management / health institutions are located near the 40 degree programs in the field of management. With the increase in programs, the need for qualified academicians trained in the field of health management is increasing. The aim of this program is; To train scientists who can conduct scientific research on the knowledge and skills acquired by the participants in their undergraduate period, access the information, make evaluations and recommendations regarding the field, and specialize in different areas of health management. Another aim of this program is to contribute to the training of healthcare managers and leaders who can collaborate with different disciplines who have research, planning and application knowledge in the field of health management. The program includes a large number of elective courses as well as compulsory courses. Thus, students will have the opportunity to take many elective courses specific to the issues that are important in today's health sector, and to better understand the characteristics of the sector and to develop solutions. As a result; In addition to the training of research assistants and academician candidates who will follow the innovations in the field of health management in the changing and developing health sector, plan resources and researches, and evaluate the results, it is aimed to bring in competent science specialist healthcare managers with field knowledge. Qualification Awarded Master's Degree Admission Requirements Those who have graduated from domestic and foreign schools (their equivalence must be approved by YÖK) at the four-year undergraduate level can apply to the Health Management Master's Program. To have 55 points from Academic Personnel and Postgraduate Education Entrance Exam (ALES), at least 50 points from KPDS, ÜDS or YDS for foreign language requirement, 50 points from Foreign Language Proficiency Exam held by the Department for candidates who do not have language proficiency. In addition, it is necessary to pass the written and interview exam. Higher Grade Transition Students who graduate from this program can transfer to higher degree programs permitted by laws and regulations. Graduation Requirements The student must be successful by taking the minimum number of courses, seminar course and thesis that make up the graduation requirement in the program. For graduation from graduate programs determined by the Institute of Health Sciences; The student's GPA must be at least 2.70 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students who graduate from the program; Hospitals (private and public hospitals), Ministry of Health central and affiliated institutions, Universities and Research Institutions, Rehabilitation Centers, Home Care Services Consulting Firms, Health Insurance Companies, Pharmaceuticals and Medical Supplies Companies. Assessment and Grading Midterm exams / exams, homework, projects, reports, and final exams are used as assessment and evaluation methods to evaluate students. For graduation, the GPA in the program must be at least 2.80 out of 4. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Healthcare Management (Without Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Healthcare Management (Without Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 1,5 Max.Program Time (Year) 1,5 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme The objective of the program is to train health administrators and leaders for Turkey’s health sector. Program is particularly suitable for new graduates who are willing to make a career in health sector and also for health profesionals who would like to enhance their competence and accelerate their careers. Education period is 1 and a half years; students should take at least 10 courses which shouldn’t be less than 30 credits in total and also complete their semester projects. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Mesut ÇİMEN ECTS and Erasmus Coordinator of the Department Instructor M. Emre Güvey History Turkey health sector in recent years has gained a dynamic sector as characterized in the past for several reasons. This situation has increased the need for managers with conceptual, analytical and technical knowledge, skills and talents who can develop more effective, more efficient and more innovative solutions to the problems of the sector and even direct the sector. The main purpose of this program, Turkey is contributing to the training of health managers and leaders for the health sector. In Turkey, health management / health care management / health institutions that provide postgraduate education in the field of university management are available. However, this proposed program differs from existing programs in two respects. First, the proposed program is a first in its field, as it includes a number of elective courses to be given in modular format, as well as the basic courses to be given per semester. Thus, students will have the opportunity to take many elective courses specific to the issues that are important in today's health sector, and thus better understand the characteristics of the sector and develop solutions. The second characteristic that differs from the program in the health sector Turkey is always "the first" signature has taken great and powerful "brand" with knowledge of the Acibadem Healthcare Group, is a program that will integrate the skills and experience. This privilege will enable the students to be taken into the program to benefit from the knowledge, skills and experience of the Acıbadem Health Group and thus, to get to know the characteristics and functioning of a successful healthcare group and its affiliated health institutions. Since the health sector has many important distinguishing features, it will be an important privilege to benefit from the knowledge, skills and experience of Acıbadem Healthcare Group in terms of being a successful manager. Qualification Awarded Non-thesis master degree Admission Requirements Students who have graduated from domestic and foreign schools (their equivalence must be approved by YÖK) can apply to the Health Management Master's Program without thesis. At least 50 points from KPDS, ÜDS or YDS, minimum 50 points from the Foreign Language Proficiency Exam held by the Department for candidates who do not have language proficiency, and to be successful in written and interview exams. Higher Grade Transition Students who graduate from this program can transfer to higher degree programs permitted by laws and regulations. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate from the Master's Program in Health Management, students must take at least 30 credits in three or four semesters at the earliest and pass the exams of these courses (30 credits correspond to 10 courses) and prepare a graduation project on their subjects in accordance with the appropriate thesis forma and must have successfully submitted. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students who graduate from the program; Hospitals (private and public hospitals), Ministry of Health central and affiliated institutions, Universities and Research Institutions, Rehabilitation Centers, Home Care Services Consulting Firms, Health Insurance Companies, Pharmaceuticals and Medical Supplies Companies. Assessment and Grading Midterm exams / exams, homework, projects, reports, and final exams are used as assessment and evaluation methods to evaluate students. For graduation, the GPA in the program must be at least 2.80 out of 4. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Histology And Embryology (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Histology And Embryology (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme Our faculty members attend the theoretical and practical courses of the students of the Faculty of Medicine at the undergraduate level. Faculty members of the Department also take charge and guide in the modules of problem-based teaching (PBL) in the 1st, 2nd and 3rd grades of the Faculty of Medicine, as well as the Institute of Health Sciences Histology - Embryology, Medical Biotechnology Master's and Doctorate Program and Biomaterials. They are also included in the postgraduate education staff. 6 students, whose advisors are in the Histology - Embryology Master's program and Medical Biotechnology Master's program, in which our faculty members are involved, continue their education. Our Department started education in 2009 with the establishment of our university. Head of Department Prof. Dr. serap arbak Head of Department Prof. Dr. serap arbak History The Department of Histolopji and Embryology started its education in 2009 and produce the first graduate in 2013. Qualification Awarded M.Sc degree in Histology and Embryology Admission Requirements To be a graduate of Medicine, Veterinary Medicine, Dentistry, Biology, Molecular Biology and genetics, Pharmaceutical, bioengineering, medicine, engineering, bioengineering and genetic,s to provide a transcript or document that may be awarded until the registration period (applications from different departments will be evaluated by the related committee) The equivalence of diplomas obtained from foreign countries must be approved by the YÖK. adopted by the board of higher education foreign language exams; TOEFL-IBT: minimum 60 points YDS / UDS/KPDS/YÖKDIL: at least 50 points For candidates who do not have a foreign language certificate, they will be asked to have received at least 50 points from the Foreign Language proficiency exam, which will be conducted by the Department of Foreign Languages of Acıbadem university. Higher Grade Transition Those who complete the master's degree program can receive a doctorate in histology and embryology or other basic sciences Graduation Requirements Students who have successfully completed their thesis study and have been successful in the thesis defense exam are considered to have successfully completed their master's degree provided that they have a passing grade determined by the Institute of Health Sciences. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates of the master's program in basic medical sciences histology and Embryology can be a researcher and instructor, may continue their academic careers with PhD, or can work as a researcher in various laboratories.A graduate student who is the subject of a master's thesis related to reproductive medicine can obtain a Certificate in the Laboratory of In Vitro Fertilization embryology and work in this field if he wishes. Assessment and Grading Studies like Midterm/homework/project, etc. are conducted by the instructors who teach the course for each course. and final exam is held at the end of each semester. The course passing grade for each course is seventy points. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=64

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Management in Pharmaceutical industry (Without Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Management in Pharmaceutical industry (Without Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 1,5 Max.Program Time (Year) 1,5 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme The demand for qualified pharmacists, chemists, chemical engineers, doctors of medicine and biologists to work in various capacities in the pharmaceutical industry is increasing each day. The Pharmaceutical industry is seeking an employee profile who has a grasp of pharmaceutical production processes, who can contribute to the improvement and optimization of systems, who has the ability of analytical thinking, who can determine problems and develop solutions using cause and effect relationships, who has knowledge of and the skills to acquire knowledge of basic GMP (good manufacturing processes) and quality assurance, analytical method development, formulation and basic manufacturing processes. There is also a need for qualified and trained employees with the required foundation for the sector to work in the areas of sales, marketing, distribution, licensing and patenting. Currently, it can be seen that pharmacists, medical doctors, chemists, chemical engineers and biologists working in the pharmaceutical industry are showing an intense and growing interest in post graduate programs. The current program, is a post graduate program where the subjects required in the pharmaceutical industry are given as a whole. With a large number of elective courses to be opened by a large number of experts considering the "requests and wishes of the students", students will be able to gain knowledge of the area they work in. In particular in a city such as Istanbul, which is intertwined with the Pharmaceutical Industry, the main purpose of this problem, which will be carried out in co-operation with the industry and university, is to provide students who will serve in national companies that have made international expansion as well as international companies, to educate them as qualified members of staff sought by the pharmaceutical industry in our country and abroad, and to ensure employment opportunities in the correct fields for individuals who have completed the program. The "Management in the Pharmaceutical Industry"; will ensure that its students receive specialist education in the knowledge and skills expected of employees in the pharmaceutical industry for all the stages of a drug, from the discovery of its active ingredient to being being used and consumed by patients (active ingredient production, analysis, quality control, formulation, regulatory affairs, factory management, customer relations, sales and marketing). Head of Department Prof. Dr. Mert Ülgen History Pharmaceutical Industry Management Master's Program is the first and only non-thesis master's degree program aimed at new graduates who are aiming to work in the pharmaceutical industry, or those who are already working in the pharmaceutical industry; and provides information on all areas of the Pharmaceutical Industry. The program provides Students to be specialized in the fields they work and to be equipped with current information in line with the demands of the Pharmaceutical Industry. Qualification Awarded Master Degree without Thesis Admission Requirements Graduates of Pharmacy, Medicine, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biology, Molecular Biology and Genetics, Faculty of Health Sciences, Faculty of Business, Economics, and other related four-year programs approved by YÖK may apply to the Pharmaceutical Industry Management Master’s Program. ALES/GRE exam is not a requirement. For foreign language proficiency, certificate from the foreign language exam accepted by the Council of Higher Education (at least 50 points or equivalence from KPDS or YDS, or if it has received a score of equivalent), or for those who do not have a foreign language proficiency certificate; Turkish Language Proficiency Exam given by Acıbadem M.A.A. University which is a professional translation from English to Turkish must be at least 50 points. TOMER: B2 is required for international applicants. Higher Grade Transition Individuals who graduate from this program, can switch to doctoral programs in accordance with regulations. Graduation Requirements In order to graduate from the Pharmaceutical Industry Management Masters Program, students must take at least 30 credit courses in three semesters and be successful in the exams of these courses (30 credits, corresponds to 10 courses) and have successfully submitted a final project related to their subjects according to the appropriate format and must have successfully submitted them. Students can graduate in three semesters if they complete at least 30 credits and a final project. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students who graduate from this program can work in all areas of pharmaceutical companies. Assessment and Grading 40% and 60% of the grades taken from the midterm and final exams are used for the evaluation of the students. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Medical Biotechnology (With Thesis) (English)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Medical Biotechnology (With Thesis) (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme Medical Biotechnology is a graduate program dedicated to provide education and research opportunities in life sciences for the development of innovative technologies to improve human health. The program covers subjects like recombinant DNA technology, protein engineering, synthetic biology, tissue engineering, drug and vaccine development, rapid diagnostics, personalized medicine and gene therapy. Students have the opportunity to work with highly experienced researchers from a wide area of biotechnology, in laboratories equipped with elaborate modern instruments and state of art infrastructure. We give importance to develop collaborative projects with industry reinforced by national grant programs. All students with Turkish citizenship, accepted in this program, receive full education scholarship. Most of the students are additionally supported by research grants. The students are expected to spend full time in the university for their education and research. Part-time study is not accepted for this program. We encourage students with high enthusiasm of research, to join us. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Tanıl KOCAGÖZ History The Department of Medical Biotechnology, which is under the Institute of Health Sciences, was a student for the first time in 2016-2017. In 2018, it gave its first graduate. Qualification Awarded Master of Science in medical biotechnology (MSc) Admission Requirements At least a bachelor's (4 years) education in a higher education program in the Department of Biochemistry Department of biology, bioengineering, biomedical engineering, Biosystems Engineering, Biotechnology and Molecular Biology, Genetics and bioinformatics, genetics and Bioengineering, chemical and Biological Engineering, Engineering and Natural Science. Programs, faculty of dentistry, faculty of pharmacy, food Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, Department of medical biology, Medicine, medicine, engineering, Veterinary students, who graduated from the faculties and departments, transcript data (transcripts) may be awarded by documenting that by providing or until the registration period may apply. Application conditions are announced in the announcements tab of the Institute of Health Sciences. The assessment is two-fold: Written Exam (aims to measure general biology knowledge; must already choose; is English.) Oral exam (students who pass the Written Exam can participate; performed by a jury; is in English.) Higher Grade Transition Those who have completed the master's program can receive a doctorate in the field of life sciences. Graduation Requirements Students who take courses in the program, fulfill the general criteria and successfully completed the thesis and thesis defense get passing grades found successful in the examination set by the Institute of Health Sciences is deemed to have successfully completed subject to the Graduate School. Occupational Profiles of Graduates They can find work as academics in universities or as researchers in public/private organizations. Assessment and Grading Aimed at measuring the learning goals set for each course, exam, homework, project, etc. methods are used for measurement and evaluation. Criteria specific to each course are defined in the course information package https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=71

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Medical Microbiology (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Medical Microbiology (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Medical Microbiology is a science of identifying microorganisms that cause disease in humans. Structure and classification, reproductive characteristics, pathogenic mechanisms, diagnostic methods and antimicrobial agents of the microorganisms are the main areas of study. In Medical Microbiology, where pathogenic microorganisms that cause major infectious diseases are examined, researches that will reveal the relations of various diseases and/or syndromes with microorganisms and to develop diagnostic methods are among the other study subjects of Medical Microbiology. With the proposed master's program, it is aimed that candidates will work in the field of microbiology at international standards with the latest technology and scientific research methods. After the master’s degree, the graduates are welcomed to proceed in the doctorate programme to take a place in variable fields of Medical Microbiology as in industry, academics. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Yeşim Gürol History The program will accept students in 2021-22 education year for the first time Qualification Awarded Those who can complete the program successfully is awarded with the title of “Master of Science in Medical Microbiology (MSc)” Admission Requirements To be a graduate of Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Veterinary Medicine, School of Science Department of Biology, or Molecular Biology and Genetics or Biotechnology, When deemed necessary there will be an examination for science proficiency. To get minimum score of 70 in Digital part of the Selection Exam for Academic Personnel and Graduate Studies, For international students, GRE minimum 152, or GMAT score of minimum 470 are required. Foreign language exam scores of TOEFL-IBT 70 (minimum), Foreign Language Exam (FLE) test of 60 (minimum) is required. Higher Grade Transition To achieve the MSc Graduate title, as mentioned in Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Directory of Master of Science program, the MSc program consists of a total of twenty-one credits, and article presentation, seminar and thesis studies with 120 ECDC. Graduation Requirements To achieve the MSc Graduate title, as mentioned in Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Directory of Master of Science program, the MSc program consists of a total of twenty-one credits, at least for seven lectures, seminars, competency exam, thesis proposal and conductance and 120 ECDC. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates of Medical Microbiology MSc Program will have the required knowledge and skills to be approved to PhD programs not only local universities but also in international universities, owing to the English program. They can also be occupied in private sector or in the government in microbiology. Assessment and Grading The examinations may be as written, oral, homework and presentation formats. During the Covid-19 pandemic, the exams may be made online in oral or written forms, as decided. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6150

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Nursing (Without Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Nursing (Without Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 1,5 Max.Program Time (Year) 1,5 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme Acıbadem University Health Sciences Institute Nursing Graduate Programs’ goal is to train specialist nurses with awareness, who could apply innovations in healthcare technologies to health field and who can also participate in prevention of basic health issues, treatment processes, care and rehabilitation, as well as those who can perform studies that aim to increase health institutes’ administrative necessities and care quality. It is our goal to train qualified, creative and enquiring individuals, who are experts in their fields and able to study post-graduate degree, with the education provided in graduate program. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Ükke Karabacak History The Program accepts students from the 2014-2015 academic year. Qualification Awarded Those who successfully complete the program receive the title of specialist nurse. Admission Requirements Graduate from one of the Departments of Nursing or Health Officer of the Faculty of Nursing, School of Nursing, Faculty of Health Sciences, School of Health Sciences and School of Health. The equivalence of diplomas obtained from foreign countries must be approved by the YÖK. Foreign language exams accepted by the Council of Higher Education; TOEFL-IBT: minimum 60 points YDS / UDS/KPDS/YÖKDIL: at least 50 points For candidates who do not have a foreign language certificate, they will be asked to obtain at least 50 points from the Foreign Language proficiency exam to be held by Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University. Higher Grade Transition None Graduation Requirements Students who work taking lessons whic are pre-requisite of the program by fulfilling the general criteria set by the Institute of Health Sciences shall be deemed successfully completed the program. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates of the Program can be appointed as a specialist nurse in medical institutions. Assessment and Grading Midterm exam/homework/project, etc.by the instructors who teach the course for each course and a final exam are conducted. Evaluation criteria for each course are specified in the course information package. Final exams are held in the date range determined according to the academic calendar announced by Acıbadem University Institute of Health Sciences at the beginning of the year. Faculty members evaluate all the work, assignments, midterms and final exams during the semester and make the grading according to the course passing grade system determined by the Institute. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=63
