fields.content: Master Of Science in Nutrition And Dietetics (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme Nutrition and Diet Specialist is a certified person whose areas of expertise are included but not limited to; - Growth, development and life-long protection and improvement of all individuals’ health, - Designation of individual nutrition’s and mass feeding’s plans and programs in accordance with nutrition science’s principles for the enhancement of quality of life, - Research, assessment and solution finding of health problems stemmed from nutritional element, food and nutrition, - Providing proper use of existing food sources in balance with economy and health rules, - Enlightment of the individual and the community about these issues to enable adaptation of physiological, psychological and sociological lifestyle, - Planning, education, enforcement and observation of diet programs based on the combination of natural and therapeutic nutritions, which are in consistent with medical and surgical treatments of congenital and acquired diseases and other special conditions. The aim of Acibadem University Health Sciences Institute’s ‘Nutrition and Dietetics Graduate Program with thesis’ is to educate scholars, who are or will be a part of researcher/specialist team; and thus to teach them how to plan and perform researches in nutrition and dietetics field in consistent with changing health necessities and consequently contribute to universal science by way of evaluating the results; and also to educate nutrition and dietetic specialists, who are intelligent, efficient, competent and knowledgeable at national and international level and capable to contribute to national policies. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Murat BAŞ History The program has been accepting students since 2014-1015 academic year. Qualification Awarded Master Degree, Msc Admission Requirements The following requirements are applied to applicants wishing to enroll in a master's program: a) Applicants should hold a bachelor's diploma accepted by the Institute Board b) Applicants must hold the minimum ALES score determined by the Institute Board not being less than 55 in the score type required for the program applied. Exam scores from international exams recognized by the Higher Education Board such as GRE or GMAT are also accepted on the condition that the scores received are not less than the minimum standard score determined by the Higher Education Board. The Senate, however, may raise the accepted minimum standard score if they wish to do so. c) Applicants are required to take a language proficiency exam administered by the University on the date announced. The results of the exam are sent to relevant Institutes. The acceptable score on the exam is determined and announced by the Administrative Board of the Institute. d) Applicants holding an acceptable score from another language exam such as TOEFL, KPDS, YDS, ÜDS are exempt from the language exam administered by the University. e) Applicants applying for a graduate program in languages must take a proficiency exam in a language other than that of their field of study Higher Grade Transition Graduates; Nutrition and Dietetics, Child Health, Nutrition, Internal Medicine, Public Health, Phytotherapy and Sports Sciences can apply to doctora programs. Graduation Requirements A student is required to successfully complete the designated program of courses meet a minimum of 120 ECTS credit requirement and have a minimum GPA of 2.70/4.00 and no FF, FG or NA grades and to prepare a seminar and a thesis. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can be employed in hospitals, food service systems and in related departments of universities. Assessment and Grading Students who are successful by taking the compulsory and elective courses required for graduation in the program, achieving the grade point average determined by the institute of health sciences, and successfully completing their thesis work and defense, complete their education successfully. Decal exams/exams, homework, project, report, and final exam are used as measurement and evaluation methods for evaluating students. For graduation, the overall GPA in the program must be at least 2.70 out of 4. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Perfusion Techniques (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Perfusion Techniques (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Head of Department Prof. Dr. Cem ALHAN History Perfusion Techniques Post Graduate Programme began education in Health Sciences Institute of Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydinlar University within 2018-2019 period. Qualification Awarded Post Graduate Degree Admission Requirements Applying will be accepted if the graduations are completed from the departments of Perfusion, Nursing or Biology or who have the Perfusionist Certificate given by the Ministry of Health. All appliers should be graduated by the licence degree. Higher Grade Transition Graduation Requirements To obtain a Post Graduate Degree, additional to the success from the theoretical courses the student should also complete the practical skills including to join at least 100 cardiac surgery operations and manage the heart-lung machine in at least 20 of them to be independently, 2 hypothermic circulatory arrest, prepare 10 blood cardioplegia, establish 4 hemo-ultrafiltration devices, prepare 2 autotransfusion sets, monitoring of 2 intraaortic balloon pump, management of 2 ECMO or ventricular support device. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates of this program will be employed in the management of extracorporeal circulation and mechanical heart support devices, artificial heart technologies. They also will have opportunity to work at heart-lung transplantation units, blood and organ preservation programmes in all kinds of surgery, in dialysis units and blood banks. Assessment and Grading Course achievement grade is obtained by examining the success of the student in midterm examinations and practical studies in the semester and final exam. The effect of the mid-term evaluations on the course grade can be up to 50%. In order to be successful in a course, the student must have at least a CC grade. In the seminar course; the student is asked to explain the depth and depth of knowledge about his thesis and his preliminary research, preparation and planning for his thesis in a fifty-minute presentation at the date determined in the examination period at the end of the semester. The student counselor who follows the seminar, decides on the success grade of the student by taking the opinions of the faculty members and staff on the subject among the audience. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=5826

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Physiology (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Physiology (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme The necessity for scientists in country, who can achieve scientific production and researches at international level particularly in medical sciences field, still exists. Acibadem University Health Sciences Institute’s Physiology Doctoral Program aims to educate qualified scientists to satisfy the necessity in Physiology field, who question and wonder, as well as who can plan and perform researches that would contribute to international literature. We are offering learning and research opportunities at laboratory and working environment which have advanced technological foundation. We are hoping to welcome you onboard, if you would like to benefit from these opportunies and to learn, research and produce together. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Güldal SÜYEN History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Department of Physiology Master of Science Program first started accepting students in the spring term of 2016-2017. In 2018, it had its first graduate. Qualification Awarded MSc in physiology Admission Requirements The Academic Personnel and Graduate Education Exam (ALES), Graduate Record Examination (GRE) or Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT) exams’ (at least 55 from ALES, at least 610 from GRE numerals or at least 450 from GMAT) ) results. To have at least 50 points or equivalent points from foreign language exams accepted by Council of Higher Education. To have at least 50 points from the Foreign Language Proficiency Exam held by Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydinlar University Foreign Languages Department. Higher Grade Transition Graduates of the Master's Program can apply for a doctorate in physiology or other basic sciences Graduation Requirements Students who have successfully completed the courses in the program and have fulfilled the criteria, who have successfully completed their thesis work and who have been successful in the thesis defense exam, are considered to have successfully completed the master's degree program provided that the GPA is at least the passing grade determined by the Institute of Health Sciences. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates of the Physiology Master's program can be researchers and lecturers in basic medical sciences, continue their academic careers with a doctoral program or work as researchers in the pharmaceutical industry and in various laboratories. Assessment and Grading For each course, the lecturers will conduct a midterm exam / homework / project etc. and one final exam. The evaluation criteria for each course are indicated in the course information packages. Instructors evaluate all work, homework, mid-term and final exams in the semester and grading them according to the course passing grade system determined by the Institute. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=62

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Physiotherapy And Rehabilitation (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Physiotherapy And Rehabilitation (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Physiotherapist is a health professional who has gained the ability to apply different assessment and treatment techniques in all kinds of injuries that lead to movement disorders, illness and old age, pain and functional disorders, and aims to improve health and quality of life. Especially in developed countries, health-promoting and disease-preventing roles of physiotherapists have been added to the therapeutic roles of physiotherapists in recent years with preventive physiotherapy and public health approaches. In this program, it is aimed to train specialized health professionals who have the knowledge and skills to meet the increasing demand for physiotherapy services, who can access and interpret information through current research and transfer it to physiotherapy and rehabilitation services, contribute to improving the health of society and provide evidence-based services. Head of Department Associate Prof. Dr. Nuray ALACA History The program has been accepting students since the 2022-2023 academic year. Qualification Awarded Master's Degree with Thesis Admission Requirements To be a graduate of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation department or Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation graduate program. Have 55 points or more from the language test. (For candidates who do not have a foreign language certificate, they will be required to score at least 60 in the Foreign Language Proficiency Exam to be held by the department.) 55 and above ALES points (For foreign students, a minimum GRE score of 149 or a GMAT score of at least 450 is required.) Undergraduate graduation score must be at least 2.50 according to the 4-point system or at least 65 according to the 100-point system Higher Grade Transition Those who successfully complete this program and receive a master's degree can continue their doctorate programs in related fields. Graduation Requirements Students who have been successful in the program by taking the courses that make up the graduation requirement and fulfilling the general criteria, have successfully completed the thesis study and been found successful in the thesis defense exam, are considered to have successfully completed their graduate education, provided that the passing grade determined by the Institute of Health Sciences. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates of the program can work as specialist physiotherapists in health institutions. Assessment and Grading Midterm exams/homework/projects etc. and a final exam are given for each course by the lecturers. Evaluation criteria for each course are specified in the course information package. Final exams are held within the dates determined according to the academic calendar announced by Acıbadem University Health Sciences Institute at the beginning of the year. Instructors evaluate all the work, homework, midterm exams and final exams during the semester and grade them according to the passing grade system determined by the Institute. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6267

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Sports Nutrition (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Sports Nutrition (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Sports Nutrition is a new and dynamic application field. Upon awareness of different sciences’ significance in athlete health and performance and the development of the market in that field, the necessity for dietitians with specific education in that field has increased. Dietitians, who are specialized in sports nutrition, work in the fields of elite athletes, recreational contestants, sports clubs, active children and military personnel, in which the physical capacity is of importance. Main responsibilities of dietitians, who work in athlete nutrition field, are providing individual, group/team counselling and planning nutrition education towards competition performance enhancement. It is important to determine the body composition with the correct methods in order to provide individual counselling for the athletes. Another responsibility of dietitians, who are specialized in sports nutrition, is to provide nutrition counselling for planning of nutrition during, before and after training. Program aims to provide access to accurate information, especially about appropriate time and dosage of ergogenic aids for students by means of access to right scientific publication and correct interpretation of the research articles. The sports centers and clubs, where the student will perform in accordance with the program, will provide opportunity to transform these information to practical application. Also, providing documentation and follow-up of the implementations about nutrition; delivering right resources about food and nutrition to trainers, instructors and parents; developing education materials by way of planning nutrition educations that are compatible with age groups; and also, providing sustainability of professional competence and skillset required for vocational practice are other responsibilities of dietitians who are specialized in sports nutrition. In order to accomplish these requirements, dietitians, who are specialized in sports nutrition, will also need graduate education with theoretical courses and practical training in exercise physiology and exercise biochemistry sciences, on top of their basic 4-year Nutrition and Dietetics undergraduate degree. One of the strong aspects of this program is that the students are able to study theoretical courses in practice at Acibadem Fulya Sports Athlete Health Center. Another strong aspect of the graduate program is that it provides the opportunity of practice for the students on the sports branch which they train or which they plan to train. By this way, students’ personal development will be achieved by means of discussions about their observations and implementations of practices. In accordance with improved athlete nutrition graduate program, dietitians will be more competent and experienced about the required assessment of the athlete; and at the same time, they will have the necessary knowledge and skillset for collaborative work with professional from other various fields. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Murat BAŞ History The program has been accepting students since 2018-2019 academic year. Qualification Awarded Sports Nutrition MSc Admission Requirements The following requirements are applied to applicants wishing to enroll in a master's program: a) Applicants should hold a bachelor's diploma accepted by the Institute Board b) Applicants must hold the minimum ALES score determined by the Institute Board not being less than 55 in the score type required for the program applied. Exam scores from international exams recognized by the Higher Education Board such as GRE or GMAT are also accepted on the condition that the scores received are not less than the minimum standard score determined by the Higher Education Board. The Senate, however, may raise the accepted minimum standard score if they wish to do so. c) Applicants are required to take a language proficiency exam administered by the University on the date announced. The results of the exam are sent to relevant Institutes. The acceptable score on the exam is determined and announced by the Administrative Board of the Institute. d) Applicants holding an acceptable score from another language exam such as TOEFL, KPDS, YDS, ÜDS are exempt from the language proficiency exam is at least 50 points. e) To be successful as a result of the interview, f) Adoption of the letter of intent prepared by the Institute Administrative Board regarding the reason for the Master's degree, g) At least two reference letters Higher Grade Transition Graduates can apply to the Ph.D. program in Nutrition and Dietetics and Sport Sciences. Graduation Requirements A student is required to successfully complete the designated program of courses meet a minimum of 21 credit requirement and have a minimum GPA of 2.70/4.00 or 65/100 and no FF, FG or NA grades. A Student has to prepare a seminar and master thesis. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduated students can work with elite athletes, recreation contestants, special groups like physically active children and military service. Assessment and Grading Students who are successful by taking the compulsory and elective courses required for graduation in the program, achieving the grade point average determined by the institute of health sciences, and successfully completing their thesis work and defense, complete their education successfully. Decal exams/exams, homework, project, report, and final exam are used as measurement and evaluation methods for evaluating students. For graduation, the overall GPA in the program must be at least 2.70 out of 4. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master of Science in Surgical Nursing (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master of Science in Surgical Nursing (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme Reasons such as the fact that individuals are more interested in health-related issues in the world and in our country and their expectations from health professionals increase, developments in care and treatment, and patient satisfaction being one of the important quality indicators for health institutions have increased the need for specialist nurses in health care fields. The aim of Acıbadem University Nursing Master's Programs is to provide evidence-based care, equipped with contemporary knowledge and skills, creative and critical thinking skills, capable of scientific research, access to information and transforming their knowledge in the field of nursing into a specialist skill, with the knowledge and skills to meet the increasing and changing care demand. To train scientific experts who can present. Nursing Master's programs give education in the fields of Emergency Nursing, Surgical Diseases Nursing, Internal Diseases Nursing, Intensive Care Nursing. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Ükke Karabacak History The Program has been accepting students since the 2010-2011 academic year. Qualification Awarded Msc with dissertation Admission Requirements 1. Having a bachelor's degree in Nursing/Health Officer. 2. To get "TOEFL-IBT 60 and YDS/UDS/KPDS/YÖKDIL 50" and above the exams approved by YÖK. 3. To get 55 and over in the numerical field from the Academic Graduate Education Entrance exam Higher Grade Transition People who have successfully completed this program and obtained a master's degree can continue doctoral programs in related fields. Graduation Requirements Students who have successfully completed their thesis study and have been successful in the thesis defense exam are considered to have successfully completed their master's degree provided that they have a passing grade determined by the Institute of Health Sciences Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates of the Program can work in medical institutions with the title of specialist nurse. Assessment and Grading For each course, midterm exam/homework/project, etc.studies and a final exam are conducted by the instructor who teaches the course Dec. Evaluation criteria for each course are specified in the course information packages. Final exams are held in the date range determined according to the academic calendar announced at the beginning of the Year at the Institute of Health Sciences of Acıbadem university. Faculty members evaluate all the work, homework, mid-term and final exams during the semester and make grading according to the course passing grade system determined by the Institute. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=58

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Biomaterials (With Thesis) (English)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Biomaterials (With Thesis) (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Biomaterials are the name given to the materials that serve as a support for the tissues and organs in the human body to carry out their functions, completely assuming their place or functions. They do not have to be of biological origin; they can be made of metal, ceramics, natural or synthetic polymers and their composites. Of these, he made contributions to the production of carbon nanotubes, change in the surface properties of materials and products, increase conductivity, orientation and strengthening. 4-dimensional materials, that is, shape-memory materials that change their shape and size over time and in response to the stimuli they receive, have opened up many new areas, ranging from cell layer engineering. Hydrogels of natural and artificial origin, medical-quality 3D printing films and graphene have contributed in many different directions. In particular, carbon structures have taken on an important function in creating surfaces that prevent cell adhesion. Advances in biomaterials have progressed so much that applications have even begun to be treated by 3D printing directly on the patient on the operating table of the injured tissue that we saw in the movies a few years ago. Tissue models are the development and use of some kind of tissue engineering product to represent a test animal, not to implant it in the body. Microfluidic technologies also provide an opportunity to study interactions very quickly with very few samples, as well as to screen for drugs. At this point, MEMS technology has also started to make contributions. Thanks to this technology, it is possible to make nano- and micro-sized patterns on materials and transfer these patterns to other pure materials. In fact, human tissue actually transmits messages to cells and tissues through small physical and chemical elements at this level. Sometimes these messages act by turning into biological and chemical signals, and sometimes they act physically. If an implant can be decorated with such signal elements, processes such as interaction with tissue, healing speed can be significantly improved. The topics that will be offered to students in our field on education and research are listed as follows: - Polymeric, Metallic and Ceramic Biomaterials; 3D Printing, Micro-Nano Patterned Surfaces, Hydrogels, Vascularization, Wound Healing, In Vitro Tissue Models, Microfluidic Systems - Tissue Engineering (Bone, Cartilage, Heart and Skeletal November, Vascular, Nerve, Skin, Ocular Tissues, etc.), 3D Tissue Scaffolds, Stem Cells - Controlled Drug Tuesday, Targeted Nanoparticles, Functional Polymer, Bioactive Scaffolds, Surface Modification - Gait Analysis, Motor Learning and Adaptation, Orthopedic Biomechanics, Sports Biomechanics, Instrumentation - Medical Simulation, Hemodialysis Membranes, Serious Gaming, Virtual/Augmented/Mixed Reality - Within the scope of our program, it is also possible to conduct R & D studies on biomaterials using freshly frozen cadavers. These mentioned methods will also show their effects more clearly in the coming years and will make important contributions to the field of health. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Vasıf Hasırcı Vice-co-ordinator Lecturer, Phd. Deniz Yücel Vice-co-ordinator Associate Prof. Dr. Halime Kenar History The field of biomaterials has started to gain visibility and importance since the late 1970s in the world and in our country. The first studies on this subject started with implants that did not have living components, and in time, with the addition of proteins and enzymes, and then cells, tissue engineering and later regenerative medicine fields were established. At Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, studies in this field started in the 2010s through courses, Acıbadem Biomaterials Application and Research Center was established in 2020, and again in 2020, a Biomaterials Master's Program was established under the ACU Institute of Science. Qualification Awarded Biomaterials Master of Science (MSc) Admission Requirements In order to get acceptance for the Biomaterials Master of Science program, candidates must graduate from the departments of Medical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Biology, Molecular Biology and Genetics, Chemistry, Physics, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Faculty of Medicine, Faculty of Dentistry, Faculty of Pharmacy with at least a bachelor's degree (4 years). (Applications coming from outside of these departments will be evaluated by the oral exam to be held by the relevant committee. Candidates who score 70 and above will be considered successful). Application requirements are updated in the announcements tab of the Graduate School of Sciences. Higher Grade Transition Those who complete the Master's Program can start a doctorate program in life sciences and engineering. Graduation Requirements Students who have been successful in the compulsory courses, who have successfully completed the thesis study and thesis defense exam are considered successful provided that the overall grade point average is at least the passing grade determined by the Graduate School of Natural and Applied Sciences. Occupational Profiles of Graduates The graduates can work as academicians at universities or as researchers in public/private institutions, as well as as manufacturers and researchers in the medical device industry. Assessment and Grading The methods such as exams, assignments and projects are used for the assesment and grading the learning objectives determined for each course. The specific criteria for each course are determined in the information package of the courses. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6126

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Biomedical Engineering (With Thesis) (English)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Biomedical Engineering (With Thesis) (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Biomedical Engineering Master’s Program (BME MSc.) offers courses specialized in biomedical electronics, biomechanics, bioengineering, bioinformatics, biophotonics, physiology, neuroscience and system biology as well as clinical engineering, quality management in healthcare, healthcare technology management, medical device standards, design and innovation in medical device technologies. In addition to the theoretical courses and laboratory applications, the clinical studies are carried out in cooperation with hospitals and healthcare professionals. In this respect, each course in the curriculum is designed to include a clinical project. Biomedical Engineering is the field that deals with the research and development of novel technologies needed in healthcare environments. Our BME MSc. program offers a variety of courses and expertise in following concentration areas: Biomaterials Nanomedicine Biotechnological Drug Development Neuroscience/Neuroimaging Biomechanics Biosensors Computational Biology Artificial Intelligence in healthcare Our program is structured to include “Biophotonics“, “Bioengineering,” “Biomedical Signal and Image Processing,“ “Biomechanics,“ “System Biology and Bioinformatics,” and “Neuroscience ” tracks. As our program offers a wide range of courses as required by the scope, it is supported by several elective courses offered by the Graduate Programs of Medical Biotechnology, Health Physics, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Physiology and Social Sciences. Program Başkanı Prof. Dr. Ata Akın History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Biomedical Engineering Master’s Program (BME MSc.) offers courses specialized in biomedical electronics, biomechanics, bioengineering, bioinformatics, biophotonics, physiology, neuroscience and system biology as well as clinical engineering, quality management in healthcare, healthcare technology management, medical device standards, design and innovation in medical device technologies. In addition to the theoretical courses and laboratory applications, the clinical studies are carried out in cooperation with hospitals and healthcare professionals. In this respect, each course in the curriculum is designed to include a clinical project. Biomedical Engineering is the field that deals with the research and development of novel technologies needed in healthcare environments. Our BME MSc. program offers a variety of courses and expertise in following concentration areas: • Biomaterials • Nanomedicine • Biotechnological Drug Development • Neuroscience/Neuroimaging • Biomechanics • Biosensors • Computational Biology • Artificial Intelligence in healthcare Our program is structured to include “Biophotonics“, “Bioengineering,” “Biomedical Signal and Image Processing,“ “Biomechanics,“ “System Biology and Bioinformatics,” and “Neuroscience ” tracks. As our program offers a wide range of courses as required by the scope, it is supported by several elective courses offered by the Graduate Programs of Medical Biotechnology, Health Physics, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Physiology and Social Sciences. Qualification Awarded Students receive a "Biomedical Engineering" degree and a graduate diploma upon graduation after 2 years of education. (MSc Degree) Admission Requirements Requires Undergraduate degree (4 yrs.) from one of the following departments/faculties: Medical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Industrial Engineering, System Engineering, Informatics, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical and Biological Engineering, Mathematics, Biology, Molecular Biology and Genetics, Bioengineering, Physics , Chemistry, Medicine, Dentistry, Veterinary; applicants will be able to apply either by submitting transcript or by documenting proof of completion until enrollment date. Higher Grade Transition Students who successfully complete this program will be able to apply to national and international doctoral programs. Graduation Requirements Students who have been successful by taking the courses that make up the graduation requirement in the program and fulfilling the criteria, who have successfully completed the thesis study and are successful in the thesis defense exam, are considered to have successfully completed their master's education with thesis, provided that their overall grade point average is at least the passing grade determined by the Graduate School of Natural and Applied Sciences. Occupational Profiles of Graduates They can find jobs as academics at universities or as researchers in public/private institutions. They can find employment opportunities as manufacturers and researchers in the medical device industry. Assessment and Grading 1) Exams; There are four types as midterm, final exam, make-up exam and make-up exam. (2) Midterm exams can be made in courses. Projects, homework, laboratory, workshop and similar studies done during the semester can also replace the midterm exam. (3) The final exam can be given in the form of a written exam, project delivery, homework delivery, oral presentation and so on. The number and form of the midterm and final exams of a course, the rate that will affect the course success grade, and the evaluation principles of the exams are determined by the relevant faculty member and by taking the opinion of the institute department head. These notifications are announced to the students at the beginning of the semester by the student affairs department. (4) A make-up exam may be given for the midterm exam. If the student has a valid excuse and applies to the head of the department with a petition within five working days from the end of the excuse, he is given the right to take the make-up exam in the same semester with the approval of the head of the relevant department and the decision of the institute board of directors. (5) In order to increase the grade point average or the grade of the course, successful courses can be repeated without requiring attendance, or courses accepted as equivalent by the head of the institute department can be taken. Courses to be repeated are determined by the written request of the student, the proposal of the institute department head and the decision of the institute board of directors. The last grade taken from the repeated course is valid for the calculation of the overall weighted grade. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6066

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Molecular And Translational Biomedicine (With Thesis) (English)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Molecular And Translational Biomedicine (With Thesis) (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Acıbadem University (ACU) Molecular and Translational Biomedicine Master's Program is established to transfer knowledge, concepts and technologies in basic and applied biomedicine research to young researchers who want to specialize in this field. Students participating in this program will have the opportunity to work on various subjects such as genetic disorders, cancer, stem cells and neurodegenerative diseases. During these studies, omics technologies, animal experiments, cell biology, molecular biochemistry, genetics and molecular biology research methods are applied. The program will shed light to advancements for the diagnosis, classification and treatment of diseases by illuminating the molecular and physiological mechanisms in cells, tissues and organs in normal and disease states, in an environment with advanced technology and research methods. By definition, "Translational Science" includes understanding the scientific and functional principles underlying the translational stages. To go into a little more detail, translation means transforming laboratory and clinical research into practices that will improve the health of society and individuals. Laboratory research falls within the scope of basic research and aims to elucidate the basic molecular mechanisms of physiological balance, disease and behavioral mechanisms. The foundation and all subsequent stages of translational science are based on these basic research. The next stage of translational biomedicine is pre-clinical research, which can also be defined as the bridge connecting medicine and basic research. At this stage, mechanisms discovered during basic research are tested using human and animal cell lines, animal models, and/or human or animal tissue samples. These tests include the discovery or repositioning of new drugs, devices or diagnostic kits. In short, the aim of the Molecular and Translational Biomedicine Master's program is to contribute to the training of students who will carry our country to the position of innovative countries in this field by continuing basic and preclinical research that will improve human diagnosis and treatment. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Eda TAHİR TURANLI History Translational Science covers the comprehension of the scientific and functional principles underlying the stages of translation. To be more specific, translation means that the conversion of laboratory and clinical research into applications that will improve the health of society and individuals. Laboratory research is within the scope of basic research and aims to elucidate the basic molecular mechanisms of disease and behavioral mechanisms. The foundation of Translational Science and all subsequent stages are also based on these fundamental research. The next phase of Translational biomedicine is pre-clinical research, which can also be defined as the bridge connecting medicine and basic research. At this stage, human and animal cell lines, animal models and/or human or animal tissue samples using the mechanisms discovered during basic research are being tested. These tests include the discovery or repositioning of new drugs, devices or diagnostic kits. Qualification Awarded Master of Science Admission Requirements Admission and registration conditions can be found in detail on the" application Conditions " page: http://www.acibadem.edu.tr/fbe-molekuler-translasyonel-biyotip-basvuru-kosullari Higher Grade Transition Students who successfully complete this program will be able to apply to national and international PhD programs. Graduation Requirements For graduation, Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Postgraduate education regulations are applied, and the student is expected to create a master thesis. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can carry out basic and preclinical researches that will improve diagnosis and treatment for humans as scientists who are capable of conducting laboratory research in line with the new trends emerging in the field of health using new generation technologies and can support these researches with preclinical studies, and can carry out studies that will carry our country to the position of innovative countries. Our graduates can either carry themselves to the next level of education by continuing their doctorate, or they can work in departments such as R&D, production and clinic in the sector. Assessment and Grading Measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the "Course Teaching Plan". Regarding exams and course grades, Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Postgraduate Education Regulations are applied. Various assessment and evaluation methods such as midterm exams, quizzes, applications, projects, reports and finals are used to evaluate students. For graduation, Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University graduate education regulations are applied, and the student is expected to create a master thesis. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=5746

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Cognitive Neuropsychology Master’s Program (With Thesis)
fields.content: Cognitive Neuropsychology Master’s Program (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Cognitive Neuropsychology Master's Program was established in 2024 and began accepting its first students in the 2025-2026 academic year. The faculty of the Cognitive Neuropsychology Master's Program currently includes Prof. Dr. Murat Kurt, Assoc. Prof. Belma Bekçi, Assist. Prof. Bernis Sütçübaşı, Research Assistant Tuğrul Torun, and other faculty members from the Department of Psychology. The program is currently being taught and researched by 1 full-time professor, 1 associate professor, 1 assistant professor, and 1 research assistant. Qualification Awarded Cognitive Neuropsychologist Admission Requirements The following conditions are required to apply for the Cognitive Neuropsychology Master's Program: Applicants must have graduated from a Psychology undergraduate program to be eligible to apply for this master's program. a) They must have obtained a minimum of 65 standard points in the ALES (Academic Personnel and Postgraduate Education Entrance Exam) from the Equal Weight score type, and their overall GPA must be at least 65. In cases where the overall GPA is equal, priority is given to those with a higher undergraduate GPA. b) Although the program is conducted in Turkish, students are expected to engage with academic sources and literature in English throughout the coursework. Therefore, applicants are required to provide proof of English language proficiency through one of the foreign language exams recognized by the Council of Higher Education: a minimum score of 70 in the TOEFL-IBT, or at least 60 in the YDS, ÜDS, KPDS, or YÖKDİL exams. c) Applicants who do not have a valid language score must take the English Proficiency Exam administered by the Department of Foreign Languages at Acıbadem University and score at least 60. d) For each program application period, the Institute forms an evaluation committee consisting of three primary and one alternate members recommended by the Department Head. The committee members are selected from those who work in the Psychology department. e) Applicants are initially assessed through a written scientific examination. Those who score 70 or higher are invited to an oral interview. Candidates are expected to be successful in both stages. ALES scores and undergraduate GPAs are also considered in the overall admission evaluation. f) The equivalence of diplomas obtained from foreign countries is verified by the Council of Higher Education (YÖK). Students who graduate from foreign universities must have a very good command of Turkish. Higher Grade Transition Graduates can apply to PhD programs. Graduation Requirements The student must have achieved all the courses in the program and not have an FF, FD or P grade. In this program, students must have a minimum of 120 ECTS credits and have a GPA of at least 2.70 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Program graduates can work in healthcare institutions such as neurology, physical therapy and rehabilitation clinics, and post-traumatic brain injury and stroke rehabilitation centers; in multidisciplinary teams at private or university hospitals; in neuropsychological assessment and cognitive rehabilitation centers; in medical research units and R&D centers; as well as in academic institutions and research laboratories as specialist psychologists or researchers. Assessment and Grading Various measurement and evaluation methods such as mid-term exam, quiz, practice, project, report, and final are used for the evaluation of the students Dec. For graduation, the GPA is expected to be at least 2.70 out of 4 in the program. Courses are scored and lettered as shown in the table. Course grade point range value coefficient AA 90-100 fine 4.00, BA 85-89 Good-Good 3.50, BB 80-84 good 3.00, CB 75-79 Medium-good 2.50, CC 70-74 medium 2.00, FD 70 and under poor-failed 0.50, FF failed 0.00, FG failed to take the semester/year end exam a) (i) grade: awarded to students who are successful in the semester If the student receives an (I) grade from any course in any semester, he / she has to complete his / her deficiencies within fifteen days from the end of the final exam determined for the semester. Otherwise, the (i) grade spontaneously becomes (FF). However, this period may be extended until the beginning of the next registration period with the recommendation of the head of the department and the approval of the Executive Board upon the application of the student in case of prolonged illness or similar circumstances. B) (S) grade: it is awarded to students who have successfully completed the courses, thesis studies and thesis examination in the scientific preparation program and who have been successful in the courses taken without credit. (S) grades are also awarded for courses taken as special students in universities other than the University. C) (U) grade: it is awarded to the students who are not successful in the courses in the scientific preparation program, in the thesis studies and in the thesis exam and to the students who are unsuccessful in the non-credit courses. In universities outside the University, a Grade (U) is also awarded for courses taken as special students and failed. ç) (NA) grade: it is given to students who have not attended classes and is treated as (FF) grade. D) (P) grade: awarded to students who are continuing their thesis studies. E) (EX) grade: it is given for the courses that students who come from universities other than the University by horizontal transfer have taken before and that are considered to the course load. The EX grade does not participate in the average but is shown in the grade documents. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6448

With only few students, the goal is t follow each student’s academic achievement and clinical skillset, one-on-one. The content of the program is comprised of meticulously constituted courses and as theoretical orientation, the students predominantly learn psychoanalytic and cognitive-behavioral paradigms. As for their second year, internship and supervision studies are in the forefront and the students are expected to write a thesis. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master of Arts in Health Sociology (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master of Arts in Health Sociology (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme The aim of the master's program in health sociology is to enable students who have completed a bachelor's degree in social sciences or health sciences to specialize in health sociology. Sociology of Health is a field of study that studies the relationships between social institutions and health and disease, the effects of medicine on other social institutions, social, political and cultural deciders of health, and the health regulations of different economic systems. The patient-physician relationship, which constitutes an important dimension of treatment, communication processes affecting the attitudes and behaviors of society about health, hospital life, characteristics and requirements of health professionals are also topics within the scope of health sociology. Research shows that the distribution of diseases within society and between different societies is dec influenced by cultural and socio-economic conditions. Currently, processes such as extended life expectancy, increased environmental pollution, intensive urbanization, globalization and migration that develop in accordance with the changing structure of the economy and employment lead to new health problems and needs. On the other hand, the rapid development of medical technology is also gradually increasing the health requirements defined by communities. The study of all this creates a need for the contributions of social scientists familiar with the field of health. Starting in the 1980s, a rapidly growing health social sciences (sociology, psychology, anthropology and economics on the health of specialized sub-branches) classical Social Science in the curriculum to keep the place as they started, aiming to specialise in this branch of social science graduate programs are offered in the Departments of universities in Europe and North America. In line with the developments in the world, social scientists interested in health have started to be trained in our country and courses such as health sociology and health psychology have been included in undergraduate programs. It is also known that medical faculties, starting from state universities such as Dokuz September University and Marmara University, have started to take these courses in their curriculum. Therefore, it is possible to predict that research and teaching in the field of health social sciences will become widespread and that academic equipment will be needed to make this possible. Students who have completed the master's program with a dissertation in the Sociology of Health can continue their academic studies in a doctoral program in sociology specializing in general or another field if they decide not to continue in this field. PROG. Director Prof. Dr. İnci User History The program was established in 2018. Qualification Awarded Upon the completion of the program, students obtain a master's degree in health sociology. Admission Requirements In order to apply for this Graduate Program, candidates must have a bachelor's degree which is compliant with Higher Education Council (YÖK) and Acıbadem University Graduate School of Social Sciences or Health Sciences Students are admitted to the master's program by evaluating their undergraduate success level, Written Exam, Interview and ALES results. The candidate must have received a minimum of 55 standard points from the academic personnel and Graduate Education Entrance Examination (Ales) in the type of equal weight score and must have a minimum of 65 (2,5/4) Graduation Achievement grade. A minimum score of 55 from public exams (YDS, UDS, YÖKDIL or KPDS) for foreign language, a minimum score of 66 from TOEFL iBT, A minimum score of 50 from PTE Academic exam, a minimum score of C from CPE and CAE exams is required. For the candidates who do not have language proficiency, the Foreign Language exam will be conducted by the Department of Sociology. In the evaluation for admission, the candidates are ranked according to their overall grade of achievement. The overall grade is calculated by collecting 50% of the ALES score, 20% of the weighted average of the grades taken during undergraduate education, and 30% of the average of the Written Exam and interview scores to be given by the evaluation board. Those with an equal overall grade are given priority to those with a high grade point average. Turkish English and other candidates can apply to the program only with a very good level of English is expected by the University Senate. Higher Grade Transition Those who have right to start master's degree can continue to PhD programs where they meet the admission requirements. Those who have a master's degree in health sociology can apply to any sociology PhD or other social sciences programs. Graduation Requirements The student must be successful in all the courses in the program, have no FF, FD or P grades and have completed his / her thesis and accepted. The minimum number of ECTS credits the student is expected to provide is 120 and the minimum GPA is at least 2.70 out of 4.00. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Health sociology is a rapidly developing field with rich research and application opportunities. Because sociology is a core science, students who pursue a master's degree mostly aim for an academic career. Students who have completed the Master's program with thesis in sociology of health can also continue to any sociology or other social science doctoral program. If they do not want to pursue an academic career, they may choose to work primarily in the field of health as a researcher, educator, consultant or administrator. Other options may be to work in local governments, social services or non-governmental organizations. As sociology is not a purely academic field, it can be expected that the demand for graduates of sociology will continue to increase, as it is a relatively new concept in our country where it can also benefit for application purposes. Assessment and Grading The measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the “course instruction plan”. Final exams are held in the date range determined according to the academic calendar announced by Acıbadem University Graduate School of Social Sciences at the beginning of the year. The instructors evaluate all the studies, assignments, projects, presentations, mid-term exams and final exams in the semester and determine the grades of the students according to the passing grade system determined by the Institute.Dec. Students are informed in advance which measurement methods will be used in each course. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=5866

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in Breast imaging Techniques And Technologies (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in Breast imaging Techniques And Technologies (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme The science of radiology is one of the fastest developing and most high-tech branches of science in the field of medicine, where all the innovations of technology are used simultaneously. The vast knowledge and experience of radiology ensures the formation of special specialties with the development of system radiology and minor programs. Breast Radiology is an area in which a minor education program has not yet been established in our country. The prevalence of breast cancer and other breast diseases, the increase in screening programs also increases the need for a specialist breast radiologist. The national community-based screening program in our country is carried out regionally by the ministry of health. Qualified breast radiology specialists are needed in these programs and in the provision of second and third-line healthcare services in need of diagnostic breast radiology. Both clinical radiologists in breast imaging and breast radiology graduate program with enough hardware technologically win, verbatim technological developments to implement these developments contribute to daily practice in a competent decision-maker and a researcher aimed to gain the ability to be sufficient in their academic studies. It is aimed to complete the training, research and dissertation preparation processes of radiologists on breast radiology and technology within the framework of the main learning objectives set out below. Learning objectives of the program, To know the clinical, pathological and radiological bases and presentations of breast diseases To learn breast anatomy and physiology, patterns that change with age and diseases To understand the physics of mammography, breast ultrasound and MRI, image formation, their impact on image quality. To learn quality control standards and problem solving methods in imaging To obtain basic information that will distinguish between normal breast, benign and malignant breast diseases To understand the basic principles of breast cancer screening and radiological evaluation To understand the basics of the approach to abnormalities detected in screening To understand the clinical manifestations of breast diseases, pathogenesis and basic principles of treatment Learn national and international guides Mammographic evaluation: to learn how to distinguish between normal anatomy, benign and malignant imaging findings Learning how to do breast and axilla ultrasound Learning how to do and evaluate breast MRI To learn the basic interventional-radiological processes of the breast To learn decision support systems with Artificial Intelligence approach To learn the basics of medical image processing To learn the methodology of biomedicine as a method of clinical innovation Head of Department Prof. Dr. Gül Esen İçten Program Başkanı Prof. Dr. Füsun Taşkın History It has been accepting students since 2020-2021. Qualification Awarded Master's Degree with Thesis Admission Requirements Among the foreign language exams accepted by the Higher Education Council; TOEFL-IBT: Minimum 60 points YDS / ÜDS / KPDS / YÖKDİL: Minimum 55 points Candidates who do not have a foreign language certificate will be required to have at least 50 points from the Foreign Language Proficiency Exam conducted by the Department of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University. The Turkish language proficiency level of foreign candidates is evaluated according to the score to be obtained from the exams determined by the Senate. To obtain at least a valid score from one of the following exams for postgraduate education (results must be valid until the application date): To have a score of at least 55, 149 (old system 610) from the ALES or e-ALES numerical score type, GRE, not less than 450 points, GMAT score. The validity of these exams is 5 years. Higher Grade Transition Those who have successfully completed this program and received a master's degree can continue their doctoral programs in related fields. Graduation Requirements Successful completion of the thesis study and success in the thesis defense exam by taking the courses that constitute the graduation requirement in the program and fulfilling the criteria. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can work in the radiology units of breast clinics. Assessment and Grading Midterm exams / assignments / projects etc. and a final exam are made by the lecturer for each course. Evaluation criteria for each course are specified in course information packs. Final exams are held within the date range determined according to the academic calendar announced by Acıbadem University Health Sciences Institute at the beginning of the year. Instructors evaluate all work, homework, midterm and final exams during the semester and grades according to the course passing grade system determined by the Institute. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6087

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Master Of Science in General Senology (With Thesis)
fields.content: Master Of Science in General Senology (With Thesis) - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 2 Max.Program Time (Year) 3 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Thanks to increasing research, there are rapid developments in science and these developments are reflected in the branches of science. Thanks to the rapidly accumulating knowledge and developing technologies, the need for specialization in the field of medicine-health has emerged. On the other hand, applying individual and multidisciplinary approaches to patients helps to achieve much more successful results in the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of diseases. This multidisciplinary approach can only be achieved when physicians, biologists and engineers from different disciplines and specialties come together for a goal and come together on an academic platform to improve their knowledge and experience and to carry out common basic research and development on issues that they cannot solve with their knowledge. This program has been prepared in order for the health personnel, nurses and doctors who will work in the science of senology to obtain information about the basic subjects listed below, to work as qualified personnel in the senology institute and breast centers, and to prepare their thesis by doing research on one of these subjects. The learning objectives of the program, The development of breast tissue in embryological life and adolescence, its change during pregnancy and in the postmenopausal period, its responses to hormonal and environmental factors, and the individual differences of these physiological responses. Investigation of hereditary and acquired genetic changes of breast cancer Benign diseases of the breast Molecular mechanisms of breast cancer Investigation of breast diseases by imaging methods (screening, diagnosis, staging and follow-up) Surgical approach to breast cancer Radiotherapy of breast diseases Pathology of breast diseases Systemic treatment of breast cancer Epidemiology of breast cancer and investigation of factors affecting the development of breast cancer Head of Department Prof. Dr. Selma Gül ESEN İÇTEN History The program started to accept students in 2020-2021. Qualification Awarded Master's degree with thesis Admission Requirements Domestic: 3 Graduate of medical, physical therapy and Rehabilitation, Nursing departments. Overseas: 1 Graduate of medical physical therapy and Rehabilitation, Nursing departments of a higher education program that provides at least a Bachelor's degree (4 years), submit a transcript or document that it can graduate before the registration period Language Proficiency Foreign language exams accepted by the Council of Higher Education; TOEFL-IBT: minimum 60 points YDS / UDS/KPDS/YÖKDIL: minimum 55 points For candidates who do not have a foreign language certificate, they will be asked to have received at least 50 points from the Foreign Language proficiency exam, which will be conducted by the Department of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar university. The Turkish language proficiency degree of foreign candidates is evaluated according to the score to be taken from the exams determined by the Senate. For foreign candidates; Foreign language exams accepted by the Council of Higher Education; YDS / UDS/KPDS/YÖKDIL: at least 70 points TOEFL-IBT: minimum 84 points PTE Academic: at least 71 points, CAE: at Level B CPE: C level Scientific Competence For graduate education, to have received the least valid score from one of the following exams (result documents must be valid until the application date): Ales or e-ALES numerical score type at least 55, 149 (old system 610) points not less than GRE, 450 points not less than GMAT score to have. The validity of these exams is 5 years. Higher Grade Transition Those who have successfully completed this program and received a master's degree can continue their doctoral programs in related fields. Graduation Requirements Students who have successfully completed the thesis study and succeeded in the thesis defense exam by taking the courses that constitute the graduation requirement of the program and fulfilling the criteria are considered to have successfully completed their master's degree with thesis provided that the GPA is at least the passing grade determined by the Institute of Health Sciences. Occupational Profiles of Graduates After completing the program, he can work in clinics serving in the field of senology and in the relevant units of the universities Assessment and Grading Midterm exams / assignments / projects etc. and a final exam are made for each course by the lecturer. Evaluation criteria for each course are specified in course information packs. Final exams are held within the date range determined according to the academic calendar announced by Acıbadem University Senology Research Institute at the beginning of the year. Instructors evaluate all work, homework, midterm and final exams during the semester and grades according to the course passing grade system determined by the Institute. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6086

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Biochemistry And Molecular Biology
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Biochemistry And Molecular Biology - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme The objective of Acıbadem University Health Sciences Institute’s ‘Biochemistry and Molecular Biology’ Doctoral Program is to educate qualified scientists, who have strong team work spirit, questioning, idea production and investigation mentality and who can also contribute to production. Today, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology are the two fastest developing scientific fields and have substantial effect on sectors such as medicine, pharmacology, agriculture, husbandry, industry and environment both globally and nationally. All of the modern biotechnologic products are based on the knowledge at hand about biochemistry and molecular biology. In this doctoral program, the goal is to teach students cellular and chemical incidents, which are observed at health and sickness, at molecular level. Genetics, signal transduction and metabolic reactions form a grift interaction web that has harmony with the environment. Genetic changes such as mutation and polymorphism, which affect single molecule, have also effect on cellular behaviour besides chemical process. This way, they might have significant effect on the organs’ functions and the organism itself. Because of these reasons, today’s biochemistry involves a wide interdisciplinary web of genomics, proteomics, gene and protein network, as well as lipid, carbohydrate and protein metabolic pathway, cellular communication and signal cascades and also organs’ complex diseases and cardiovascular circulation. And in modern biochemical researches, as parallel to that wide content, advanced techniques such as microarrays, peptides, proteins and mass – spectrometry analysis of biomolecules are also in use. Students, who attend this doctoral program, will gain experience about clinical and laboratory aspects of biochemical and genetic researches, besides acquisition of wide theoretical knowledge about an interdisciplinary program. As a result, a student, who graduates from this program that aims to educate preemptible researchers in terms of career opportunities and preferability in various areas, will be able to become an academician or a researcher at public or private institutions such as universities and research centers and also will have executive positon opportunities at medical faculties’ and health institutions’ diagnosis and tratment laboratories. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Aysel Özpınar Program Başkanı Prof. Dr. Aysel Özpınar History The BMB PhD Program has started to accept students from the fall semester of 2013-2014 academic year. Five students have completed the PhD program; many of them are continuing the academic career as a faculty member and the other one is working in Public Health laboratory under the Ministry of Health. The program included 2 Prof., 7 Assoc Prof and 5 Assist Prof at the beginning. Qualification Awarded Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) Admission Requirements Candidates applying for a master's degree must have a numerical score of at least 55 from the Academic Staff and Graduate Education Entrance Exam (ALES), a GRE of at least 149 for foreign students or a GMAT of at least 450 points. Of the foreign language exams accepted by the Council of Higher Education, TOEFL-IBT: at least 66 points, YDS/UDS/KPDS/YÖKDIL: at least 55 points. Applicants applying PhD with a bachelor's degree a must have a numerical score of at least 80, a GRE of at least 152 or a GMAT of at least 590 points. Undergraduate graduation GPA must be at least 3 or equivalent out of 4. Of the foreign language exams accepted by the Council of Higher Education, TOEFL-IBT: at least 84 points, YDS/UDS/KPDS/YÖKDIL: at least 70 points. Higher Grade Transition Graduates can apply for faculty member positions Graduation Requirements The students should pass the courses successfully and have completed at least 240 ECTS, after completing the PhD qualifier exam and make the thesis and succeed in the defense of the thesis; an abstract presented to congresses every year, at least 2 publications in SCI- SCIE covered journals and student's thesis is accepted to be published in journals covered by SCI-SCI-expanded, the student is entitled to graduation. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can continue their careers in universities as academic staff and can go abroad as a post-doctoral researchers. They can work as researchers in R & D centers and can also work in the pharmaceutical industry and medical laboratories. Assessment and Grading For the evaluation of students, different assessment and evaluation methods such as midterm, project presentation, practice exam, final exam and article discussion are used. In order to be considered successful, students must get at least 75 out of 100 points. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=54

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Biophysics (English)
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Biophysics (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Biophysics is a scientific field that studies biological processes using the concepts, principles, and methods of physics. To understand the structure and function of complex biological systems a multidisciplinary approach is required. Biophysics is a field where scientists from life sciences and quantitative sciences of physics, mathematics, chemistry and engineering address scientific questions. Due to its interdisciplinary nature, students with an undergraduate degree in many fields, including physics, chemistry, biology, engineering and medicine can be trained in biophysics. Biophysicists are expected to have a basic background in medical sciences such as anatomy, physiology, and biochemistry, as well as in fields such as mathematics, physics, biology, and computers, and they must acquire sufficient knowledge in these fields during their education. Especially in recent years, developments in the field of science and technology have highlighted the need for an interdisciplinary approach and many countries have intensified their investments to train manpower in these fields. In our country, the number of scientists and faculty members in the field of biophysics is quite limited. Our graduate program aims to fill this gap and train biophysicists for academia as well as other career options. Vice-co-ordinator Lecturer, Phd. Evren Kılınç Vice-co-ordinator Associate Prof. Dr. Devrim Öz Arslan Vice-co-ordinator Associate Prof. Dr. Zeynep Aslıhan Durer Head of Department Prof. Dr. Beki Kan History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Institute of Health Sciences, Biophysics PhD Program has started education and training in the 2020-2021 Academic Year. Qualification Awarded Those who graduate after completing their four-year education will receive the title of "philosophical doctorate PhD". Admission Requirements Those who have completed their master's degree in the field of Nature, Life Sciences and Engineering, and those who have graduated from the Faculty of Medicine or Faculty of Pharmacy can apply to the Biophysics Doctorate Program, in accordance with the student admission criteria of the Higher Education Council (YÖK) and Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Institute of Health Sciences. Applications coming from outside these departments will be evaluated by the science exam to be held by the relevant board. Scientific Qualification Requirements: Candidates must have at least 60 Numeric score from Academic Personnel and Postgraduate Education Entrance Exam (ALES) or GRE must be at least 149 For candidates who will apply to doctoral programs based on undergraduate degrees; Graduation grade point averages of at least 3 out of 4 or an equivalent score and ALES not less than 80 points in the score type of the program applied for from ALES, to have ALES, not less than 152 (old system 720) points, which will be determined by the Senate. Foreign Language Requirement: Among the foreign language exams accepted by the Higher Education Council; TOEFL-IBT: Minimum 84 points; YDS / ÜDS / KPDS / YÖKDİL: They must have at least 70 points. Higher Grade Transition Degree holders may apply for a job in relevant faculties of universities as an assistant professor or a researcher at research institutes. Graduation Requirements For the Biophysics doctorate degree, as stated in the Article 50 of the Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Graduate Regulation: The doctorate program requires a total of 24 credits for students accepted with a master's degree with thesis and a minimum of 60 ECTS per academic semester At least 249 ECTS credits including seven courses, seminar, proficiency exam, thesis proposal and thesis work; For students admitted with a bachelor's degree, it consists of a minimum of 46 credits, 16 courses, seminars, proficiency exam, thesis proposal and thesis study, and a total of at least 303 ECTS credits. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Degree holders may apply for a job in relevant faculties of universities as an assistant professor or a researcher at research institutes. Assessment and Grading Different assessment and evaluation methods such as project presentation, homework, seminar preparation and final exam are used in the assessment of students. Students must get at least 75 points out of 100 in order to be considered successful. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6149
