fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Biostatistics And Bioinformatics (English)
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Biostatistics And Bioinformatics (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Biostatistics and Bioinformatics approaches emerge with their frequent use in the solution of today's health problems. These two fields aim to produce probabilistic and analytical solutions to problems in medicine and life sciences, respectively. Although these areas have overlapping aspects, they also have different aspects. Developments in today's technologies, especially in next-generation sequencing, transcriptomics, proteomics and other omics technologies, allow the collection of large numbers of data. In addition, electronic health records of hospitals are rich databases and contain very large data. It is necessary to develop advanced biostatistics and bioinformatics methods in order to absorb such data and use them with a personalized medicine perspective, in making diagnosis and treatment decisions, in understanding the mechanisms of disease formation, and in providing early diagnosis of diseases. In this program, we aim to teach these two scientific approaches together. We think that this is important because we believe that scientists who can acquire these skills together will contribute significantly to the development of science in Turkey. Although the program we provide does not have an example in Turkey, there are examples in the world. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Uğur Sezerman History The first PhD program in this field. Qualification Awarded PhD in Biostatistics and Bioinformatics Admission Requirements Dil Yeterliliği • Yükseköğretim Kurulu tarafından kabul edilen yabancı dil sınavlarından; • Yüksek lisans derecesi ile doktora programına başvuranların; • TOEFL-IBT: En az 80 puan • YDS/ÜDS/KPDS/YÖKDİL: En az 67 puan • Lisans derecesi ile doktora programına başvuranların; • TOEFL-IBT: En az 84 puan • YDS/ÜDS/KPDS/YÖKDİL: En az 70 puan Bilimsel Yeterlilik • Lisansüstü eğitim için aşağıda belirtilen sınavlardan birinden en az geçerli puanı almış olmak (sonuç belgeleri başvuru tarihine kadar geçerli olmalıdır) • Yüksek lisans derecesi ile başvuran adayların ALES veya e-ALES sayısal puan türünden en az 55 puan almak, veya GRE quantitative türünden en az 149 ya da GMAT en az 450 puan olması gerekmektedir. • Doktora/ sanatta yeterlilik/tıpta uzmanlık/diş hekimliğinde uzmanlık/veteriner hekimliğinde uzmanlık/eczacılıkta uzmanlık mezunları için ALES şartı aranmaz. Üniversite Senatosu tarafından mezun olduğu lisansüstü programa girişteki puan türü veya uzmanlık alanına bakılmaksızın belirlenen puan dikkate alınır. Lisans derecesi ile doktora programına başvuranların; • ALES sınavından elde edecekleri sayısal puanın en az 60 olması, GRE en az 151 puan ya da GMAT en az 465 puan olması gerekmektedir. • Lisans mezuniyet not ortalamalarının 4 üzerinden en az 3 veya eşdeğeri bir puan olması gerekmektedir. • Lisansüstü programlara başvuran adaylardan başvuruları sırasında aşağıdaki belgelerden herhangi birini sağlayamayanlar, olumlu değerlendirilmeleri durumunda, ilgili Enstitüsü Yönetim Kurulu tarafından başvurdukları programa şartlı kabul edilebilirler: o Lisansüstü Eğitim Giriş Sınavı Sonucu o Dil Yeterlik Sınav Sonucu o Tanınırlık Belgesi (yurt dışından alınan diplomalar için) • Şartlı kabul alan öğrencilerin eksik belgelerini en geç kabul edildikleri ilk dönemin akademik takvimde belirtilen dönem sonu sınavlarının bitiş tarihine kadar tamamlamaları şarttır. İlgili belgeyi belirtilen süre içerisinde sağlayamayan adayların kayıtları iptal edilir. • Yurtdışında öğrenim gören adayların, lisans ve lisansüstü derecelerini aldıkları yükseköğretim kurumunun tanınırlığı veya verilen eğitimin uygunluğunun YÖK tarafından onaylanması gerekmektedir. Bu sorgulama aday öğrenci tarafından yapılır ve tanınırlık/uygunluk onay dokümanı üniversiteye sunulur. Aday bu sorgulamayı yapmadan da başvurabilir, bu durumda başvurusu olumlu değerlendirlen adaylar onay dokumanını en geç bir dönem içinde sunmak koşuluyla kabul alabilir. Onay dokumanı bir dönem içerisinde sunulmayan adayların kayıtları iptal edilir. Bunun dışında yabancı uyruklu adaylar, Acıbadem Üniversitesi yabancı uyruklu öğrenci kabul koşullarını sağlamasını gerekmektedir. Programlara Başvuru için Gerekli Evraklar; • Lisans ve Yüksek Lisans Diploma veya Geçici Mezuniyet Belgesinin Aslı (Onaylı fotokopisi kayıt esnasında yapılacaktır.) (Yabancı ülkelerden Biyoinformatik Doktora Programına temel oluşturabilecek ilgili alanlardan bir lisans programından (BSc) veya yüksek lisans (MSc) programından alınan diplomalarının YÖK tarafından denkliğinin onaylanmış olması gerekir.) • Resmi akademik transkript: İlgili yükseköğretim kurumunun Öğrenci İşleri tarafından hazırlanmış, adayın aldığı tüm dersleri ve notlarını gösteren resmi belgenin online sistem üzerinden sisteme yüklenmesi ve/veya kapalı zarf içerisinden sunulması gereklidir. • Niyet mektubu: Adayın söz konusu programa neden katılmak istediği, programa ve kariyerine ilişkin hedefleri, motivasyonları, beklentileri özetlenmelidir. • Referans Mektubu, (iki adet) (kapalı zarf içinde) (Mülakat Sınavında Referans Mektuplarının teslim edilmemesi durumunda kayıt alınmayacaktır.) • İngilizce Yeterlilik Sınav Sonuç Belgesi • ALES, GMAT veya GRE sınavlarından birisinden sonuç belgesi (Doktora/ sanatta yeterlilik/tıpta uzmanlık/diş hekimliğinde uzmanlık/veteriner hekimliğinde uzmanlık/eczacılıkta uzmanlık mezunları için mezun olduğu lisans programı diploması). • Nüfus cüzdanı fotokopisi /Pasaport Fotokopisi • Erkek Adaylar için Askerlik Belgesi Higher Grade Transition Graduates can apply to faculty member positions Graduation Requirements Completing coursework and thesis Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can apply to faculty member positions Assessment and Grading Exam, homeworks, projects, presentations https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=5846

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Medical Biotechnology (English)
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Medical Biotechnology (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme Medical Biotechnology is a graduate program dedicated to provide education and research opportunities in life sciences for the development of innovative technologies to improve human health. The program covers subjects like recombinant DNA technology, protein engineering, synthetic biology, tissue engineering, drug and vaccine development, rapid diagnostics, personalized medicine and gene therapy. Students have the opportunity to work with highly experienced researchers from a wide area of biotechnology, in laboratories equipped with elaborate modern instruments and state of art infrastructure. We give importance to develop collaborative projects with industry reinforced by national grant programs. All students with Turkish citizenship, accepted in this program, receive full education scholarship. Most of the students are additionally supported by research grants. The students are expected to spend full time in the university for their education and research. Part-time study is not accepted for this program. We encourage students with high enthusiasm of research, to join us. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Tanıl KOCAGÖZ History The Department of Medical Biotechnology, which is under the Institute of Health Sciences, admitted a student in 2016-2017 academic year. In 2018, it produced first graduates. Qualification Awarded The title of Doctor of Medical Biotechnology is given. Admission Requirements Admission of students to our graduate programs is made according to the provisions of YÖK's "graduate education and training regulation" and Acıbadem University's “Graduate Education, Training and examination regulation”. General application requirements for graduate programs, application documents, Application and admission process are determined and announced by the Institute of Health Sciences and program coordinators. Candidates can apply directly to the relevant institute by providing the necessary documents. Applications and entries are made within the periods announced in the academic calendar. Masters or Bachelors (4 years) education in a higher education program in the Department of Biochemistry Department of biology, bioengineering, biomedical engineering, Biosystems Engineering, Biotechnology and Molecular Biology, Genetics and bioinformatics, genetics and Bioengineering, chemical and biological engineering programs in engineering and Natural Sciences, Faculty of dentistry, faculty of pharmacy, food Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, Department of medical biology, Medicine, engineering, medicine, Graduates of Veterinary faculties and departments can apply by submitting a transcript or certifying that they can graduate before the registration period. Language Proficiency Candidates applying with a master's degree; Foreign language exams accepted by the Council of Higher Education; TOEFL-IBT: minimum 78 points YDS / UDS/KPDS/YÖKDIL: minimum 60 points PTE Academic: minimum 50 points Applicants for a doctoral program with a bachelor's degree; Foreign language exams accepted by the Council of Higher Education; TOEFL-IBT: minimum 84 points YDS / UDS/KPDS/YÖKDIL: at least 70 points Scientific Competence Candidates applying with a master's degree; Academic staff and Graduate Education Entrance Exam (ALES) to obtain a numerical score must be at least 65, for foreign students GRE must be at least 151 or GMAT must be at least 480 points. Ales is not required for graduates of a doctorate/ qualification in art/specialty in medicine/specialty in dentistry/specialty in veterinary medicine/specialty in pharmacy. 65 points determined by the Senate of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar university, regardless of the type of points or area of expertise at the entrance to the graduate program, are taken into account. Candidates applying for a doctoral program with a bachelor's degree; The numerical score they will receive from the ales exam must be at least 81, GRE must be at least 156 or GMAT must be at least 590 points. Undergraduate graduation GPA must be at least 3 or equivalent out of 4. Application conditions are announced in the announcements tab of the Institute of Health Sciences. Evaluation is two-stage: Written Exam (aims to measure general biology knowledge; must already choose; is English.) Oral exam (students who pass the Written Exam can participate; performed by a jury; is in English.) Higher Grade Transition They can apply as a lecturer/faculty member to the relevant faculties of universities. Graduation Requirements Students who take courses in the program, fulfill the general criteria and successfully completed the thesis and thesis defense get passing grades found successful in the examination set by the Institute of Health Sciences is deemed to have successfully completed subject to the Graduate School. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can apply to the relevant faculties of universities as a lecturer/faculty member. According to their interests, students who graduate from this program may find the opportunity to work in many health-related areas, such as medicine, pharmaceutical and food industries, especially in R & D units. Assessment and Grading Aimed at assessing the learning goals set for each course, exam, homework, project, etc. methods are used for assessment and evaluation. Criteria specific to each course are defined in the course information package. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=70

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Medical Microbiology
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Medical Microbiology - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Medical Microbiology is a science of identifying microorganisms that cause disease in humans. Structure and classification, reproductive characteristics, pathogenic mechanisms, diagnostic methods and antimicrobial agents of the microorganisms are the main areas of study. The aim of the microbiology doctoral program is teaching the candidates in the field of microbiology at international standards with the latest technology and scientific research methods. In the light of contemporary and universal values, the candidates will gain professionalism in Medical Microbiology, performing profession with self-confidence, developing themselves scientifically and contributing to science under the innovation, while adopting ethical rules as a principle. Our doctorate program will show its effect also for academic life as the graduates take place at educational institutions. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Yeşim Gürol History The program will accept students in 2021-22 education year for the first time Qualification Awarded Those who can complete the program successfully is awarded with the title of “Medical Microbiology Doctor (PhD)” Admission Requirements To be a graduate of Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Veterinary Medicine, School of Science Department of Biology, or Molecular Biology and Genetics or Biotechnology, To get minimum score of 70 in digital part of the Selection Exam for Academic Personnel and Graduate Studies, For international students, GRE minimum 152, or GMAT score of minimum 470 are required. Foreign language exam scores of TOEFL-IBT 70 (minimum), Foreign Language Exam (FLE) test of 60 (minimum) is required. Higher Grade Transition To achieve the MSc Graduate title, as mentioned in Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Directory of Master of Science program, the MSc program consists of a total of twenty-one credits, and article presentation, seminar and thesis studies with 120 ECDC. Graduation Requirements To achieve the PhD graduate title, as mentioned in Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Directory of Master of Science program, the PhD program consists of a total of twenty-one credits, at least for seven lectures, each with 60 credits annualy, seminars, competency exam, thesis proposal and conductance and 240 ECDC. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates of Medical Microbiology Doctorate Program will have the required knowledge and skills to be occupied as an academician in not only local universities but also in international universities, owing to the English program. Assessment and Grading The examinations may be as written, oral, homework and presentation formats. During the Covid-19 pandemic, the exams may be made online in oral or written forms, as decided. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6151

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Neuroscience
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Neuroscience - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Neuroscience (neuroscience) is the field of science that covers the scientific study of the nervous system. Neuroscience studies and researches the nervous system from a structural, developmental, evolutionary, functional and medical point of view. Its branches in various types of Neuroscience (Anatomy, histology, physiology, biochemistry, genetics, pharmacology, Neurology, Neurosurgery, Psychiatry, radiology, etc.) and non-medical science in various fields (biology, chemistry, physics, psychology, and engineering sciences, such as a place that is important to them that they could find multi-disciplinary field of research. Macro and micro anatomy of the peripheral and central nervous system, brain, sensory systems, neurons, synaptic structures, neurotransmitters, noromodulator in neural connections, networks, vision, hearing, pain, language, learning, memory, cognition and neural science, some important research topics. Neuroscientists Neuroanatomy, neurophysiology, neural chemistry, norofarmakoloji, neuroimaging, neurotechnology, developmental neuroscience, Social Neuroscience, the neural philosophy of Science, the understanding of the causes of neurological and psychiatric diseases and drug conduct research on development issues. Neuroscience is a branch of science in which very important and exciting developments are taking place all over the world and in our country. The leading countries in science for research in this field have announced special programs [such as the United States BRAIN Initiative (USA), the European Union's Human Brain Project (EU), the China Brain Project (China)] and created large funds for these studies. It is hoped that in the coming years there will be increases and developments in research in the field of neuroscience. In parallel with these important developments in the world in our country, the field of neuroscience research is one of the priority areas where major developments are expected, and there is a need for competent scientists to conduct high-level research in this field. Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University has a very competent academic staff working in the field of neuroscience and equipped modern research laboratories. Our university aims to contribute to the education of competent scientists who will work in the field of neuroscience with the doctoral program in neuroscience. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Filiz ONAT History It was established in 2018 and actively accepts students. Qualification Awarded PhD Admission Requirements Graduates of Faculty of Medicine (physicians and specialist physicians), Graduates of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine, Faculty of Dentistry and Pharmacy with at least 10 semesters of undergraduate education, Candidates that have expertise in a laboratory branch according to the principles regulated by the Ministry of Health, Candidates who have a PhD (PhD) and a Master's degree, Candidates who have successfully completed at least 8 semesters of undergraduate education in the health field or document that they can graduate until the registration period. (Undergraduate Degree will not be accepted.) Higher Grade Transition Students can apply to the relevant faculty of the universities as an academic staff Graduation Requirements For applicants with a Master's degree: Medical, Dental and Veterinary Medicine, graduates of Pharmacy Faculties or Departments of Molecular Biology and Genetics or Biochemistry should have a Master's Degree or submit a transcript or document that they can graduate by the semester. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates have opportunity to find positions in academia and industry, as well as find postdoctoral researcher positions abroad. Assessment and Grading Midterm exam, project presentations, practice exam, final exams are required in the assessment of students, which they are expected to succeed in. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=5986

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Nursing
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Nursing - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Changes in health care services, globalization, developments in science and technology necessitate the training of qualified nurses who will develop policies at international level and give scientifically-based care, and the training of faculty members who will train these nurses. The aim of the doctoral program in nursing; The aim is to provide the student with the ability to conduct independent scientific research, to develop evidence-based practices in nursing, to interpret, to solve problems, to make professional values and ethical decisions, to base nursing care on a model/theory, principles and methods, and to encourage the use of the knowledge gained in this direction. With the Nursing Doctorate Programs, both nurse lecturers will be trained and national and international publications will contribute to professional and academic development. It is thought that scientific studies will contribute to the protection of public health, raising awareness of patient care and building strong bridges in international relations. Nursing doctorate program, planned in line with the student's request; It covers areas of specialization such as Internal Medicine Nursing, Surgical Nursing, Nursing Fundamentals, Women's Health and Diseases Nursing, Public Health Nursing, Child Health and Diseases Nursing, Psychiatric Nursing and Nursing Management. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Ükke Karabacak History The nursing Doctoral Program has started to admit students in the fall semester of 2017-2018. Higher Grade Transition A lecturer/member can be applied at the relevant faculties of universities Graduation Requirements The total national credit with 7 courses+seminar courses required for admission with a master's degree in order to obtain a doctoral degree is a minimum of 21 and ECTS 240, and for students admitted with a bachelor's degree, 14 courses+seminar courses are at least 42 national credits and 300 ECTS. GANO must be at least 3 out of 4. The course passing grade is CC. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Nutrition And Dietetics
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Nutrition And Dietetics - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent .Graduate Degree About Programme Nutrition and Diet Specialist is a certified person whose areas of expertise are included but not limited to; - Growth, development and life-long protection and improvement of all individuals’ health, - Designation of individual nutrition’s and mass feeding’s plans and programs in accordance with nutrition science’s principles for the enhancement of quality of life, - Research, assessment and solution finding of health problems stemmed from nutritional element, food and nutrition, - Providing proper use of existing food sources in balance with economy and health rules, - Enlightment of the individual and the community about these issues to enable adaptation of physiological, psychological and sociological lifestyle, - Planning, education, enforcement and observation of diet programs based on the combination of natural and therapeutic nutritions, which are in consistent with medical and surgical treatments of congenital and acquired diseases and other special conditions. The aim of Acibadem University Health Sciences Institute’s ‘Nutrition and Dietetics Graduate Program with thesis’ is to educate scholars, who are or will be a part of researcher/specialist team; and thus to teach them how to plan and perform researches in nutrition and dietetics field in consistent with changing health necessities and consequently contribute to universal science by way of evaluating the results; and also to educate nutrition and dietetic specialists, who are intelligent, efficient, competent and knowledgeable at national and international level and capable to contribute to national policies. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Murat BAŞ History Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Institute of Health Sciences, Nutrition and Dietetics Ph.D. Program has started education and training in 2015-2016 Academic Year. Specializing in the field of private universities in Turkey and have sufficient academic staff of Nutrition and Dietetics is one of the Doctoral Program. Qualification Awarded Doktorate Admission Requirements Students who have Equivalency Certificate and Master's Degree in Nutrition and Dietetics) from the program of Nutrition and Dietetics will be admitted to the students who have received the Bachelor's and Master's Degree from the other countries. Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University will be held in accordance with the Regulations for Graduate Education and Examinations. For Graduate Graduates; a) To have a master's degree approved by the Institute Board upon the recommendation of the related department. b) get at least 55 points from the ALES Digital Department or equivalent scores from international exams such as GRE and GMAT, which are accepted by the Council of Higher Education. (At least 450 points from the GMAT Exam, GRE at least 610 points in the past, at least 149 points again on GRE). (c) At least 55 points from the KPDS / ÜDS / YDS or at least 66 points from the TOEFL: Internet-based test (IBT) or at least 50 from the PTE Academic. For Undergraduate Graduates; a) Graduation average of the undergraduate program to be at least 3.0 / 4.0. b) get at least 80 points from ALES Numerical Department or equivalent scores from international exams such as GRE and GMAT accepted by the Council of Higher Education (at least 585 points from the GMAT Exam, at least 720 points from GRE, at least 156 points from GRE). c) At least 70 points from the KPDS / ÜDS / YDS or at least 84 points from the TOEFL: Internet-based test (IBT) or at least 71 from the PTE Academic. Higher Grade Transition They can apply as a faculty member to the related faculties of universities. Graduation Requirements The student must have achieved all the courses in the program, not have F1, F2 or Z grade. In this program, the student must provide minimum 240 ECTS credits and the GPA must be at least 2,70 out of 4 or 69,66 out of 100. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can work in hospitals, various public institutions, food and beverage companies, nursing homes, elderly care homes, nurseries and food industry and/or can be employed as academicians in nutrition and dietetics departments of universities. fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Physiology
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Physiology - Department Information Language Turkish Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme The necessity for scientists in country, who can achieve scientific production and researches at international level particularly in medical sciences field, still exists. Acibadem University Health Sciences Institute’s Physiology Doctoral Program aims to educate qualified scientists to satisfy the necessity in Physiology field, who question and wonder, as well as who can plan and perform researches that would contribute to international literature. We are offering learning and research opportunities at laboratory and working environment which have advanced technological foundation. We are hoping to welcome you onboard, if you would like to benefit from these opportunies and also to learn, research and produce together. Head of Department Prof. Dr. Güldal Süyen Program Başkanı Associate Prof. Dr. Hande Yapışlar History Since the fall semester of 2017-2018 Academic Year, Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University has started to accept students in the Department of Physiology. Qualification Awarded Doctor of Philosophy Admission Requirements For those applying to the PhD program with a Bachelor's degree: A program of at least a Bachelor's (4 years) program in Biology, Chemical Engineering, Molecular Biology and Genetics, Bioengineering, Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation, Medical Engineering, Medicine, Dental and Veterinary Medicine, Pharmacy Faculty and Departments graduates must demonstrate that they can graduate by presenting their transcript or by graduation. For applicants with a Master's degree: Medical, Dental and Veterinary Medicine, graduates of Pharmacy Faculties or Departments of Molecular Biology and Genetics or Biochemistry should have a Master's Degree or submit a transcript or document that they can graduate by the semester. Higher Grade Transition Students can apply to the relevant faculty of the universities as an academic staff Graduation Requirements If the students pass the courses successfully and have completed at least 240 ECTS, after completing the PhD qualification exam and make the thesis and succeed in the defense of the thesis, the student is entitled to graduation. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Students who complete their doctoral training may apply to post-doctorate academic staff in Turkey after they pass the language examination; also they may apply to post-doctorate positions in abroad. Assessment and Grading In the evaluation of students, different measurement and evaluation methods such as midterm, project presentation, practice exam and final exam are used. In order to be considered successful, students must get at least 75 out of 100 points. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=5726

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Translational Medicine (English)
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Translational Medicine (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme PROG. Director Prof. Dr. Uğur ÖZBEK History It is the first doctoral program opened in this field. The doctorate program that is proposed to be opened does not have a master's program, but it will be in cooperation with other master's programs that are still being carried out, especially the "Genome Studies Master's Program". Qualification Awarded Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Translational Medicine Admission Requirements The application requirements for the "Translational Medicine" doctorate program within the body of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Institute of Health Sciences, are as follows, in addition to the conditions in the legislation of the Higher Education Institution; • To fulfill the application requirements of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Rules and Regulations Governing Graduate Studies. • For those who apply for Ph.D. with a B.S degree: Applicants holding a B.S. degree in Faculty of Medicine, Faculty of Dentistry, Faculty of Pharmacy, Genetics and Bioengineering, Molecular Biology, Molecular Biology and Genetics, Medical Engineering, Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Medical Biology, Biology must certify that they can graduate by the registration period. Individuals whose transcript does not have an equivalence in graduate courses are required to take the graduate courses of the Translational Medicine program. o B.S. graduation CGPA must be at least 3.00/4.00. o ALES (Akademik Personel ve Lisansüstü Eğitimi Giriş Sınavı - Academic Personnel and Postgraduate Education Entrance Examination) scores / quantitative must be at least 80. o Candidates are required to submit their English proficiency exam scores accepted by the Council of Higher Education (TOEFL IBT(at least 84), YDS/ÜDS/KPDS/YÖKDİL ( at least 70)). ? For those who apply for Ph.D. with an M.S. degree: All applicants are required to have an M.S. degree in Faculty of Medicine, Faculty of Dentistry, Faculty of Pharmacy, Genetics and Bioengineering, Molecular Biology, Molecular Biology and Genetics, Medical Engineering, Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Medical Biology, Biology, Molecular and Translational Medicine, Biostatistics and Bioinformatics, Biological Data Science ( The applicant's educational background is evaluated against the chosen fields of study for the Doctorate Program). ? If the applicant is accepted to the program while her/his transcript does not have equivalence in courses of Translational Medicine Program, the applicant may required to complete the required courses without earning credit for the fulfillment the requirements of the Ph.D program. o ALES (Akademik Personel ve Lisansüstü Eğitimi Giriş Sınavı - Academic Personnel and Postgraduate Education Entrance Examination) scores / quantitative must be at least 60. o Applicants who are not Turkish citizens may provide GRE (at least 149) or GMAT (at least 450) scores instead of ALES. o Applicants are required to submit their English proficiency exam scores accepted by Council of Higher Education (TOEFL IBT (at least 78), YDS/ÜDS/KPDS/YÖKDİL (at least 65). o Applicants, who do not possess a foreign language document, are required to have scored a minimum grade of 65 at Foreign Language Proficiency Test which is conducted by Acibadem Mehmet Ali Aydinlar University Department of Foreign Languages. Higher Grade Transition Graduates can apply for teaching staff positions. Graduation Requirements To get a Ph.D. degree in Translational Medicine Doctorate Program, 21 credit units of course work beyond the M.S. level and at least 60 ECTS in an academic year are required as indicated in article 50 of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Rules and Regulations Governing Graduate Studies. The program consists of at least 240 ECTS credits, including at least seven courses, seminars, a proficiency exam, thesis proposal, and thesis work. To get a Ph.D. degree in Translational Medicine Doctorate Program, 42 credits of course work beyond the B.S. level are required as indicated in article 50 of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Rules and Regulations Governing Graduate Studies. The program consists of at least 300 ECTS credits, including at least fourteen courses, seminars, a proficiency exam, a thesis proposal, and thesis work. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Graduates can apply for teaching staff positions. Assessment and Grading https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6228

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Biomaterial (English)
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Biomaterial (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme In this program, it is aimed to train the candidates in international standards on Biomaterials, to provide basic information about Biomaterials to the candidates during their training, as well as to provide theoretical and practical information about materials, processes and biocompatibility related to medical device materials on biomaterials.With the help of the aforementioned information, it is aimed to provide the student with the necessary skills in conducting independent research in the field of biomaterials, gaining theoretical and practical knowledge on biomaterial-based medical devices, examining, understanding, interpreting a wide range of scientific problems in health, biology, chemistry, materials and process techniques, and planning product design and production methods. In the 27th meeting of the Supreme Council of Science and Technology (ICTA), which is the highest decision-making body in the formation of science policies in Turkey, there is also a biomaterial area among the priority areas determined as a result of the meeting. As a result of this meeting, it was emphasized that 20 percent of domestic medical devices and medical equipment needs are planned to be met by domestic production in order to reach a high value-added product-oriented production structure, and the main components with the highest potential to affect the foreign trade deficit are biomedical equipment, diagnostic products, biomaterials, drugs and vaccines. In this direction, organizations such as the Ministry of Science, Industry and Technology and TUBITAK have started to provide significant support to projects in this field. With our PhD program opened in addition to the Y. Undergraduate Program we have opened in our university, it is expected that the domestic biomaterial requirement will be met partially by domestic production and that it will make a significant contribution to the field of health with its personalized biomaterial design and production targets. 11th Presidential Strategy and Budget Presidency of the Republic of Turkey published in July 2019. According to the Development Plan, it is planned to implement the Health Valley as an integrated health ecosystem in which all stakeholders of the sector such as universities, Research Centers, laboratories, technology companies, application centers, physicians and engineers are involved in order to improve the R&D and production capacity of our country in the field of Pharmaceuticals and Medical Technologies, where biomaterials are also a part of.It is envisaged to establish health technology development zones where pharmaceutical and medical device production areas will be located, technological facilities will be available to serve common use, support will be provided for clustering, and to establish accredited Centers of Excellence including analysis, verification, testing and measurement activities for R&D, pre-clinical studies, prototype development, production and post-production processes of medical devices (Eleventh Development Plan, 2019-2023, July 2019, Presidency of the Republic of Turkey Strategy and Budget Presidency). The learning objectives of the program are: Teaching relevant concepts on biomaterials, tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, Raising awareness of ethical values and ethical problems in scientific research and laboratory applications, Acquiring common working skills by taking an active role in scientific studies, Accessing to scientific resources and acquisition of correct interpretation skills, History Qualification Awarded Admission Requirements Higher Grade Transition Graduation Requirements Occupational Profiles of Graduates Assessment and Grading https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6206

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Doctor Of Philosophy in Biomedical Engineering (English)
fields.content: Doctor Of Philosophy in Biomedical Engineering (English) - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Biomedical Engineering Doctoral Program (BME Ph.D.) mainly focuses on neural engineering, medical imaging and point of care technologies, biomaterials (smart materials, smart drug release systems) but also Biomedical Electronics, Biomechanics, Bioengineering, Bioinformatics, Biophotonics, Physiology, Neuroscience and System Biology. In addition to the theoretical courses and laboratory applications, the clinical studies are carried out in cooperation with the hospitals and healthcare professionals. In this respect, each course in the curriculum is designed to include a clinical project. Biomedical Engineering is the field that deals with the research and development of novel technologies needed in healthcare environments. Our BME Ph.D. programs offer a variety of courses and expertise in following concentration areas: Biomaterials Nanomedicine Biotechnological Drug Development Neuroscience/Neuroimaging Biomechanics Biosensors Computational Biology Artificial Intelligence in healthcare In our BME Ph.D. program, healthcare technologies are determined in cooperation with medical doctors and healthcare professionals and thesis studies are conducted for this need. Courses and seminars are coordinated by experts. Candidates, who have the opportunity to conduct research and development in the fields, where international and national projects are carried out, gain experience in which they can continue their careers in industry and academy when they graduate. The primary objective of our BME Ph.D. program is to provide students the opportunity to invest in their future and to increase our scientific productivity through participating in our research projects. In recent years both in the world and in our country, the amount of support given to the ongoing research in the field of medical science has been increasing. National and international research funds support basic scientific, clinical and technological research. We, as the team of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, have benefited and will continue to benefit from these funds. In this respect, each course in the curriculum is designed to include a clinical project. Our BME Ph.D. programs offer a variety of courses and expertise in following concentration areas: • Biomaterials • Nanomedicine • Biotechnological Drug Development • Neuroscience/Neuroimaging • Biomechanics • Biosensors • Computational Biology • Artificial Intelligence in healthcare In our BME Ph.D. program, healthcare technologies are determined in cooperation with medical doctors and healthcare professionals and thesis studies are conducted for this need. Courses and seminars are coordinated by experts. Candidates, who have the opportunity to conduct research and development in the fields, where international and national projects are carried out, gain experience in which they can continue their careers in industry and academy when they graduate. The primary objective of our BME Ph.D. program is to provide students the opportunity to invest in their future and to increase our scientific productivity through participating in our research projects. In recent years both in the world and in our country, the amount of support given to the ongoing research in the field of medical science has been increasing. National and international research funds support basic scientific, clinical and technological research. We, as the team of Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, have benefited and will continue to benefit from these funds. Qualification Awarded Students receive a "Biomedical Engineering" PhD degree upon graduation after 4 years of education. Admission Requirements Requires Graduate or Undergraduate degree (4 yrs.) from one of the following departments/faculties: Medical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Industrial Engineering, System Engineering, Informatics, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical and Biological Engineering, Mathematics, Biology, Molecular Biology and Genetics, Bioengineering, Physics , Chemistry, Medicine, Dentistry, Veterinary; applicants will be able to apply either by submitting transcript or by documenting proof of completion until enrollment date. Higher Grade Transition He/she can apply for a lecturer/member at the relevant faculties of universities. Graduation Requirements Students who have been successful by taking the courses that make up the graduation requirement in the program and fulfilling the criteria, who have successfully completed the thesis study and have been successful in the thesis defense exam and have published at the determined rates, are considered to have successfully completed their doctorate education, provided that the overall grade point average is at least the passing grade determined by the Graduate School of of Natural and Applied Sciences. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can continue their careers as academic staff at universities, and they can go abroad as post-doctoral researchers. Assessment and Grading 1) Exams; There are four types as midterm, final exam, make-up exam and make-up exam. (2) Midterm exams can be made in courses. Projects, homework, laboratory, workshop and similar studies done during the semester can also replace the midterm exam. (3) The final exam can be given in the form of a written exam, project delivery, homework delivery, oral presentation and so on. The number and form of the midterm and final exams of a course, the rate that will affect the course success grade, and the evaluation principles of the exams are determined by the relevant faculty member and by taking the opinion of the institute department head. These notifications are announced to the students at the beginning of the semester by the student affairs department. (4) A make-up exam may be given for the midterm exam. If the student has a valid excuse and applies to the head of the department with a petition within five working days from the end of the excuse, he is given the right to take the make-up exam in the same semester with the approval of the head of the relevant department and the decision of the institute board of directors. (5) In order to increase the grade point average or the grade of the course, successful courses can be repeated without requiring attendance, or courses accepted as equivalent by the head of the institute department can be taken. Courses to be repeated are determined by the written request of the student, the proposal of the institute department head and the decision of the institute board of directors. The last grade taken from the repeated course is valid for the calculation of the overall weighted grade. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6067

fields.title: Program Hakkında – Molecular Biology and Genetics PhD
fields.content: Molecular Biology and Genetics PhD - Department Information Language English Program Time (Year) 4 Max.Program Time (Year) 6 Program Quota Internships Status Absent About Programme Head of Department Prof. Dr. Eda Tahir Turanlı History Molecular Biology and Genetics (MBG) Doctorate (PhD) Program aims to train expert researchers who can provide and develop advanced knowledge in the fields of research and development of mechanisms of human health and diseases within the scope of molecular biology and genetics disciplines. Thanks to the new technologies developed in the 21st century, very important new discoveries have been made in the field of molecular biology and genetics, which explain the functioning of molecules, cells, tissues and organisms. It is seen that the Nobel prizes given in the fields of medicine and chemistry are often given in the fields of molecular biology and genetic research in recent years. The importance of the discoveries made and to be made in this field of science and how valuable it is to train graduate-level researchers in this field is obvious. In addition, thanks to the mRNA vaccines developed during the COVID19 pandemic process, it once again highlighted the importance and necessity of training experts in the field of molecular biology and genetics. This PhD program aims to develop a scientific perspective that integrates the fundamental fields of molecular biology and genetics. Qualification Awarded Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) Admission Requirements Admission and registration conditions can be found in detail on the" application Conditions " page: https://www.acibadem.edu.tr/akademik/lisansustu/molekuler-biyoloji-ve-genetik-doktora-programi-hakkinda/basvuru-kasullar%C4%B1 Higher Grade Transition Graduation Requirements For graduation, Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Postgraduate education regulations are applied, and the student is expected to create a doctorate (PhD) thesis. Occupational Profiles of Graduates Our graduates can carry out basic and preclinical researches that will improve diagnosis and treatment for humans as scientists who are capable of conducting laboratory research in line with the new trends emerging in the field of health using new generation technologies and can support these researches with preclinical studies, and can carry out studies that will carry our country to the position of innovative countries. Our graduates can either carry themselves to the next level of education by continuing their post-doctorate research, or they can work in departments such as R&D, production and clinic in the sector. Assessment and Grading Measurement and evaluation methods applied for each course are defined in the "Course Teaching Plan". Regarding exams and course grades, Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University Postgraduate Education Regulations are applied. Various assessment and evaluation methods such as midterm exams, quizzes, applications, projects, reports and finals are used to evaluate students. For graduation, Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University graduate education regulations are applied, and the student is expected to create a doctorate (PhD) thesis. https://obs.acibadem.edu.tr/oibs/bologna/progAbout.aspx?lang=en&curSunit=6486
